shortDescription: Fight to survive in extraterrestrial environments while scavenging weapons and ammo. Defeat waves of enemies to earn money in order to upgrade your weapons in Horde Mode.

name: The Mice of Riddle Place: The Incident of Izzy Ramirez
shortDescription: Help Izzy solve the mystery of what is causing her asthma! In this game, the player will embark on an exciting journey to identify the causes of Izzy’s asthma using Science, Technology, Engineering and Math (STEM) in the exciting world of Riddle Place.

name: Lost Items
shortDescription: You wake up lost in a maze and realize there are many items on the ground. They all seem high-valuable, so you decide to pick them all. But there are also many ghosts that don't really want you to pick the items. Not that they will try to kill you, but they'll steal and move the items...

name: Delirium
shortDescription: Woken up in a strange and seemingly abandoned house, you discover what insanity has prevailed as you uncover the remnants of its past guilt-ridden inhabitant.

name: Captivus
shortDescription: Join the movement! Build a deck, equip your ship, and take on others in intense 1v1 card battles!

name: AESCULAP® OrthoPilot®Elite VR Palpation
shortDescription: Assume the role of a surgeon during this gamified knee replacement surgery minigame in VR.

name: Divide
shortDescription: Divide is a character-driven, science fiction action/adventure game with a modern take on isometric adventures of the past. Search for clues that reveal new insight into the story, interact with fully realized characters, and combat enemies by hacking out of sight, or launching a direct assault.

name: Xenia
shortDescription: A Metroidvania in Ancient Greece. Take control of the blacksmith Ardas. Fight epic bosses, find secret rooms and treasures, spend your gold for upgrades, and choose your fate through alternative endings. All this for one purpose. To save queen Xenia.

name: MINE!
shortDescription: This VR Shooting Gallery single player game has three levels of game play challenging you to defend the mine from invading forces. From your static vantage point you need to shoot as many aliens as possible, as fast as you can. Are you able to stop them stealing your crystals?

name: SPYHACK: Episode 1
shortDescription: SpyHack is a tactical action game where you play as male or female ATD Agent stealthily sneaking past guards or dispatching them with various weapons. Walk your way through the levels, hack various devices and terminals to reveal rooms. Get rid of guards and take control over hacked contraptions.

name: Doodle Jamboree
shortDescription: Play as a drawing and explore a world of paper scraps and sketches in a quirky, delightful doodle extravaganza!

name: Huedango
shortDescription: This game is intended to be simple and easy to play to pass time. Inspired by 90s hand-held consoles. In this game you select an egg to hatch and take care of one of the many creatures. If you keep your creature alive long enough it will eventually mature.

name: Lone Vessel
shortDescription: Prepare for the invasion! Explore the void, complete missions for credits, and collect items to arm yourself. Unlock new load-outs and face exotic enemies in the face of impending destruction!

name: Trivia Vault: Science & History Trivia
shortDescription: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Science & History and bring your thinking hat. Answer science and history category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Trivia Vault: Super Heroes Trivia
shortDescription: Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Super Heroes Trivia. Answer super hero trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value. Correct answers lock in the digit code for the vault, 10 correct answers cracks the vault and awards bonus cash.

name: WireNet
shortDescription: Minimalistic scroll-shooter with green-on-black pseudo-vector display. Rush through the isometric madness of WireNet to the NeuroCore!

name: Avoid The Monsters
shortDescription: A mix of puzzle and (roguelike) RPG where your aim is to upgrade yourself as much as possible while.. avoiding the monsters!

name: Juniper's Knot
shortDescription: Juniper's Knot is a short (~30 mins) kinetic novel about the meeting of a demon and a boy. A kinetic novel is a game that uses text, sound, and illustrations to tell a story.

name: Magic Pixel Picross
shortDescription: A game of numerical reasoning for practicing your logical thinking. A game of exploration and collection which may recall your childhood memories. A drawing game for you to paint your dreams freely.

name: Cat vs. Corgis
shortDescription: The castle is yours for the taking! Take control of Stretch the Cat as you jump and swing your way through corgis to collect crests! Cat vs. Corgis brings back classic on rail platforming in a more expansive and dynamic way.

name: Epic Cards Battle 2 (TCG)
shortDescription: 3D PVP Free Fantasy Strategy TCG Online Game！Experience the legendary battles. Hundreds of cards. 3 Card types: Creature, Spell, Trigger. Campaign and Arena and Ladder.

name: Infinity Assassin (VR)
shortDescription: Infinity Assassin is an stealth action VR game that you can play with HTC Vive on PC. You can play various missions as an assassin in the medieval fantasy world.

name: Baobabs Mausoleum Ep.2: 1313 Barnabas Dead End Drive
shortDescription: Baobabs Mausoleum™. The second episode mixing Monkey Island, Zelda Link´s Awakening DX with Twin Peaks and SpongeBob Squarepants. Welcome To the "open town" of Flamingo´s Creek: Population 64.

name: My Way VR
shortDescription: A 360 degree video player that enables you to watch videos from all over the world. It detects geographical location of the video, so you can choose the place you want to visit.

name: Occultus - Mediterranean Cabal
shortDescription: A thrilling quest at the heart of a powerful occult society. Dive into the heart of an unbelievable investigation set against stunning Italian backdrops. Make your way through the many hidden object scenes and solve the increasingly original puzzles. Your time is limited, so warm up those gray cells!

name: The Pilgrimage
shortDescription: One thousand years beyond the fall of Earth, one last drink may yet be your epitaph, in this post-post-apocalyptic hangover odyssey by a novelist you've never heard of! A parser-driven text adventure for the ages! Or at least a weekend! Fun for all the family (except the kids)!

name: unWorded
shortDescription: unWorded is an innovative Narrative Puzzle Game where everything is built from letters. Use your imagination to create objects by assembling letters together and discover the story of a writer hospitalized after a serious accident...

name: Mothlight
shortDescription: In a world corrupted by Eldritch abominations, Enzo must climb out of the hellish depths of the universe. From the Black Sea to the Planes of Neethan, it is your job to make your pilgrimage back to the Worlds above. In the black hell of this world, only Moths and demons await you.

name: Trials of the Thief-Taker
shortDescription: In London, 1729, before they had police, they had you: thief-takers, hunting criminals for cash! Fire a flintlock and sip gin in the age of powdered wigs. Will you grow rich catching smugglers and highwaymen, show mercy, or become a crime boss yourself?

name: Kitchen Simulator 2
shortDescription: Ever wanted to own your own restaurant? Well now you can with Kitchen Simulator 2. Customer satisfaction is your main aim, try and serve as many customers as you can, without leaving to many disappointed before the day ends.

name: BoidWatch
shortDescription: Feel a flock at your fingertips. An interactive flock simulation for VR.

name: Legendary Gary
shortDescription: Help Gary become a better person in his real life and a legend in his virtual life.

name: TOXICANT
shortDescription: TOXICANT offers a sinister twist on the survival horror genre, featuring randomized levels and roguelike elements.

name: JUMPER : SPEEDRUN
shortDescription: JUMPER : SPEEDRUN is a new Type of FPS Platformer crafted for the hardcore audience. Jump your way through insane levels, solve puzzles and try to finish fast.

name: Denki Gaka's Bombshell
shortDescription: A fast-paced minesweeper game in 3D with classic and arcade style game play!

name: Cassandra's Fabulous Foray
shortDescription: Help the magnificent and humble Third Baroness of New Haven, Cassandra Dawnstrider, survive in the backwater town of Malapais. Cassandra's Fabulous Foray is a western-themed fantasy visual novel with an integrated turn-based battle system.

name: Deathlands
shortDescription: Deathlands is a multiplayer turn-based survival game where you fight other players to remain the last man standing. If you only play one turn-based game, make it this one, because you'll love it!

name: Morph Girl
shortDescription: Morph Girl is a Japanese horror inspired FMV game about loss, depression and the supernatural.

name: Zombie Commando 3D
shortDescription: Variety lineup! Single finger manipulation five personality team; Use traps! Lure the enemy to trigger a fatal organ; Shocking effect! Full HD host level combat scene; Weapon synthesis! Super firepower to crush the enemy.

name: Cyberoque
shortDescription: The year is 2215. Terrible news arrives from the outer reaches of the Solar System. An alien civilization has launched a full-scale invasion, and a devastating war begins. Humanity is surrounded as enemy fleets overwhelm Earth's forces, pushing civilization to the brink of defeat.

name: Rise of One
shortDescription: Rise of One is a free-to-play third person online action game. Fight everyone you confront with or team up with others and fight with the other teams! Customize your favorite character with your victories. Join the endless loop in the Uounus Castle !

name: Romance with Chocolate - Hidden Object in Paris. HOPA
shortDescription: New Hidden Object romantic adventure in Paris! Guide an American girl and a Frenchman through beautiful historic Parisian locales, putting together pieces of the detective puzzle as your proceed. Trips to real attractions in the city of love: Basilique du Sacre-Coeur, Pont des Arts, and the Louvre Museum.

name: Tiny Force Deluxe
shortDescription: 30 characters to evolve, 5 worlds, only one champion

name: Nightork Adventures 2 - Legacy of Chaos
shortDescription: Nightork Adventures - Legacy of Chaos is an arcade shooter game. You fly with a spaceship through procedurally generated caves and fight against evil demons using magic colors. There is a campaign of 30 levels and 5 boss monsters. It also comes with a level editor, so you can create your own levels.

name: You Doesn't Exist
shortDescription: Set out on an adventure that challenges all the codes of the RPG genre, toying with its boundaries to create something unlike anything you've ever seen. In a world full of magic and adventure, a young boy starts his apprenticeship to become a knight... And it will change his life... and yours.

name: Her Majesty's Ship
shortDescription: All young naval officers dream of becoming Admiral, but few realise this can't be done without a loyal crew and keeping the vessel under your command afloat!

name: Oswald's Adventure
shortDescription: Follow Oswald in his short adventure to find his sister. Will he find her? Or is there a surprise waiting for him? There is only one way to find out! Good luck, adventurers.

name: YOBA
shortDescription: Collect all coins on the level to reach the next one. Avoid the dangers on your way. Just remember, you have only one chance, if you die, you will start again!

name: Infinity Fall
shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the starship Aphelion's vast and unforgiving underbelly. You are Doctor Rupert Grouch, hounded by his own creation, DAVE. Survive time-based, combat and stealth trials, all in zero gravity. An experience uniquely suited to and built for VR.

name: MineDrill Redux
shortDescription: Embark on a journey in the depths of the earth!

name: TETRUX: Online
shortDescription: The classic of arcades has returned, and better than ever! Solo or with friends, in TETRUX: Online you can play in a wide variety of gamemodes.

name: Taras Bulba and platforms of Hoolion
shortDescription: Old-school bloody 2d-shooter!

name: Nebula Nuker
shortDescription: Command a powerful craft in order to lead a fleet to victory! Purchase upgrades to improve your ship, collect powerups, and destroy increasingly powerful foes!

name: Paralysis
shortDescription: Paralysis is a multiplayer horror game. Which includes two unique game modes, Constant updates, and plenty of thrilling moments with friends.

name: Endless Reality
shortDescription: Endless Reality is a fantasy turn-based RPG. Help Sol and Luna free their homes from exile while travelling 12 different worlds in this 8+ hour story for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

name: CUBE-C: VR Game Collection
shortDescription: CUBE-C includes three VR mini-games. I try to design this game with a new concept to improve VR game experience. Hope you like it!

name: City of Ages: Picture Supportive Text MUD (server and client included)
shortDescription: Two windows applications install to any Windows Computer: Ansi compliant telnet text MUD Server and Client and their VB6 source code, heavily SQL coded with support and admin commands. I run my server on a 1000Mhz x 2 processor 7nm HP fanless laptop.

name: Steve's Pub - Soda on tap
shortDescription: It's all about service! Welcome to your new job as a bartender! Steve's Pub is an amazing bartender simulator game for virtual reality with not too realistic physics and a lot of fun!

name: Vulture
shortDescription: Attention Pilots! Your skills are needed to defend our world! Collect, build, design, and fight your way to victory!

name: Infection Rate
shortDescription: 3rd person Co-op Zombie Survival with multiplayer

name: Scuttlers
shortDescription: Race your friends in this Multiplayer Platformer. Play as the Runner and avoid all kinds of traps along the way, or play as the Leader and sabotage the race with many different abilities!

name: Next Stop: Zombie
shortDescription: People have become zombies after an alien-induced epidemic. Hiding in tunnels, they have completed an intergalactic portal of X-Points. Your mission is to collect the red x-gems in, stop the invasion and save humanity!

name: Microtransaction Simulator
shortDescription: Live your wildest dreams by splurging on insane amounts of cash you wouldn't have in real life. Play for random number generated loot that is a reflection of the meaningless nature of this game and everything surrounding it.

name: Ravager
shortDescription: Ravager is a 2D Open World Platformer with 12 unique characters to ravage your way across the land. Each character has different upgrade abilities to fight against the army of Crows and Trolls, who are trying to unleash the Nidhoggr into the world.

name: Scuffle Scoundrels
shortDescription: Scuffle Scoundrels is an oldschool arcade brawler for 2-to-4 rivals of all ages. With explosive powerups, deadly hazards, and imposing animal captains, it's sink or be sunk in this fast paced pirate romp!

name: Operation: Polarity Hook
shortDescription: We take FPS next level by combining combat specifically designed for VR with a revolutionary new movement system that does not rely on teleporting. Attach to walls and swing through the environment on a beam of energy code named “Polarity Hook” as you battle enemies and fight to save human kind!

name: Potemkin
shortDescription: Potemkin is a sandbox strategy game! Build any map you can imagine! Conquer your enemies! Play on massive maps with hundreds of players at once! Simulate any real or fictional war! Play against a very strong and flexible artificial intelligence. Share your maps simply by copy-pasting them onto Reddit!

name: The Museum of ThroughView
shortDescription: The Museum of ThroughView is a VR museum unlike anything else. This is the first time a virtual reality app showcases 2d to 3d conversions of famous paintings and old photographs. When looking at these paintings in VR, the paintings themselves can also be experienced in 3d.

name: Chessia
shortDescription: Are you a chess master? Or a chess enthusiast? Maybe you just play chess from time to time. Whoever you are, Chessia is here for you.

name: My RC Buggy! VR
shortDescription: My RC Buggy! VR is a RC car themed room-scaled VR game with an emphasis on part collection -- Mix and match parts and take on different race tracks!

name: Monsteria
shortDescription: Introducing a hysterical top-down shooter. Challenge your way through 7+ randomized levels, brimming with hordes of bizarre monsters. Upgrade your character through a selection of 30 unique powerups and minions, unlock special classes and much much more. Monsteria is chaotic fun for everyone.

name: LOGistICAL: USA - Florida
shortDescription: LOGistICAL: USA - Florida is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country with over 700 towns to Complete. LOGistICAL: USA - Florida game covers the US state of Florida including cities like Tallahassee, Orlando, Miami, Tamp, Jacksonville and the Keys.

name: Ruin City Gasolina
shortDescription: Eliminate the invasion of mechanical invaders and save what remains of the once great city.

name: Madu Maths
shortDescription: Based on a school curriculum, Madu Maths tests primary school kids in addition and subtraction as they help bees collect honey for their hive. A solo developer effort, Madu Maths boasts challenging gameplay coupled with an original score and organic graphics to make for a fulfilling experience.

name: Trinity Dungeon
shortDescription: A turn-based tactical rogue-like dungeon crawler. Fight the monsters, descend the Dungeon, and recover the Amulet!

name: ★ Fallalypse ★
shortDescription: A group of terrorists has arranged a nuclear hell and occupied Fort. You’ll have to build your own base in the new world burnt by the nuclear apocalypse.

name: Little Earth
shortDescription: An educational VR experience about the solar-system. Meet little animals and learn about the seasons.

name: Hunt 'n Sneak
shortDescription: Hunt ‘n Sneak is a manic online and local multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Think hide and seek with a twist – where only the hunter is visible, and the map is shrouded in darkness. As a hiding Pixie you emit a light to reveal yourself and your surroundings, but beware… you never know who is watching!

name: Alpha Mike Foxtrot VR - AMF VR
shortDescription: Get ready for the Next Generation in Virtual Reality First Person Shooters! Focusing on fast-paced gameplay and immersive environments, Alpha Mike Foxtrot VR (AMF VR) delivers the goods. Put on your headset and engage in all-out warfare with Bots, Friends (or Enemies) around the globe.

name: Without A Roof (W.A.R.)
shortDescription: Hunt, or be hunted - W.A.R. is a Survival Sandbox with many features. Play survival your way: Hunting Zombies, Crafting recipes, Procedural cities, Fortifying Buildings, Player Traps, Base building with multiplayer survival!

name: Memories
shortDescription: A third person double main character adventure-puzzle solving game.Figure out what they forgot and find a way out.

name: Hop Step Sing! Kimamani☆Summer vacation (HQ Edition)
shortDescription: Take a trip to the beach with the members of Hop Step Sing! In the 3rd song from our VR idol group, the viewer can be a part of the story; the conclusion all depends on who you were watching... Are you ready to join your three singing and dancing companions on their carefree summer vacation?

name: Gangsta Underground : The Poker
shortDescription: Gangsta Underground : The Poker is a gangsters heads up poker league which takes place in a dark backstreet. Win the game to take all bets from the loser and kill him with a gun.

name: Mystery Loss
shortDescription: Help! A little pretty сanary is lost! Join Grandmother-detective and her funny cat Leonardo in their investigation of the mysterious kidnapping. Play match-3 and HO levels, find pieces of evidence and track down the villain who dared to hurt innocent little bird!

name: DUELEUM
shortDescription: DUELEUM is an action game that fights enemies by making full use of magic and sword. Let's survive using various techniques.

name: Bee Aware! 2.0
shortDescription: Bee Aware! Not just another Bee Game! Help the bees get rid of all the bad, bad industrialists on every continent with the use of bags of biological pest control. Earn these bags by playing eight minigames. Games that will surely fit the needs of every casual gamer!

name: Slimebrawl
shortDescription: Slimebrawl is a 3D melee brawler game focused on quick action and fast rounds. Select your character, customize your appearance, choose your heirloom and get ready to brawl. Play in 2-4 player matches and collect the most slime at the end of the game to win.

name: SORE
shortDescription: Mystical puzzle quest game in a gloomy minimalism style will tell you a story of a person who's got himself into a camera, and from which there is no way out it seems. Experimental gameplay diluted with a pinch of a philosophy, that's what SORE is.

name: Deadly Traps
shortDescription: Battle yourself through dangerous traps in this fast-paced platformer.

name: FlatFatCat
shortDescription: Relax with cats! FlatFatCat is an amusing cat billiard game that creates addiction and is super cute. Just look at those Chihuahuas :) The ideal game for casual players, who seek for small challenges combined with a cute gameplay.

name: Call Me Skyfish
shortDescription: Call Me Skyfish is a game about a fish, a stick-figure hedgehog, and a long tongue.

name: Trivia Vault: Classic Rock Trivia
shortDescription: Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Classic Rock Trivia. Answer classic rock trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value. Correct answers lock in the digit code for the vault, 10 correct answers cracks the vault and awards bonus cash.

name: Tower Miners
shortDescription: Tower Miners is a local multiplayer game. Mixed out of strategy, tower defense and random party game genre.The goal is to beat your enemy by destroying his base. Also additional game modes are on the way

name: Territory Control 2
shortDescription: A 2D multiplayer sandbox game revolving around industry, innovation, factions, combat and emergent gameplay. Design factories, customize tools and weapons, fight or trade with other players or get viciously murdered by an angry badger.

name: Snake-A-Roid
shortDescription: Vector-like Arcade action!

name: Endless Combat
shortDescription: Endless Combat, is a coop game which is about fighting as characters with unique skills against zombies, the game also contains free for all mode

name: Rainbow Step
shortDescription: Teru Teru Bouzu, with the mysterious ability to clear the rain, journeys though the world in this 3D adventure game. Why is it always raining in this magical world? Solve the mystery by using the mysterious ability to clear the rain while riding rainbows to explore this magical world.

name: Twisted: Enhanced Edition
shortDescription: Twisted:EE is an action-platformer game combined with the best gameplay elements like time and object manipulation, clever enemies, traps and other challenges.

name: Korvae in space
shortDescription: Solve puzzles and shoot enemies in this fun little indie game.

name: In the Village of Grandfather: Summer,Sun,Heat.
shortDescription: Harvest. Take care of the territory. Prepare the perfect vegetable garden.

name: Pogo
shortDescription: Hold on tight it's time to bounce! Pogo is a goofy yet challenging 3D physics platformer that will make you laugh with joy and cry with frustration.

name: Drone Racer: Canyons
shortDescription: Challenge your reflexes and skills in this unique Drone Racing game! Race your friends in exciting 1vs1 Battles! Also finish career mode by completing challenging levels!

name: Evil Spirits
shortDescription: Tom and his friends went on vacation on a beautiful tropical island. Where they met a tribe of friendly Aborigines, the leader of the natives told a wonderful story that will change their whole life.

name: Light Fantastik
shortDescription: Light is fantastic isn't it? but what if you can jump higher in the dark with inverted controls.

name: Klondike Solitaire Kings
shortDescription: Famous Card game also known as Klondike. We kept the game true to the spirit of the classic Solitaire (also known as Klondike or Patience) Klondike Solitaire Kings features a beautiful custom designed card set in high resolution with 300+ levels, playing Patience on your desktop never looked this good!

name: HEIANKYO ALIEN / 平安京エイリアン
shortDescription: The Heiankyo Alien, developed on a personal computer and released in 1979 as an arcade game from Denki Onkyo, is now ported and arranged for Windows! Arranged version "Heiankyo Alien 3671" is a time-based game, overwhelmingly addictive and euphoric, with new features such as seven items buried in the field, various scoring...

name: The Sunset 2096
shortDescription: Mankind invented Them - to simplify your life. Mechanoids to perform all of our mundane activities which finally completely replaced humans in the workspace. Creating the perfect workers turned out to be a mistake.

name: Martha Madison: Simple Machines Volume 1
shortDescription: Transform your room into a science lab and go bonkers with Martha Madison: Simple Machines Volume 1. Players, as virtual scientists, work alone or collaboratively with a partner to use screws, inclined planes and wedges to solve physics puzzles and challenges.

name: Magibot
shortDescription: Magibot combines the principles of a platform game and those of a strategy game. Wisely place the action blocks upstream before taking control of your character.

name: Pirate Jump 2
shortDescription: Pirate Jump 2 is a classic runner game and includes 3 gameplay modes for the entire family to enjoy. See you in Davie Jones' Locker!

name: Skeleton Sprint
shortDescription: Use interesting puzzle mechanics like the burrow power-up on challenging puzzles that increase in difficulty and complexity as you play through the game.

name: TO4: Tactical Operations
shortDescription: Tactical Operations is a round based fast-action first-person shooter with classic controls. Built using the Unreal Engine 4 – Welcome to TO4!

name: Fates Call: A New Beginning
shortDescription: Fates Call: A New Beginning ! Embark in an epic VR Fantasy RPG You are Talos, a hero that has been awaken by ancient ghosts save the world once again. Evil forces are plotting against peace, you need to stop them before it's too late. Explore the world of Fates Call today !

name: Parkour
shortDescription: Parkour is a runner game with tons of challenges. Try to run as far as possible.

name: Firebird - The Unfinished
shortDescription: Behold, the new episode of the award-winning FIREBIRD SERIES for virtual reality ! The Unfinished is a magical musical experience in virtual reality, with music from the Toronto Symphony Orchestra and beautiful ballet performances.

name: Space Fighter
shortDescription: A mini-game designed for split screen experiences with up to 8 players. Pilot your spaceship through an anti-gravity suspended asteroid field to destroy enemy targets. Summon wingmen to coordinate your team, unlock upgrades to increase your spaceship’s efficiency, all in objective or deathmatch modes.

name: Wingless
shortDescription: It’s a snowball crafting, penguin mashing, dynamite throwing fun! Fend off waves of flightless birds in the name of gaining the ultimate skill - flight. Who deserves it more? Humans or wingless animals?

name: Maggie's Movies - Camera, Action!
shortDescription: Help me follow my dream and become a movie director! 🎥 🎬

name: KryptCrawler
shortDescription: KryptCrawler brings classic first person, grid based Dungeon Crawler gameplay to your PC and VR. Descend into the unknown and explore the perilous depth of the sinister tombs and crypts you are thrown into, armed with nothing but a map and your wits.

name: Death Rings of Jupiter
shortDescription: Death Rings of Jupiter is a 2d retro bullet hell shooter, set in the dense asteroid fields that make up the rings of Jupiter. It features original gameplay that mixes classic gravity games and platformers. Hidden somewhere in the rings of Jupiter, there is treasure, and it's guarded by an infestation of alien monsters.

name: RoadRunner VR
shortDescription: Run, dash and dodge your way through a choatic road!

name: Kaet Must Die!
shortDescription: This is the hardest, most challenging, horror puzzle game you will ever play. 30+ hours of sanity-testing puzzles over the course of 10 horror filled levels. You are Kaetheran, an extremely powerful psionicist with a flair for cyberpunk style. You have awoken in a dank sewer without your mind powers.

name: Ganbatte
shortDescription: Ganbatte is a competitive social multiplayer arcade game for VR, about cats, in space, eating sushi. Try to eat as much valuable sushi as you can and reach the highest score.

name: Triton Wing
shortDescription: Triton Wing is a top-down, open-world space shooter full of fast action.

name: RetroGunX VR
shortDescription: Miss playing those 8-bit, button-bashing, classic arcade-style cabinet and cartridge games from the 70s and 80s? Ever wanted to experience the intense action from the point of view of the hero within the game? Now you can, in VIRTUAL REALITY.

name: FPV Drone Simulator
shortDescription: This FPV Drone Simulator is especially designed for practicing your drone flying skills! Fly in different environments. Choose 'abandoned factory', 'free ride' or 'fantasy forest'.

name: Andromeda Wing
shortDescription: An action-packed retro arcade shoot 'em up featuring organic and bio-mechanical alien life, including ammonites, centipedes and spiders!

name: The Mines of Morseph
shortDescription: You are Darsius, a peaceful man who was sold into slavery to the Mines of Morseph. This changed when an evil invaded the mines and killed everyone... except you. You must journey through the mines of evil to find the mine key which will lead out of the mines of death...and to your freedom.

name: Watch Out
shortDescription: Watch out is intended to be an "I got to kill 5-10 minutes somehow"-game. It is an arcade racing game where your only objective is to get as high a score as possible on a random generated map.

name: Machine Crisis (陨星危机)
shortDescription: Machine Crisis is a sci-fi VR shooter, player fight gigantic bio-mechs with guts and wits

name: MSI Electric City: Core Assault
shortDescription: Rediscover MSI Electric City as you pilot a fighter ship with the mission to defend the city. Maneuver and blast away the enemy swarm in this VR bullet hell arcade shoot ’em up.

name: Fortune's Tavern - Remastered
shortDescription: Every great RPG has its tavern: where heroes meet, rumours are told, quests are undertaken, and beer is supped by the gallon… but could you manage such a place? Jump into the role of a fantasy-world tavern keeper and renovate the infamous Fortune’s Tavern, amongst the backdrop of a world on the brink of war.

name: Cat's Lover
shortDescription: The adventure of an unknown man in an unknown field for your fun.

name: Robin of Loxley the Legend of Sherwood
shortDescription: it looks like old school arcade game, with modern graphics. There is a lot of emphasis on sneaking mechanism, and a lot of things around it, making noise, distraction, and others. This is definitely a plus, because it’s adding a “think quickly” element, to arcade mechanism of collecting loot.

name: ArchRobo - Robotic Annihilation
shortDescription: This is ArchRobo, a top-down shooter. Featuring incredible visuals, 28 intense levels ranging from easy to incredibly challenging, with 5 large Bosses, dozens of enemies, and a plethora of creative weapons such as the Laser Sword, and Juggernaut power-up.

name: Virtual Robots - Robot programming simulator
shortDescription: Virtual Robots is a robot programming simulator. The objective of this game is to write code for your robots. Yes, WRITE.

name: Pixel Puzzle Picross
shortDescription: Pixel Puzzle is a challenging and fun picross logic game with 182 original puzzles and two modes of play.

name: Tales of Wedding Rings VR
shortDescription: Tales of Wedding Rings VR is a unique and brand new manga experience for VR, brought to you by Square Enix.

name: Community Garden
shortDescription: A VR city powered Improbable's SpatialOS.

name: DEFECTIVE
shortDescription: You must save the world, whatever the cost...

name: Two Escapes
shortDescription: 1 Player, 2 Hands, 2 Analog Sticks, 2 Characters! Two Escapes is a single player game that controls two characters at the same time to find exits and place both of them. You need to move both hands independently to achieve your goal.

name: Beetlejuice: Bad as Can
shortDescription: Play as Beetlejuice, the greatest Wack Packer of all time, in this hilariously wacky adventure.

name: Invictus: In the Shadow of Olympus
shortDescription: Caught in a bitter feud between spiteful gods, you fight for more than your life in this strategy RPG. Enlist Hercules, Achilles, Electra and the mightiest of heroes in your struggle for an eternal seat atop Olympus. Create your own war host from over 30 distinct units.

name: Don't Explode

name: Sorcery Jokers All Ages Version

name: All Cows In
shortDescription: Push the cows in the stable and become Millionaire!

name: Pixel Killers - The Showdown
shortDescription: It's Friday night, invite your friends over, gather around a screen, fight each other over a suitcase full of money in "Deal gone bad, hold the cash", or just have a good old deathmatch in a game of "Waste 'em". Shared-screen local multiplayer for 2 to 4 players.

name: VRpatients
shortDescription: Step into VR/MR as a nurse or paramedic and experience safe, fun, and realistic healthcare scenarios—no prior experience needed!

name: Bang Bang Fruit 2
shortDescription: Just make a cake.

name: MORDER
shortDescription: MORDER is a stealth-shooter game where you play either as a hired killer or a security agent. Be quick and sneaky, or deliver chaos and destroy the opposition, or maybe you will defend the innocent with your life. It's your choice.

name: Protoball
shortDescription: Protoball is a Movement Arena Sports Shooter, a blend of basketball and soccer crossed with high tech futuristic style. Players athletically jump, slide, run, grind and dash around the arena trying to pass the Protoball through the opponents goal. This is the game you've been waiting for.

name: Star Wars: Imperial Assault - Legends of the Alliance
shortDescription: Legends of the Alliance is a companion app for the Star Wars: Imperial Assault board game, a scenario-based game of tactical combat. When you play with Legends of the Alliance, the app assumes the role of the Imperials, while you and your friends form a team of Rebel heroes fighting to bring down the Galactic Empire.

name: LongStory
shortDescription: In LongStory you can be and date who you choose. Play as the gender of your choice and date the cutie you like best! LongStory is is based on real stories - things that have happened, if not to us, to people we know and love. We hope it is funny, sad, perplexing and wonderful… Just like life.

name: Robots.io
shortDescription: Robots.io is a classic top-down MMO shooter. Choose the best weapons, improve your robot! Dominate! Fight with your friends anywhere, show them who is the king of the arena! Join the battle in the online game Robots.io! A variety of ammunition - all for your enjoyment!

name: Gunhouse
shortDescription: Load your guns! Rain death from above! Protect your valuable orphans! Defeat giant, improbable bosses! Gunhouse is part puzzle, part active tower defense, as you make big combos to launch a hail of bullets and special attacks at the enemies who want to consume your delicious orphan friends!

name: Bitcoin Collector
shortDescription: Bitcoin collector - a colorful game in which you have to dodge the traps and collect bitcoins, changing gravity at your discretion

name: The Chronicles of Nyanya
shortDescription: A sweet jRPG-style game about cats, brutal massacres, cuteness, racism and social issues, friendship, sinister thoughts, hilarity and Nazi furniture. It’s an epic attempt to blow your mind with adult themes hidden behind bright cartoon graphics.

name: Lumberjack VR
shortDescription: Experience the thrilling life of a Lumberjack in virtual reality with Lumberjack VR, an arcade action game for the HTC Vive. Fight your way through waves of logs, lumber and bombs with nothing but an axe in your hand.

name: Captain 13 Beyond the Hero
shortDescription: Captain 13 - Beyond the Hero is an endless arcade shooter set in multiple galaxies of the universe. You are Captain 13, the sole survivor of a voyager fleet sent with the mission of clearing asteroid clusters.

name: Water Pipeline
shortDescription: Water Pipeline is a strategic puzzle game. Objective of this game is simple, rotate the different pieces of pipe in order to get water and save the life. There is no time limit but you have limited moves for each round and you have to complete the pipeline before running out of moves.

name: Space Survivors I: The Reckoning
shortDescription: Hello Survivors, this is little zombie shooter game. With big plans :)

name: Durak!
shortDescription: Durak is a classical Russian card game. While it requires strategical thinking, cheating is also a viable strategy as long as you don't get caught. In the same spirit pay attention to your opponents or else you might get tricked and be left as the Durak! The game is best enjoyed with 1 to 5 friends.

name: Maze Trials
shortDescription: Master an endless descent into massive, procedurally generated mazes. Use markers to find your way, collect coins, and race the clock to find the portal. Each exit only leads to a new labyrinth. It's a pure test of navigation and endurance—how deep can you go?

name: Inexplicable Geeks: Dawn of Just Us
shortDescription: Enter a world of ridiculously underpowered superheroes as you navigate a comic and pop culture convention celebrating their history.

name: AMPLITUDE: A Visual Novel
shortDescription: Amplitude is a story-centric visual novel. You play as either Adam or Eve, a murder victim who made a dubious deal to seek revenge. With the help of your new vessel, Katy or Jon, will you uncover the mystery or will you take more than you bargained for?

name: TRYON
shortDescription: A mixture of a minesweeper and "remember the pictures". Remember as much information as possible, or act at random. Reach the finish line as quickly as possible in a variety of puzzles. And you can also make your own levels in the editor.

name: Grimrush
shortDescription: Grimrush is a top down action game in which you must face off a gauntlet of seven brutal boss fights. Utilize three characters and a large selection of active and passive abilities. Balance offense and defense to take down the bosses and maximize your score!

name: The Walking Vegetables
shortDescription: It’s the 1980’s and an evil alien race has invaded Earth, turning all vegetables into crawling, bawling, mauling abominations. You are about to join Department Radical, the grooviest police force on Earth. Are you a rad enough dude (or dame) to smite these ravenous creatures?

name: Trident's Wake
shortDescription: Trident's Wake is an intense co-operative twin-stick shooter in an unforgiving sci-fi setting. Join up to three other players to take back humanity's last hope - the colony ship code-named Trident – from an unknown race of alien invaders!

name: Scarlett's Dungeon
shortDescription: Scarlett's Dungeon is a retro-inspired action RPG dungeon crawler with roguelite elements. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fight monsters, and collect loot in beautifully crafted pixel art reminiscent of the Game Boy Advance era. Test your skills as you dive deep into ever-changing challenges!

name: Project Ara - Crucible
shortDescription: Project Ara - Crucible is a bullet hell type shoot’em’up featuring procedural content generation in addition to light RPG elements. Help Lethe Zelmiya, the forgetful wizard on her epic quest to graduate from the Myrellian Academy of Magic.

name: Bottom of the 9th
shortDescription: Play the most exciting moment of baseball in this fast-paced dice and card game!

name: HAWKEN REBORN
shortDescription: Return to the world of high-octane mech combat in Hawken Reborn. Construct your ultimate war machine and shoot your way through hordes of enemies to uncover the mysteries of Ilall in this brand-new Free-to-Play PVE mech game.

name: Apocalypse: Legacy Edition
shortDescription: Apocalypse: Legacy Edition is a fast-paced single player shooter, updated to the last update (1.7), adding fixes, improvements and additional features. Including all the content that inspired the remaster, Apocalypse: 2.0 Edition! Available on Windows.

name: FEMINAZI: 3000
shortDescription: Race your oppression away! Kill all men in the race of your life - the race for tolerance and equality.

name: Trivia Vault: Super Heroes Trivia 2
shortDescription: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Super Heroes Trivia 2 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new super heroes category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Marshmallow Melee
shortDescription: Marshmallow Melee is VR rogue-lite dungeon crawler with toy-sized warriors. Rally your troops and fight your way to the top of an ever-shuffling tower to defeat Steve, The Evil Wizard.

name: Foundation of Nightmares
shortDescription: After disaster strikes, you are left debilitated in the village of Quader. There, under the care of a warrior, magician, and healer, you manage to slowly recuperate. Meanwhile, yet another new enemy lurks in the shadows, and old acquaintances from Lorden make their own appearances.

name: InGame.exe
shortDescription: It's year 2079. One of the best policemans have been fired and a strange floppy disk falls into his hands. When he tried to run it on his PC, he found himself in the digital world. In this world exists a virus, that intends to destroy everything around. Only the protagonist can stop the virus and get back home.

name: Boom Box Blue!
shortDescription: Boom Box Blue is a frenzied skill based physics game. This is what you get if you merge Tetris with physics and throw some bombs into the mix!

name: Cross Set Infinity
shortDescription: Sudoku-like novel number puzzle game with beautiful musics.

name: Waste Cleaner
shortDescription: Waste, what could be worse, but someone has to solve this problem? Use the liquid to flush out the debris, detect invisible obstacles, build up protrusions and get to inaccessible places. Find other possibilities for using fluid in a first-person logical game with fluid simulation.

name: Suicide Adventures
shortDescription: Lost in the abyssal depths of limbo, you are a tortured soul who is trapped between life and death, stuck in a dungeon whose puzzles will test you as you strive to go into the afterlife.

name: The Cursed Tower
shortDescription: "The Cursed Tower" is a story-driven platformer game where you are a dutiful postal worker. Armed with only a letter opener and graceful jumping skills, you must embark on a quest and fulfill your duty. Along the way, you will encounter many dangers and uncover a dark secret. Do you have what it takes?

name: Galactic Shipwright
shortDescription: Build the best or the funniest ships to transfer passengers, destroy enemies or navigate minefields. Beat every level and compete with your friends on the game's leaderboard, and share your best creations on the workshop.

name: Aya's Journey
shortDescription: Guide Aya through a perilous journey in this haunting 2D sidescroller puzzle game. Overcome deadly obstacles, face inner demons, and unravel the secrets of her dark world. Will you help her escape the shadows?

name: World War Party: Game Of Trump
shortDescription: World War Party: Game of Trump is a deathmatch battle played by two teams of 4 players each (humans or bots). But the teams are not alone on the battlefield: PRESIDENT TRUMP drives around in his mighty ‘murican tank shooting lasers and talking nonsense.

name: Onager!
shortDescription: Do you like to destroy huts and castles ? Do you like to solve puzzles too ? Then this game is for you! Onager! is a physics based game filled with challenging puzzles in fully destructible environment, the goal is to destroy all blue monsters and their lairs using as few shots as possible to gain maximum score, but monsters can be...

name: Tiny Bubbles
shortDescription: Play with squishy clusters of soap bubbles in this mesmerizing physics puzzle game. Winner of over a dozen indie gaming awards!

name: Picture Builder
shortDescription: This is an artistic innovative puzzle. Build pixel pictures from blocks by stacking them on top of each other with partial overlap. (But for those who like to just relax, there are also modes of playing the classic mosaic.)

name: Wizard Hunter 2348
shortDescription: A high speed ambush tactics shooter, it's you (and maybe a friend) as foxes or wizards against an army of bumbling spellcasters and their demon reinforcements. Sneakily nip wizards in the ankles on foot, or get the jump on a whole room of them in a tiny machinegun-wielding tank.

name: Burgle Bros.
shortDescription: Burgle Bros. blends high-tension teamwork, stealth and brain-twisting puzzles.

name: Where They Cremate The Roadkill
shortDescription: Death is a dream

name: BACK TO THE EGG! Tower Defense
shortDescription: Classical tower defense game mixed with rpg elements - Filled with things to do and places to explore.

name: Ballz: Farm
shortDescription: Arkanoid game with farm style!

name: The Donnerwald Experiment
shortDescription: A mature dreampunk RPG with German folklore, demons galore, interactive combat mechanics and more!

name: Ancient Future
shortDescription: Ancient Future is a fast paced multiplayer brawler set in a pixelated cyberpunk dystopia. Choose from a huge set of weapons, items, and characters to make your perfect loadout, and fight your friends or play online!

name: Astroe
shortDescription: Multiplayer player 2D space battle. Collect gold, team up and take over the other team's satellites.

name: Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)
shortDescription: "Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)" is a multiplayer online Collectible Card Game(CCG) which is based on Chinese traditional myths. Its rules and numerical value have been honed for ten years. Now the game is available for Windows, Android and iOS, on each of which can you share the data.

name: SpaceWalker
shortDescription: You are about to be part of the SpaceWalker team. Let’s explore the the multiple dimensions yet to be known, obtain the knowledge and power of the cosmos and save the universe!In Early Access, Solar System Explorer, you will steer a spacecraft to visit planets in the solar system,.

name: Echo Grotto
shortDescription: Echo Grotto is a virtual reality experience that lets you explore unique and intricate cave systems using a range of caving gear and tools!

name: Empress of Gold
shortDescription: 1336, Feudal Japan. The player takes on the role of a ninja, out for vengeance against a corrupt Nobel. Maybe the Empress of Gold can help restore balance, unless she's already captured.

name: The Trace
shortDescription: Matthew is a less successful private detective, trying to make his career take off. One day, he took a child kidnapping case. However, as he continues to investigate, but found that a terrible fact is gradually surfaced, and will be able to expose a group of ongoing appalling experiments. But is this the whole picture of things?

name: DreamPuzzle
shortDescription: VR jigsaw Game. Step into the enchanting world of Dream Puzzle, where your creativity and puzzle-solving skills bring 3D objects to life! In this immersive VR experience, you'll encounter floating puzzle pieces drifting through the air, waiting for you to assemble them into stunning 3D forms.

name: The Unseen
shortDescription: The Unseen is a multiplayer thriller FPS in a one VS many format. Terminate The Unseen with modern day weapons or hunt the S.W.A.T. from the shadows.

name: Parking Cop Simulator
shortDescription: Take on the role of a Parking Enforcement Officer and show your knowledge of parking regulations and laws as you hand out fines to parking violators!

name: Celtabula
shortDescription: Celtabula is a Celtic-style puzzle game with imitation board game, where each level has many solutions. Think: if you can not go through the level for a long time, maybe you should try a different approach?

name: Haul Asteroid
shortDescription: Catch Asteroid - Haul Asteroid - Grind Asteroid. A simple, minimal game that is difficult to master. Chaotic movements from the double pendulum + varied weights of asteroids require intuition and focus. My first published game + story by my son. Hard but addictive. Two great songs!

name: Gravity Light
shortDescription: A bizzarre platformer about a square in the space.

name: Devil in the Pines
shortDescription: An Appalachian man makes a desperate final move to save his sick daughter's life. But after unknowingly stepping onto cursed land, he now also finds himself in a fight to save his own.

name: CaveDuel
shortDescription: Design your cave around your strategy. Raid caves and steal gold.

name: Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia
shortDescription: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new mixed trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 2
shortDescription: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 2 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new mixed trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon
shortDescription: LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state with over 300 towns to Complete. LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon game covers the US state of Oregon including cities like Portland, Eugene and Salem.

name: LOGistICAL: Norway
shortDescription: LOGistICAL: Norway is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country with over 600 towns to Complete.

name: LOGistICAL: Chile
shortDescription: LOGistICAL: Chile is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country with over 100 towns to Complete.

name: Cyborg Arena
shortDescription: In a desert post-apocalyptic world ruled by cyborgs, you are the last soldier alive. Drive across defense lines and reach the evacuation point ! Listen to radio communications ! Also featuring an arena mode.

name: The Man in the Cape: Special Edition
shortDescription: In retaliation for using his roof as a city lookout point, The Man in the Cape is captured and left for dead in Mr. Granderson's superhero elimination dungeon. To escape, the determined Capeman must blast his way past Granderson's horde of malcontents.

name: SOMOS
shortDescription: SOMOS is an action-arcade game with minimalist visuals, where movement is key to solving procedurally generated, living puzzles

name: The Seven Stages
shortDescription: Inspired by William Shakespeare's poem All The World's A Stage comes the VR game: The Seven Stages. The player must escape each "room" that represents a stage of their life. They can escape the room by solving various puzzles of increasing difficulty.

name: Megatronic Void
shortDescription: The legendary 80s. in Megatronic Void you are dressed in a scientist, the earth has been devastated by a nuclear explosion, your job is to conquer and explore Megatron, recover alien artifacts to free Megatron zones.

name: Close Your Eyes
shortDescription: An anthology of 7 horror tales within a connected universe. Join a murderous marshmallow bound by their past down an atmospheric descent, brought into question by an odd game show host. Follow a Witch trying to seduce her love with sweet things. Plus 5 other surprisingly twisted yet emotional tales.

name: Devader
shortDescription: Devader is an intense 90's-style twin-stick shooter, complete with crazy old-school bosses, powerful strategic abilities and multiple endings. Upgrade your robot with nukes, shields, turrets and more to exterminate the relentless invaders.

name: 战术狂想1(Chimera of Tactics 1)
shortDescription: Gameplay: detection, bombard, head-on attack, launch missiles, intercepting the missile, boarding, seizing enemy ships, skills of roles(such as make enemy missiles U-turn), offensive warfare, defensive warfare, breakout warfare ... ...

name: Chupacabra
shortDescription: Experience the unforgiving jungle environment and gameplay as you try to hunt one of the most mysterious creatures ever roaming the earth: Chupacabra!

name: PaperCat
shortDescription: PaperCat is a game about Slick the cat and Frank his human. It's a 2D puzzle platform game.

name: BLOCKPOST LEGACY
shortDescription: Procedural cubic 3D-shooter in the best traditions of the genre. The game is a rich cocktail consisting of the most popular and functional gaming solutions. Customization of characters, opening cases and improving the existing arsenal — all this is available in the game now!

name: Aw Nutz
shortDescription: Have you ever wanted to be a nut? How about a pistachio? Well, now you can! Choose from a wide variety of legumes and assorted nuts as you try flinging into the mouths of your enemies. Play with friends or with complete strangers as 1 human with nut allergies vs. 5 nuts!

name: Robosoul
shortDescription: Robosoul is a dynamic and innovative action-adventure game that combines old-school FPS action, two worlds to explore, strategic gameplay elements and stealth mechanic.

name: Anahita
shortDescription: Anahita's doll has been her best friend as long as she can remember. One morning she awoke to find some stranger stolen her doll! She has to find the thief and retrieve her beloved doll. Help Anahita as she traverses multiple traps and puzzles in this fully hand drawn and animated adventure game.

name: Chess
shortDescription: The classic strategy game with gorgeous graphics, online gaming and intuitive interface.

name: The Base
shortDescription: PC only tower defence inspired by oldschool RTS games. Build up your defence in realtime under the constant pressure of creeps.

name: Prison Chainball Massacre
shortDescription: Prison Chainball Massacre is a fast paced, mindless arcade brawler set in a prison arena where your only weapon is the Chainball.

name: Keatz: The Lonely Bird
shortDescription: Keatz -The Lonely Bird is a 2D Old School action platformer which is based on the story of the lonely bird, abandoned by the society. The Government of Heavens, a country of birds, suddenly and unexpectedly decide to eliminate all the flightless birds from the country by any means necessary.

name: Damascus Gear Operation Osaka HD Edition
shortDescription: Mecha Hack'n'Slash "Damascus Gear: Operation Osaka HD Edition", is now out on Steam with full HD graphics! Pilot your humanoid mecha "GEAR", alongside with your dependable operator! Will you be able to pay off your debts before the due date?

name: Attack Of Insects
shortDescription: Love insects? And insects that are two or even ten times more than you? If you love, then - it's fine, you will definitely be pleased with our insects. And if you do not love, then you will be happy, because you have to shoot on insects and watch them fly apart!

name: March to Glory
shortDescription: March to Glory is a turn-based strategy game that takes you through the Napoleonic wars with a new strategic and challenging gameplay, full of interesting mechanics combined with thrilling combat.

name: JumpFist
shortDescription: A fast paced platformer that will test even the most seasoned of gamers! Jump, punch and slide your way through mayhem and reclaim your stolen games!

name: Crucible Trails : Initial Rupture
shortDescription: A 3rd Person Action Adventure Game with a Medieval backdrop. Player is given an opportunity to follow the trails of Noah the protagonist.

name: Food Mahjong
shortDescription: Food Mahjong is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

name: Mobile Dungeon
shortDescription: From the universe of Shakes & Fidget, the NEW Team Battle RPG dungeon crawler!

name: Ragna Maya
shortDescription: Play as the Dullahan in this retro-modern multi-turn based JRPG, as he makes his way deeper into the Labyrinth of Razuri on a quest to take back his head from the Witch who killed him.

name: DrumSim
shortDescription: Simple drumkit simulator.

name: War to the Core
shortDescription: War to the Core is a tactical multiplayer Moba/RTS hybrid where you control a mothership and battle on a team against other teams for total world domination. Use all the available resources, from interceptors, you can control while alive or dead to different upgradable ship components to win!

name: Tactics 2: War
shortDescription: Tactics 2: War.This is a real-time strategy, combined with a shooter of an airplane, a tank, a rocket launcher, a ship and a submarine. Modern warfare.

name: Jigsaw Puzzles
shortDescription: Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for kids aged 2-12 and parents to have fun together. It‘s a clever and colorful learning experience. Puzzles are a challenging young minds, teaching and preparing them early in life some very important life skills.

name: Hoo-Boy
shortDescription: HOO-BOY! A platformer game about the adventures of a candy boy hailing from Candy-Land.

name: Analemma
shortDescription: Discover a new, mysterious and unusual world. Pass the tests, open the secrets of the main character and slightly open the veil of secrecy, as well as find the answer to the question - "Who am I? And why am I here? ".

name: Tank Warz!
shortDescription: Tank Warz! is an arcade shooter that will keep you entertained with fast paced tank destruction, power-ups, traps, secrets, and an energetic rock soundtrack. You'll enjoy hours of arcade fun!

name: A Boy and His Beard
shortDescription: A Boy and His Beard is a fast-paced beard fighting experience that lets you steal the beards of your enemies! Survive waves of bearded foes as you collect as many beards and achievements as possible!

name: TriElement
shortDescription: Fire, Ice and Lighting elements often cancel each other out. However, in TriElement the enemy invasion is so dire that even the elements must work together to push them back. TriElement is a casual endless shooter against hordes of germs and viruses.

name: Code World
shortDescription: In Code World you control the robot that can walk around the world and send messages to devices. Every device reacts on those messages according to its code. You will have to read this code, understand what messages to send and write your own code.

name: Lava Rolling Kid
shortDescription: Lava Rolling Kid is an arcade adventure platformer inspired by classic retro games. Focusing on innovation, we have given the game a modern feel so that gamers can play time and time again!

name: Text Wormhole
shortDescription: Text Wormhole is a dodge game of bullet hell generated by the roguelike way dynamically based on the theme of letters, which adopts the minimalist design style. The unprecedented visual spectacle will give you an extraordinary game experience.

name: Bobbi_Cities
shortDescription: In 10 levels, players can use fireballs, snowballs and boulders to attack enemies in addition to building defensive towers, and can summon reinforcements for defense.The fireball can cause a lot of damage, and a snowball can slow down the enemy, and the boulder can destroy the enemy.

name: Infinite Gravity
shortDescription: This is a build sandbox game We have hundreds of elements for your choice We offer a variety of materials in building their ideal architectural works for you We will also open survival mode in the future

name: Shark Simulator
shortDescription: Shark Simulator is a WTF physics sandbox. Play as Ed the shark, and give those tourists a vacation they will remember!

name: Kamikaze Cube
shortDescription: Once a cube named Kamikaze decided to discover a dungeon but when he entered the den he realised that it wasn't a dungeon at all - it was the HOUSE OF DETENTION. Our hero, Kamikaze is a seasoned one but even for him these hell-like traps turned out to be a great challenge. Find the exit from this dungeon.

name: Pembrey
shortDescription: Two young film makers travel out deep into the Pembrey Forest in search for footage for their documentary. Record and document your findings and unravel the truth behind the famous "Pembrey Forest".

name: The Promethium Effect - The Idle Clicker MMO
shortDescription: Your job as head of the corporation is to take on the role of manager, pirate, and bounty hunter. All for the growth of the corporation. Protect your assets, steal from the weak, post bounties and pay others to do your dirty work to get ahead.

name: Battle Master
shortDescription: A world of Dwarves, Elves, Humans and Orcs. Mounted in the crowns of each race's king are four scattered shards of the Watcher's Tower Gem, which must be returned to its rightful place before the world degenerates into oblivion. Conquer all four races with the army you assemble and lead into battle.

name: Little Adventurer II
shortDescription: Third-person 3D casual games.which is suitable for people of all ages.Control your little adventurer to help NPC find his items.Knock down the little monster.Or you need to start again.

name: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator
shortDescription: You appeared on this beach by accident, but it took you 5 seconds to realize one thing: DO NOT let go of your pants.

name: Octopus Bar
shortDescription: Enter this hidden izakaya bar hidden deep in the magical forest, where the octopus serves you, fish float into the sky, and a frog enjoys your company while smoking his pipe. In this world the impossible is now possible and you are invited to discover the games and enjoy this whimsical scenery.

name: Defend Your Castle
shortDescription: Defend your Castle against the relentless army of crayon invaders! Those crafty barbarian hordes have amassed their forces once again to challenge your domain. Will you and your court rise to the challenge, or stand aside as they raze your Castle to the ground?

name: Social Club VR : Casino Nights
shortDescription: When you enter Social Club VR : Casino Nights you enter into a high-class Casino, where you can play your favorite casino table games, like Blackjack, Texas Hold'em Poker and Roulette. Play a private game with friends you know, or get to know people from around the world.

name: Slam Fighter II
shortDescription: In this rhythm/fighting game, The Philosopher’s Burn, the most legendary put down in history, is the prize as the world’s best trash talkers face off in the diss battle of the millennium!

name: Baby Hands
shortDescription: Hilarious retro parodies! Experience the world through the eyes, ears and chubby little hands of a baby! Crawl your way through a zany retro sandbox experience, filled with imagination and fun! Baby Hands is a funny, family friendly VR baby simulator!

name: The Armament Project
shortDescription: The Armament Project is a fast paced Science Fiction First Person Shooter.

name: Reverie
shortDescription: An ambient, very simple game* with pseudo-puzzle elements, something you can leave open on a second monitor while you work.

name: Reginald Does His Thang
shortDescription: Reginald Does His Thang is a platformer in which Reg gathers scattered pages for his grandfather's final recipe. In a surreal land where cannibalism, vomiting, and creeping kuru are commonplace, Reg chops, explodes, masticates and vomits to see what culinary masterpiece Grampinald's cooking up.

name: BEATris
shortDescription: BEATris is a puzzle-based rhythm game. Feel the rhythm as you bash the blocks with the power of music! Enjoy various levels with unique soundtracks. Make and share your own level on Steam Workshop.

name: Hordiaz
shortDescription: Hordiaz is a combination of survival, simulator and role-playing. Explore the magical lands of Solinia, surrounded by dangers, adventures, secrets and deities.

name: I Can See the Future
shortDescription: This is my job. Dying again and again. But I'm used to it. That's how I can see the future. What's waiting for me? Good question.

name: Dice 1000 online
shortDescription: This game is a simulator of a board game.

name: Steam Tactics
shortDescription: Welcome aboard your airship, captain! Engage in tactical combats, upgrade your ships and weapons, level up your pilots.

name: GOD STARFIGHTER
shortDescription: GOD STARFIGHTER is a fusion of a roguelite and puzzle game. We're the dark soul of space invaders genre. Extremely challenging combat that is logic-based, innovative guns, equipment and enemies, tough choices and light humour - we have it all.

name: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR
shortDescription: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR is a brand new simulation game, where you can explore the human body and fight against viruses and infections .The game begins on the emergency class, where a sick man lies, who waiting for a medicine of vital… You will be the medicine capsule which can redound the healing, and you enter into the human...

name: The Bears And The Bees
shortDescription: The Bears And The Bees is a debut adventure that follows the heroic exploits of Beesworth, a baby bee who hasn't got his wings yet. Bounce through a hand crafted world in which bears have kidnapped the queen bee, and everyone is relying on Beesworth to get her back!

name: A Dream For Aaron
shortDescription: A Dream For Aaron is a first person shooter with a huge replay value.

name: God of Failure
shortDescription: Defend your castle from the orcish chavs, lure them into your traps and destroy them.

name: Ingnomia
