name: Arrowpoint
shortDescription: Test your skill in this arrow shooting, leaderboard focused on-rails shooter. Set out on horseback, fire at challenging targets, and battle a giant, flying, cyborg whale! Can you reach the top of the leaderboard?

name: Daddy's gone a-hunting
shortDescription: Daddy's gone a-hunting is a retro 16 bit game with cute explosions, fx-sounds and represents a story of a lazy prehistoric dad.Who was kicked out from home by his wife. And need to find a food for his kids..

name: Battle High 2 A+
shortDescription: The fast-paced fighting action of the Battle High series comes to Steam! Face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced as 14 students (and 1 insidious faculty member) and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

name: Christmas Race
shortDescription: Help Santa pick up presents on the trail! The more gifts you collect, the higher your score!

name: Defend Your Buttress
shortDescription: Defend Your Buttress is a simple game. You defend your wall to your dying breath. Why? I don't know... Because the evil stick-man want to break your wall and kill you. For some reason.

name: Sleep Tight
shortDescription: Sleep Tight is an adrenaline pumping arcade-style, twin-stick shooter with base-building elements and wrapped in blankets of nostalgia. Construct your strongest pillow fort during the day to defend your bedroom from endless hordes of monsters each night.

name: Power Supplied
shortDescription: Power Supplied is a multiplayer puzzle game, a one-to-four player game where four characters are controlled, each with different methods of traversing levels. Constantly changing routes will mean passing over the same ground many times to try and reach your freedom.

name: Hades' Star
shortDescription: A unique space strategy game where thousands of players participate in one shared galaxy.

name: One Against The Galaxy
shortDescription: Fast-paced shmup for those times when you only have a couple of minutes to blow things up and try to reach the high score.

name: Lonely Astronaut
shortDescription: Pilot the corpse of a long-abandoned astronaut floating in a cosmic graveyard in this one-button arcade game. In the process, you might find out something about the human condition. But probably not.

name: VR Ping Pong Paradise
shortDescription: You can play table tennis in outer space!! You feel refreshed! You can choose 6 play zones in this game. Sky Arena , On the raft , Under the cherry trees , Street basketball court , Seaside golf course , Outer space. You can enjoy ping pong in an unreal world.

name: CHOP
shortDescription: CHOP is a 2D party game with tons of gore and fast-paced action. Swords will fly, bodies will be chopped, friendships will break !

name: Fantasy Quest Solitaire
shortDescription: At the very last moment the Fairy Land was saved from the dark shadows. But now absolute chaos is threatening its peaceful denizens. King Feodor asks the magic Fairies for help. Are you ready to face this challenge? Play your cards right and solve many challenging quests.

name: Puppet Kings
shortDescription: Puppet Kings is a modern take on the Breakout genre taking block-breaking to new levels of fun by introducing characters, boss rush as primary game mode and a roguelike twist.

name: RollerCoaster Legends
shortDescription: Transport yourself to the land of Greek mythology on a virtual reality RollerCoaster ride you'll never forget. Unlike any VR rollercoaster experience you have seen.

name: Good Morning
shortDescription: Good Morning is an open world sandbox game. Explore the world. Get a job. Grab a cup of coffee. Rob a bank. Rise to political power. Sell some drugs. Join a gang. Unleash hell fire upon the world. Or maybe go on an afternoon stroll through the park. The Choice is yours!

name: Curse of the Old Gods
shortDescription: A mystery adventure game set in a present-day Lovecraftian universe.

name: Born Tubi Wild
shortDescription: Control 4 different pigeons to track down unsuspecting pedestrians and present them with falling surprise from the skies.

name: Helix Brawl
shortDescription: Helix Brawl is a single-player beat em' up action game. Make your way enemy by enemy, beating up bosses and unlocking new powers as you go. Go all or nothing to finish each level, making your way from the underground lab to the CEO's penthouse, wrecking everyone in your wake!

name: Sky Road
shortDescription: Sky Road is a casual game for all ages. It does not take much effort. In a calm atmosphere, choose an emotion for yourself and take a ride along the celestial road, collecting coins. The further you pass the more reward.

name: Impossibox
shortDescription: In Impossibox work your way through 50, sometimes seemingly impossible, levels and show the world what you are made of! Collect the coins to clear the levels. Impossibox has everything a tough platformer needs to challenge your skill.

name: Talsaluq: Tower of Infinity
shortDescription: A maze-adventure game entailing multi-level trials to reach the peak of a 3,000 year-old tower.

name: Whirlpool
shortDescription: Whirlpool is about Roy, who finds himself suspiciously uncertain about a lot of things, including who he really is. And his adventure of finding out more about himself.

name: KARTOFELKA
shortDescription: Platform of medium complexity, where the main role is played by 'potato'.

name: Asylamba: Influence
shortDescription: Making your culture shine is often more effective than taking out weapons!

name: Kingdom Defense
shortDescription: In Kingdom Defense you have to be in the role of the commander of the defense of the kingdom. You will have to keep defense using three towers, soldiers, traps and a variety of improvements for them. For a successful level you need to hold out under the pressure of hostile troops, not allowing him to get to the territory of the kingdom.

name: In League
shortDescription: Tactical multiplayer shooter built from the ground up for VR. Team up with other players wielding a wide array of realistic guns, grenades and melee weapons in Hunt or Hostage mode. Winning takes strategy and teamwork as you fight through rich interactive environments.

name: Gym Empire - Idle Gym Tycoon Management
shortDescription: Starting from a simple storage closet build your Gym Empire to make it the best in the world. Will you build a Commercial Gym, a MMA Dojo or an Olympic Training Facility? The choice is yours.

name: Snail Trek - Chapter 2: A Snail Of Two Worlds
shortDescription: Relive 1980s nostalgia in this text parser driven graphic adventure game. You and your molluscan crew embark on an epic journey to find a new home world. In Chapter 2 - A Snail Of Two Worlds, you are stranded on an alien planet searching for food, water, and most of all... answers.

name: Traffic Cop
shortDescription: It's the 1950s in a city like no other. You're on duty as the local Traffic Cop smack dab in the middle of a busy intersection. Direct traffic, dodge flying food, & unlock bonus rounds to disintegrate aliens, and hunt birds!

name: OutBreak: The Escape
shortDescription: OutBreak: The Escape is a Fps Survival Horror game, You play as a Marshall as you try to save your family While trying to escape a viral outbreak that occurred overnight in your hometown. Can you save your family and escape the OutBreak?

name: Super Bugman Extreme Ultra
shortDescription: A unique 2D platformer with puzzle elements where you can jump, pick stuff up, place it down, throw onions, and use special abilities on enemies. Play through the Story Mode, have fun in Creative Mode, tackle the Procedural generated Chaos levels, and even design your own levels in the level editor.

name: Dark Maze
shortDescription: Your task is to get out of the maze. For this, you need to find the key!

name: Next Hero
shortDescription: 'Next Hero' is a Roguelike-shooting action RPG that explores dungeons, acquires weapons and equipment, and kills monsters. Find a girlfriend kidnapped by the dragon and rebuild the destroyed village to become a hero in the village!

name: Robot Warriors
shortDescription: Slash and shoot everyone in your way in this hack and slash game. Kill a lot of enemies and find a way to the exit to complete missions.

name: Trianga's Project: Battle Splash 2.0
shortDescription: Full-Physics Water FPS/TPS, Class-based Action-packed Arena Shooter, Run & Gun with Rocket Jump, Single/Coop/Multiplayers, Survive Procedural Waves of Enemies, Lots of Game Modes, Endless Challenges and Replayability, with an Anime Beautiful Cast, and More...!

name: Solar Wind
shortDescription: Blast your way through a galaxy of planets in this fast paced, side scrolling shoot 'em up. Fight in deep space, fly through asteroid belts, and battle across moons as you take on the alien menace.

name: THE BOX VR
shortDescription: The Box is a new arcade game of Virtual Reality that will test your reflexes, your coolness and your ability to strategy. An action game that challenges you to keep playing again and again.

name: Angelo Skate Away
shortDescription: Angelo Skate Away is a brand new game based on the successful TV show Angelo Rules!

name: Neon Seoul: Outrun
shortDescription: In a future where the AI we created have become our gods, a new breed of rebel has emerged - The OutRunners. Weaving through seas of automated vehicles, operating off the grid, these rebels risk their lives on hoverbikes built for insane speeds. Welcome to the future. Welcome to Neon Seoul.

name: Man of Honor
shortDescription: Man of Honor is a mafia themed top down shooter / character study where you control Emilio Gallo, an ex-mafioso, as he fights to get revenge on his former friends in the waning rust belt city of Ferrousburgh.

name: cityglitch
shortDescription: Fly across haunted cities, solve rooftop puzzles and light magical runes. Cityglitch is a shimmery pixel puzzler with simple movement and deep challenge.

name: M.A.X. 2: Mechanized Assault & Exploration
shortDescription: A sci-fi colony-building RTS where you choose between simultaneous turns or fully turn-based modes. With eight human clans and dozens of land, sea and air units to build.

name: 摩尼遊戯TOKOYO
shortDescription: Maniyugi TOKOYO is a Pixel-art shooting game inspired by Japanese Buddhist worldview. The player becomes a priest, goes on a journey round the Rokudo, aims at constant life while accumulating merit.

name: Archers
shortDescription: Hop into the world of archery and acrobatics. Play in modes of 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3. Create servers with your friends or play versus random players. Pick up different arrow types and use your abilities to eliminate your foes. Make precision longshots or get up close and personal with your enemies.

name: Alive Hunter
shortDescription: Alive Hunter is a Indie Third Person shooter game with a Open World full of content and cinematic narrative.

name: Raymond's Obstacle Course
shortDescription: Raymond's Obstacle Course is a multi-stage 3D, first-person platformer. Your goal is to reach the end of each stage by successfully navigating across all obstacles.

name: Christmas Stories: A Christmas Carol Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Everyone deserves a second chance – even the stingiest of them all.

name: Pure Metal: Feature 1
shortDescription: Old school shooter fun. Can you save Pure Metal from the clutches of evil? Kill the hoards of enemies and rain righteous fury on the bosses and save the planet!

name: DoubleTap
shortDescription: Stylish pistol action for the movie hero/dapper spy/assassin with a dark past that you don't want to talk about/cool person in all of us.

name: Broadway: 1849
shortDescription: Fight your way to box office glory, while fending off the gangs of New York! Will you spur a revolution or keep order in a fractious city?

name: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA
shortDescription: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA is not your average rhythm game where you just keep beat with the song -- it's a virtual reality music game where you can actually play the melody.Punch the melody into existence by hitting the lyrics and stars flying at you to the beat of the music on your own personal grand stage!

name: KOLOBOK
shortDescription: Go through the epic path of Kolobok, prove to yourself and everyone that he is alive and can think.

name: Vexius
shortDescription: Roll and dash through a grid-based 2.5D world while overcoming various obstacles and hazards. Feeling creative? Create your own levels with the editor and share them with the world!

name: Donjon Defense
shortDescription: Donjon Defense is a game in the genre of tower defense. In this case, defense of the castle, consisting of... only one tower. Build walls, hire different warriors, resist attacks. Build a real fortress, hardened in countless assaults.

name: Aimtastic
shortDescription: Training game for FPS games. Helps you become a better aimer. Includes a lot of different practice scenarios, which is great for warmup or taking your aim to the next level.

name: On Board
shortDescription: 1 player arcade boat game.

name: Ship Ahoy Open BETA
shortDescription: Frag as many other pirates vessels as possible until the time limit is reached.

name: CITY BALLS VR
shortDescription: THE jump'n'run experience for VR! Beat the time by completing all games on the rooftops as fast as possible.

name: Zombie Crisis: Last One Standing
shortDescription: Zombie Crisis: Last One Standing is a LAN(local area network) Battle Royale genre game.

name: Schwerpunkt
shortDescription: Schwerpunkt is a World War 2 military simulation game. Take control of hundreds of units over a large frontline, making daring manoeuvres to push your enemy back. Fight in one of the scenarios given or make your own in the map maker.

name: Crafting Tycoon
shortDescription: THE ROAD DESIGN-CRAFTING-TYCOON GAME !!

name: Samurai of Hyuga Book 3
shortDescription: Life isn’t getting any easier for our favorite ronin! The journey continues in the land of silk and steel, where fantasy and reality clash and tough choices await you on every page. Get ready to prove why you’re the toughest ronin around.

name: Doom Roller
shortDescription: Doom Roller is a fast paced physics arcade game. Guide the ball through the level avoiding obstacles and the dreaded Orbs of Doom! Collect all the gems within time to proceed to the next level. There's an evil twist though... every time you collect a gem your time decreases by five seconds!

name: Mapas do Horizonte - Um jogo para conhecer BH
shortDescription: Neste jogo infanto-juvenil gratuito que reúne quebra-cabeças em formatos diversos e jogos de encontrar objetos, o jogador conhece um pouco mais sobre a história da capital mineira ao passar por diversos desafios junto da professora Clara, da motorista Suely e da turma de alunos!

name: Fadeholm
shortDescription: Endless exploration and adventure awaits those fearless enough to enter. Survival is only the beginning! Fadeholm is a procedural generated virtual reality (VR) survival dungeon crawler designed in the same vein as old school Nethack and Rogue.

name: Oedipus Dating Sim
shortDescription: You shouldn't date your own mother... or should you? That is the dilemma Oedipus is facing in this Dating Sim. You can either change how the legend goes or end up facing the wrath of the fates. The choice is yours in this daring Dating Sim!

name: Endless Inside
shortDescription: Get ready to mix scares, puzzles, hidden secrets, exploration and survive modes around dusty and dark sites with three alternate endings into one disturbing night full of strange activity, creepy giggles under the floors and spooky songs coming from old objects arround a closed Arts University.

name: Life Game
shortDescription: Open World, first person life simulation

name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Monsters Overboard
shortDescription: Dracula, Mavis and their monster friends are marooned on the mysterious Lost Islands – and only you, in command of lovable little creatures, the Impa, can save them! Explore the islands, discover new Impa abilities, and rescue Frankenstein, Murray and Wayne from fearsome enemies. But hurry – the Drac-Pack’s lives are at stake!

name: Big Day
shortDescription: The Big Day has arrived. Blast your way through the apocalypse in this bloody pixel-art ARPG, riding through the ruins of the last days on Earth following a devastating zombie outbreak. Uncover the truth behind the crisis, find your missing daughter, and blow holes in every zombie who crosses your path!

name: Blitz Freak
shortDescription: Blitz Freak is an online multiplayer VR game optimized for e-Sports. Players can fly through the air with locomotion completely free of VR motion sickness, and knock out opponents with intuitive controls.

name: Limit of defense
shortDescription: Limit Of Defense combines the arcade game on the type "Tower Defense" military strategy. A simple and addictive time killer.

name: Dungeons Barrage
shortDescription: Control an Arcana Magus through the dungeon and try to survive the waves as long as you can! Dungeon's Barrage is a shoot’em up with a feeling of retro games with a fast-paced combat in a closed dungeon filled with enemies.

name: Shadowcrawl: The Dark Pilgrimage
shortDescription: Set in a dynamic living world driven by Dark Gods and Occult Forces. Shadowcrawl is a classic roguelike with updated design principles and an emphasis on strategy. Worship Demons, conquer Gods and make dark pacts with unspeakable horrors as you crawl deeper into the shadows...

name: Sector 452
shortDescription: Sector 452 is a futuristic low poly shooter that takes place in the year 2058, you are an astronaut who was on a standard search mission that went horribly wrong. Fight your way through various planets, meeting friends and foes while looking for a way back home.

name: Mahlone One
shortDescription: Malhone game fps coop

name: Flowing Lights
shortDescription: Flowing Lights is an Arcade Puzzle Shooter. Each fight is a puzzle. Attack and... Fail! ...Think back... try again! Got it? Improve with each try, there is always a smarter way to win!

name: The Grim Ending
shortDescription: The Grim Ending is a humerous classic Point and Click adventure game. Old school gameplay that comes with word commands, pixel art and a full talky storyline with moral decisions and several endings.

name: Elbub
shortDescription: You are a bubble, flying among other bubbles. Relax and go on a journey!

name: Australian trip
shortDescription: Take a bright and exciting adventure in Australia with dog Dingo. A fascinating and extraordinary puzzle game. Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Latvian, Portuguese, French, Chinese

name: Away
shortDescription: Away — is a short game telling about the hero's death experience, performed in a gloomy black and white style.

name: Raygun Gadabout
shortDescription: An exhilarating action-adventure game set in a vibrant retro-futuristic universe. Embark on daring interstellar journeys, uncovering new worlds, and battling formidable alien adversaries. Upgrade your ship and abilities as you explore the vastness of space to save the Galaxy from a hidden threat.

name: Disassembly Line
shortDescription: Remote control a robot into the evil robot factory to take on the artificial intelligence in combat. Upgrade your robot by collecting add-ons that give you awesome abilities. Play together with your friends to stand a chance!

name: Big NEON Tower VS Tiny Square
shortDescription: Ride the vaporwaves as you outrun nefarious neon nuisances in this 90s inspired precision platformer. No sprint, no double-jump, and no floaty controls! Just quick deaths and generous respawn points. Can you reach the top of the tower and rescue your Pineapple?

name: DMD Mars Mission
shortDescription: The Martian mining facility FK16 has been invaded by insects and mutated creatures and now the system reports that all human workers have been killed. It's up to you and your assistant Isabel to save the situation.

name: Internet Simulator
shortDescription: Web-browser simulator from beautiful locations

name: Kill the Superweapon
shortDescription: 3D Twin-Stick Action game where bosses can roam from room to room in pursuit of the player. Samantha Kill is on a mission to take down Abaddon Inc. and their Bio-Mechanical Supersoldiers.

name: RC Fun City
shortDescription: RC Fun City is a singleplayer simulation game about radio controlled vehicles.

name: The Plague
shortDescription: Prepare to fight alone against a horde of zombies from the graveyard to the streets in this suspenseful and horrifying zombie shooter, The Plague.

name: McRogue
shortDescription: It's man versus machine in this action roguelite from Snare Games. Explore procedural worlds, collect power-ups, and use McRogue's devastating robot fists to destroy all that stand in his way. But don't take too long about it - the robots only get stronger.

name: Krampus Quest
shortDescription: Krampus Quest is a back-to-basics retro-style action-platformer with a christmas theme. Fighting your way up the North Pole, absorbing souls, dodging traps and pitfalls, and upgrading abilities, to in the end battle Santa Claus himself.

name: Escape Room
shortDescription: Look for hints and disable the bomb. Now!! Your time is running short.

name: Osmorrow
shortDescription: An adventure set on the planet of Osmorrow, where the Ogre clan has run rampant. Your mission is to help restore peace and order to this world as you liberate Osmorrow from the Ogre oppression. Use high skilled melee and ranged combat along with swift and precise movement to quell the Ogre threat.

name: Taste of Power
shortDescription: Show your strategic talents in Taste of Power! It's a RTS set in an alternate medieval world, where Europe, Middle East, and China confront each other. Develop unique technologies and lead warriors into an epic battlefield – the victory is yours!

name: Drunkenpants
shortDescription: Drunkenpants is a game where ordinary heroes who got drunk in their underpants at home (Kalsarikänni) try to solve mundane problems with excessive violence. The game is an action based, fast-paced multiplayer battle game, where you compete in different game modes and try to beat your opponents.

name: The Ultimate Heist
shortDescription: Ever wanted to go on an adventure where you get to infiltrate some of the most High Security Vaults across the world? We have you covered, use the gadgets at your disposal to neutralize your foes!

name: Human Parking Simulator
shortDescription: Are you confident in your driving skills? Then come and take on this challenge. The goal is simple: drive the vehicle and park it in the designated space. That's all there is to it.

name: Africa Hunting
shortDescription: You are playing for an African pirate and you need to destroy as many planes as possible off the coast of Africa, and also collect humanitarian cargo, and dodge of rockets

name: Sprout
shortDescription: Embark on a casual, botanical-puzzle-adventure. Make friends, learn new skills, solve puzzles, and become the mighty oak that you were always meant to be.

name: Versus World
shortDescription: Welcome to Versus World! Shoot, stab, snipe, and 'splode your opponents to victory in this fast-paced multiplayer FPS. Here, the afterlife of a respawning immortal is seasoned by an up-down crouch.

name: Grim Tales: The Wishes Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Be careful what you wish for... A deadly bargain has been made, and it's up to you to set things right before your nephew pays the terrible price!

name: League of Light: Silent Mountain Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Solve the mysteries of Stoneville and escape with your life!

name: Christmas Stories: Hans Christian Andersen's Tin Soldier Collector's Edition
shortDescription: The Rat King's wand has fallen into the hands of a vengeful baron. Team up with your new friend, the Tin Soldier, to stop him!

name: Botanica: Earthbound Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Play as both Ellie and Ian, two scientists stranded on Botanica. Can you save your friends and find your way home?

name: Shadow Wolf Mysteries: Bane of the Family Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Return to the De la Fer estate to help the count unravel the curse that has been passed down through his family!

name: Cadenza: The Kiss of Death Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Is your husband-to-be guilty of betrayal – or even worse?

name: Nevertales: Legends Collector's Edition
shortDescription: The love between you and your husband was strong enough to end a war... but is it strong enough to save the world?

name: Haunted Train: Frozen in Time Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Thieves have stolen Charon's most powerful artifact: watches that can stop time. Now only you stand in their way.

name: NeverBound
shortDescription: NeverBound is the gravity-shifting shooter that brings you mind-bending combat and puzzles in multi-gravity environments. You are as dangerous from below as you are from above. The rules have changed. High ground is relative.

name: Musical Reflex
shortDescription: Musical Reflex is a game as its name suggests where you can test your musical reflex by having fun or trying to improve yourself and try to be the best in the ladder. The principle of the game is pretty simple, press the right keys at the right time all this enbiencer with a music chooses.

name: RedSun RTS
shortDescription: Redsun RTS is a prime example of the genre classic RTS, unjustly forgotten today.

name: Action Rush
shortDescription: Simple racing game. Our goal is to reach the exit by coming from the top of simple obstacles in 10 different maps.

name: Poker Legends: Texas Hold'em Poker Tournaments
shortDescription: Poker Legends is a free-to-play multiplayer Texas Hold’em game where you bluff, bet, and strategize against real players. Compete in tournaments, complete challenges, unlock rewards, climb global leaderboards, and prove you’re the ultimate poker champion.

name: WaywaY
shortDescription: WaywaY – A game that tests your skills in dealing with various obstacles while directing a circle (ring) along a path. Along this path you will encounter various and anomalies and bosses.

name: Planet Guardian VR
shortDescription: Planet Guardian VR is an action room-scale VR game in which you play to protect planets from incoming asteroids. To fulfill your mission you need to use your controllers as weapons to destroy the asteroids. Each level brings a new challenge, be it by the speed, matter or placement of the asteroids.

name: City Eye
shortDescription: In the world of City Eye, you’ll become an operator of the Central Monitoring System, who will try to prevent the effects of every single transgression in the game. Use city maps to track dangerous areas and don’t let the suspects run away from the Police.

name: Dungeons & Vampires
shortDescription: Dungeons & Vampires- addictive step-by-step role-playing role-playing Roguelike-game with a gothic atmosphere, combining Dungeon Crawler and Clicker mechanics. Teach your hunters to vampires, clearing the way through dangerous procedurally-generated dungeons.

name: Bizarre Tale
shortDescription: Bizarre Tale is a fast focused game that requires agility, dexterity and fast decision making, in order to avoid obstacles and destroy waves of enemies that come in great numbers and in all directions.

name: Go All Out
shortDescription: Yandere-Chan, Teslakid, Cole Black, Breakbone and more crossover characters in one fighting game! Be the last man standing in this intense and action packed platform fighter.

name: House of Evil
shortDescription: House of Evil - atmospheric survival horror with a first-person view, in which you can test your nerves for strength. The events take place in the mansion that exists in reality. The main character is an ordinary philistine, his wife is an exorcist, after an unusual telephone conversation, the protagonist can not call to the spouse, and...

name: Plug Me
shortDescription: Plug Me is a tricky puzzle platform where the timer is a physical object in the game world! You are able to walk on the green parts of this bar as a platform, but you must be careful not to fall off as the power is drained.

name: Christmas Puzzle 3
shortDescription: Help the Elf to prepare your town for Christmas with beautiful ornaments and decorations! Play through cool Match 3 levels, collect Santa’s coins and prepare the best Christmas fair ever!

name: Doodle God: Alchemy Jam
shortDescription: Short experimental puzzle game, based on Doodle God alchemy mechanics.

name: Gamma Blast
shortDescription: Blast your way through enemy waves. Strike at enemy formations prioritizing targets depending on the situation. Rip them to pieces using an arsenal of powerful and versatile weapons. Put your reflexes to the test dodging a fire storm of enemy projectiles. Destroy challenging Bosses to achieve victory.

name: Battle for Mountain Throne
shortDescription: Battle for Mountain Throne - virtual action game in world of fantasy

name: DEBUFF
shortDescription: Nine fantasy heroes await your leadership in single player campaign, multiplayer battles and raids and last but not least, killing football game! Gain experience to level up, assign skill points, purchase bonus buffs to fight DEBUFF. Oh, and don't forget to kill Hellga!

name: MGP Manager
shortDescription: The Championship Awaits Step into the paddock as a Team Principal in the ultimate single-player motorcycle racing management simulation. Take the reins of a team across three distinct championship classes and call every shot on your journey to the top of the world standings.

name: HJ: Sacrifice
shortDescription: Horror Jail, Professor Dr. Cherubs's little hell on earth. Your sole purpose in single player action-horror game to survive this horrible prison. But you are not alone.

name: Souland
shortDescription: There are many nations in Souland, and you will be one of them. Can you beat all other nations?

name: Uizuno Blade VR
shortDescription: Uizuno Blade is an action Sci-Fi game designed for Virtual Reality. Fight with laser guns and energy swords against hostile soldiers and monsters. This version contains five levels of action and will be updated with more levels in the coming months.

name: MIMIC
shortDescription: Memorize the path as quickly as you can to reach the finish block in 100 unique levels and 10 different environments. Collect stars to unlock puzzles with increasing difficulty and added obstacles as you compete with other players on online leader boards. Create your own maps (NEW!)

name: AWAKEN：Gunpowder Adventurer Day.Dream
shortDescription: Awaken as an action RPG game has a wealth of levels and a variety of way to play. We hope that players who love this type of game can experience the core content of the game as well as the overall story of the game.

name: Flying Turkey
shortDescription: Welcome to Flying Turkey!!! In here, You must defend the platform and stop turkeys getting away. Have you ever try to use an ice cream to strike turkeys away? Or use a frog-glove to launch turkeys? There is a great variety of turkeys and weapons waiting for you to explore. Just have a blast!!!

name: Dizzy Dungeon
shortDescription: Move, rotate and fall. Move, rotate and fall. Get ready for dizziness, find to best strategy to conquer the dungeon.

name: Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome
shortDescription: Guns, cars, lasers, and explosions! Nightwolf is a synth-themed, cyber-powered vehicular combat game in which you enter this dystopian future’s most popular sports arena – the MEGADOME! Survive an onslaught by motorized enemies and dispatch them in style for the enjoyment of the crowd!

name: Your Toy
shortDescription: Your Toy is a 3D first person horror room escape game that features an advanced non-repeat puzzle system with challenging riddles, heart-pounding escape sequences and a mysterious narrative that dives deep into your darkest subconsciousness. Are you ready to enter your nightmares?

name: Chineze
shortDescription: Chineze is the HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) quiz trainer, with the aim to improve your Chinese vocabulary. You'll have an opportunity to choose exact level of HSK. Every HSK level has a number of categories for easier learning process.

name: Gunman Tales
shortDescription: Gunman Tales is an old-school action adventure game for 1-4 players set in the wild west and inspired by the legendary game from Amiga Moonstone: A Hard Days Knight and Cabal

name: Star Sweet
shortDescription: The goal is simple as a roasted cucumber. The gambling field is studded with jewels, you need to swipe the same diamonds in a row to clear the field.

name: Android John 2.1
shortDescription: Operating system AJ 1.0, created by students enthusiasts in 2070 showed stupendous results. Since the release of the first version of the operating system 5 years have passed. This product was noticed and was purchased by a larger company engaged in the development of military robotics.

name: Tile Typer
shortDescription: Tile Typer is a simple score chasing game. Bind your keys then press them as they come up. Can you beat your previous speeds? How long can you be accurate?

name: Frontier Runner
shortDescription: In Frontier Runner video game you play a character role in the mid-22nd century who was selected to travel on one of the first exploration ships that left earth to find new homes to expand mankind faiths, and ideologies.

name: Cat Burglar: A Tail of Purrsuit
shortDescription: Cat Burglar is a short, light-hearted, stealth, puzzle platformer with a pet charity awareness campaign. Help Kat find her way into the Dogo Corps base to discover Major Bulls' master plan.

name: Futurejam

shortDescription: Play as the hero of the story, Hero. In this generic adventure inspired by classic RPG's, take on the role of Hero and save the princess from The Kingdom's many enemies. Completely open-level based intended for level crawlers and casual players alike.

name: Adventures of Dragon
shortDescription: Unlikely hero is thrust into a crazy world and gets involved in a grand adventure!

name: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim: Black GOAT of the Woods Edition
shortDescription: Experience the non-groundbreaking, non-award winning VN/RPG, Army of Tentacles, in all its DLC glory! Comes with New Game+ Benefits, the most amazing Cthulhu Dating Sim in the universe, as well as Halloween, SDCC, the Sequel outfits, and the item packs!

name: Fairy of the treasures
shortDescription: In the game Fairy of the treasures you have to help a young fairy Mei to open magic chests and hidden gems, and gold! The game is a clicker with elements of visual novel.

name: The Dummy Experiment
shortDescription: Scientist Strohmann loves to play around with all kinds of crazy stuff. This time he thought of a cruel and inhumane experiment in which his test subject, Dummy 44, will experience a horrible and terrifying pain. Your role is to help Dummy 44 to escape the laboratory forever.

name: Goblin Gearshop
shortDescription: The orcs have started a war and are trying to take over the world! Gather your friends and smelt, mold and forge your own weapons to craft an end to this war!

name: Boomer Rampage
shortDescription: Boomer Rampage is a puzzle game in which we control the boomers rocket hand. Our task is to destroy the target, avoiding enemies, traps and walls in all the 90 levels.

name: Overlook: Local multiplayer game - up to 16 players
shortDescription: Players split into two teams. You can play as an infected robot or you can play as an overseer to seek and find infected robots.

name: Memento of Spring
shortDescription: Spring has come, and yet Juliane is more than happy to let it pass from the comforts of her bedroom. But how will her indoor nature survive when the world decides to boot her as far away as possible?

name: Boo! Greedy Kid
shortDescription: In "Boo! Greedy Kid", you play as a small brat who's so into soda that he doesn't blink an eye before wreaking havoc to get his favorite drink. Go frighten people with your own voice! (or a controller, that's fine too)

name: Thetaball
shortDescription: Thetaball is an authentic digital sport with challenging, physics-based gameplay and lifelike AI.

name: FormFish
shortDescription: FormFish is a little tetris-like game. Try to catch the incoming shapes with the traps of the right color and the right trap !

name: Factory Hiro
shortDescription: Hiro Kikuchi (age 42) oversees an assembly line at the factory. Each day is a new puzzle that will test his reflexes, patience and quick thinking right as it all goes horribly wrong...

name: Alien Revival - Episode 1 - Duty Calls
shortDescription: Initially very much First Person Shooter, with collectables, series will develop into more adventure/task driven whilst still keeping the FPS element.Episode 1: Duty Calls - Join the government service as a lone agent...

name: DUNKYPUNG
shortDescription: THIS GAME WILL $%#@ING DESTROY YOU. BRUTAL BALL BOUNCING ARENA ACTION. DEATH TO THE MAX. GET JUICY!

name: Annwn: the Otherworld
shortDescription: Annwn is an abstract stealth strategy game of tension and relief, across a series of mysterious procedural islands.

name: Queen's Tales: Sins of the Past Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Your enemy imprisoned your father, but now he’s forcing you to marry him! Can you escape and save your father?

name: Love Story: The Beach Cottage
shortDescription: Haunted by memories left behind forty years ago, Sandra must return to the Beach House she’s been trying to forget!

name: Web of Deceit: Deadly Sands Collector's Edition
shortDescription: While visiting your uncle, you stumble upon a curious case. Men are vanishing, reappearing dead days later. Who killed them?

name: Off The Record: Liberty Stone Collector's Edition
shortDescription: How much is the famous Liberty Stone worth? A life?

name: Haunted Legends: The Undertaker Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Find out who is behind the shocking zombie invasion.

name: Containment
shortDescription: Containment is a turn-based, minimalist strategy game about managing the growth of bacteria. Use antibiotics to keep their power under control as you work towards containment.

name: Talk to Saki
shortDescription: Chat with Saki! Input keywords, ask questions, or simply check in to see how she's doing!

name: Rotator
shortDescription: Rotator is a casual 2D puzzle game based on groupped diamonds. Each falling diamonds group can be move, rotate, scroll and fast drop. Experience endless gameplay with unique puzzles every day in a beautiful game filled with different surprises, explosions under magic music and sound effects.

name: Sad City 42
shortDescription: Learn the story of a simple Russian Vlad, who is trying to survive in Russia.

name: Doodle God: Mighty Trio
shortDescription: Colorful match-3 game mixed with Doodle God alchemy and world builder. Unleash the power of elements to perform a miracle of creation! Blast these gems of elemental magic and fill your very own world with wonders and marvel! Create the flourishing life full of color, joy and sweetness!

name: Welcome to Light Fields
shortDescription: Welcome to Light Fields. Experience real-world reflections, depth, and translucence like never before in VR. Explore the Gamble House, Mosaic Tile House, and the Space Shuttle Discovery. These navigable stills showcase the emerging technology Google is using to power its next generation of VR content.

name: Amazing Trivia
shortDescription: Challenge your knowledge in the new exciting trivia game!

name: Kansei
shortDescription: A murder mystery visual novel. Use your psychic powers to uncover secrets and hunt down a murderer.

name: Confederate Express
shortDescription: 50 levels. One mouse. Zero mercy. A brutal mouse-only clicker puzzle

name: Yousei
shortDescription: A murder mystery visual novel. Dig into your history as you chase down a murderer.

name: ESCAPE FROM VOYNA:  Tactical FPS survival
shortDescription: Escape from Voyna is an action packed realistic single player shooter set in the era of the Cold War on russian soil. After many nuclear tests the land is devastated and apocalypse spreading. You, a secret agent stranded on an island try to escape without getting caught by enemy soldiers.

name: Evolva
shortDescription: Evolva combines the excitement of a fast paced shoot-em-up with the tactical challenge of commanding a squad. Fight against the alien parasites and save the planet. This is survival of the fittest!

name: ERROR: Human Not Found
shortDescription: Error: Human Not Found is a visual-novel/puzzle game with portions of point-and-click adventure. Play as Grace and work to uncover the cause of death for the first AI to inhabit a physical body. Solve 4 types of computer-science based puzzles that increase in difficulty as the story progresses.

name: Stage Fright (by Broan Games)
shortDescription: Stage Fright is a single player rhythm and horror game where you take the role of a piano prodigy who is overwhelmed by musical performance anxiety. This anxiety manifests itself as a supernatural ghost girl, the mysterious HANNAH, who haunts your concerts to strain your ability and sanity.

name: The Intern
shortDescription: The Intern - O Estágio is a platform/action with elements of rpg/jrpg and anime elements, a deep story places the player in the shoes of an aspiring creative lady who will travel through worlds, times and dimensions

name: Take That
shortDescription: Fast-paced Western shooting game, can quickly play the core content even if you only got 10 minutes break. Multiple modes are added to the game to help you kill time when you don't know what to play.

name: Banshee Force
shortDescription: Banshee Force is a virtual reality game where you command the legendary Banshee Force Weapons Platform. Standing in the middle of a planetary battle you use the weapons platform to stop the invaders and build a defense that can outlast the enemy.

name: FFXV WINDOWS EDITION 4K Resolution Pack
shortDescription: This pack allows you to enjoy FINAL FANTASY XV in high resolution.

name: Zombie City
shortDescription: Are you ready for the zombie apocalypse? We've done the research and want to make sure you're prepared. Fought to the end. Requires the virtual reality headset.

name: VR_PlayRoom
shortDescription: Play a game with your friends to reach the highest score.

name: Shield Impact
shortDescription: Shield Impact is an action survival game where a gladiator with only one shield will be challenged by rising hordes of enemies in an arena in ancient Rome.

name: Fimbul
shortDescription: Fimbul is a single-player comic-book, action adventure set in the final winter before Ragnarök, The Fimbul Winter. You play as an old berserk, travelling to Jötunheim to fulfill his destiny, battling Trolls and Jotuns to reclaim an ancient artifact that might, just might save Midgard.

name: Airhead
shortDescription: Help a small body save a head-like organism full of air, from a leak that threatens its life. Explore their Metroidvania-style world and overcome challenging environmental puzzles to find the key to the head's survival.

name: .T.E.S.T: Expected Behaviour — Sci-Fi 3D Puzzle Quest
shortDescription: .T.E.S.T: Expected Behavior is a first-person brain twister with a sci-fi plot. On top of logic, you'll need a fast reaction speed, "outside the box" reasoning, and the skill to adapt to unfamiliar situations.

name: Isles of Etherion
shortDescription: A third-person open-world Voxel ARPG with Physics-based Magic and 100% dynamically destructible fantasy world, featuring Airships, Floating Islands, Dungeons, Voxel Combat and Spell Weaving. Created by a solo developer living the dream of making the game he wants to play.

name: Rookie Math Pro
shortDescription: Rookie Math Pro is the new social learning platform that engages six to eleven year-olds to practice and learn mathematics in a fun, interactive and safe environment. Discover secrets, unlock characters, collect coins, earn trophies and level up!

name: Jelly Escape
shortDescription: The adventures of the cute jelly left in search of freedom! You have to run, run and use the traps and various objects to get into the black hole to take you to the next level.

name: Bullet Runner
shortDescription: A clone army is taking over the world. Kill them all in an epic single-player campaign to save humanity, and yourself!

name: Star Runner
shortDescription: Star Runner is a challenging 2D space shooter with resource collection and surprising depth. Zip through dynamically created solar systems to wreak havok on enemy spaceships and starbases while dancing around asteroids to mine them for the materials needed for weapons, thrusters and repairs.

name: Harvester of Dreams : Episode 1
shortDescription: Harvester of Dreams is a first person adventure game, taking you on board an steampunk airship. Unravel the secret of the ship while you are exploring it room after room.

name: Harvest Seasons
shortDescription: Part farming game, party city building game, part idle/clicker game, Harvest Seasons is all about harvesting and growth. Gather up resources from your farmland and spend them on buildings and upgrading your city. And then upgrade your resources to get more. It's the circle of harvest!

name: Mind Portal
shortDescription: A beautiful, low poly stylized, first-person exploration game centered around three things: interesting story, hard mazes and atmospheric music.

name: Once upon a Dungeon
shortDescription: Explore dark dungeons, defeat challenging creatures and collect unique loot in this hardcore traditional roguelike game.

name: Dexterity
shortDescription: The exhibition's main entrance/exit has mysteriously vanished. Help the guests to escape by completing a host of devilishly difficult and silly physics based challenges and puzzles with the aid of your 'hand on a stick' device.

name: Asteroidiga
shortDescription: A single mine detonation in this bullet hell game will send you flying around the screen. But never fear! Use your wits and your Teleportation module, fast Machine Gun, powerful Laser, Tracer Bullets, and the venerable shotgun.

name: 4 for the Money Demo
shortDescription: 4 for the Money is a fast-paced, side-scrolling action/platformer featuring gameplay and graphics resembling the greats of the NES era. Except you don't need a Four Score to play 4-player! Sit down alone or with a pack of friends and jump in for the action!

name: Mortal Manor
shortDescription: Take part in a difficult 2D Metroidvania adventure where you will fight through the Manor and surrounding areas to find the source of fog consuming the world. Collect weapons, relics, and experience to upgrade your character to fight, or avoid, the hordes of monsters sent out by the scientist.

name: Committed: Mystery at Shady Pines - Premium Edition
shortDescription: You wake up strapped to a bed, inside an abandoned hospital. Find a way to save the patients, stop the psychotic doctor, and escape before it’s too late. Explore the inner workings of Shady Pines and solve challenging mini-games in this immersive hidden object puzzle adventure game!

name: Arbiter
shortDescription: Arbiter is an intense, multiplayer arena shooter in VR. Blast yourself around the battle grid with an assortment of weapons in destructible environments. Each round is a new arbitration with players representing a side procedurally decided upon by the all-powerful Arbiter AI.

name: 跳跃2/LeapII
shortDescription: The scroll of Temple has been stolen,casual worker Ming vow to get it back.

name: The Treasure Seekers of Lady Luck
shortDescription: Jump to hyperspace aboard the Lady Luck, the fastest starship in the galaxy! Join her ragtag crew of space pirates, or infiltrate their ranks, working undercover for the Galactic Police.

name: Blocked and Loaded
shortDescription: Lay waste to the armies of Soros with an awesome assortment of over 150 weapons, armor and magical items in this MMO-RPG-FPS.

name: To the City of the Clouds
shortDescription: Search for the lost Incan city known as La Ciudad de las Nubes in the mountains of Colombia. Your fledgling archaeologist will battle venomous pit vipers, tropical diseases, and the FARC guerrilla army to secure fame, fortune, and tenure at a prestigious university.

name: Yeti's Parole Officer
shortDescription: The Yeti, Loch Ness Monster, Chupacabra, and Mothman are aliens, sentenced to prison on Earth by the Pan-Galactic Prisons Bureau. As the Yeti's parole officer, you must defend the galaxy from these convicts, unravel their criminal conspiracy, and bring them to justice!

name: Showdown at Willow Creek
shortDescription: Saddle up and defend the town of Willow Creek from nefarious outlaws and city slickers! It all starts when a rancher's daughter goes missing, and it ends at the showdown at Willow Creek, where greed, lust, science and Mother Nature will face off at high noon.

name: For Rent: Haunted House
shortDescription: How will you screw over your tenants? Will you ignore inconvenient supernatural phenomena, or use them to drum up publicity? How will you deal with ghost hunters, squatters, and celebrity tenants? Will you emerge as the top agent? Or will you become a permanent resident of 57 Crowther Terrace?

name: COMPLEX a VR Puzzle Game
shortDescription: - A puzzle game for HTC VIve and Oculus Rift

name: Sky Ball
shortDescription: In this game you will visit the heavenly islands. Manage the ball get to the final point without falling, while you decide to solve all kinds of puzzles.

name: Prison Bomber
shortDescription: Prison Bomber is an oldschool arcade shooter, based on classic 2d action games. Your main goal is to rescue your ally from enemies prison. Fight your way through the mass of enemies and beat the high-score.

name: YangBo Adventure
shortDescription: YangBo Adventure是一款結合劇情、遊戲和3D環場影片的方式來介紹朝陽科技大學特色的校園導覽遊戲，遊戲內容是在學校的六棟大樓裡闖關，每一棟大樓都有不同的遊戲內容、劇情和環場影片，玩家可以在遊玩中就可以了解到朝陽科技大學的特色。

name: Super Inefficient Golf
shortDescription: Super Inefficient Golf builds on top of the most inefficient game ever conceived by making it even LESS efficient. Drop your silly golf stick and start using exploding mines to guide your ball! Place them, choose the right timing, and BOOM - Birdie!

name: Crew 167: The Grand Block Odyssey
shortDescription: Crew 167 finds himself alone on a spaceship hurtling towards a destination that may be the salvation that his home is seeking. Isolated, his mind begins to create hallucinations to keep him entertained. Dive into the mind of the character as he tries to make sense of the world around him.

name: After Life VR
shortDescription: You regain consciousness in a closed room, how did you get there? Why is there a coffin? Are you dead? Is this the afterlife?

name: Fisherones
shortDescription: Get beneath the scales of a little blue fish and dive into a vibrant, living, breathing world and uncover its mysteries. Explore every nook and cranny of 3 vibrant biomes: a coral reef, a kelp forest and a rocky ocean floor and all the lost and forgotten beautiful sites within them.

name: R.A.F.A.
shortDescription: Imagine that you are a child and want to explore new worlds as an astronaut. Imagine a platformer with the ability to jump across an entire solar system. Imagine a story that won’t left you enough time to separate your face from the screen. Challenge yourself and be part of this arcade style videogame – RAFA. R.A.F.A.

name: Beyond the Invisible: Darkness Came
shortDescription: Play this Hidden Object Adventure Game with strong characters, old style cartoonish graphics, a bonus chapter, and a sublime story line which will enchant you to the end. Take the role of a persistent detective, solve puzzles, play minigames and unveil the secret of the people of this magic location

name: a Museum of Dubious Splendors
shortDescription: a Museum of Dubious Splendors, is a storybook from the world of Somewhere. A quiet game about prosaic objects and spurious histories, it is an irreverent rumination on the nature of an archive and forms of recollection.

name: MatchyGotchy
shortDescription: MatchyGotchy is a casual idle clicker game full of childlike wonder. Introducing characters from the Matchy Star world, collect them all as digital pets and build thousands of ships to reach Xanadu. Get your virtual Stars that intergalactic pool party they always wanted!

name: Fay's Factory
shortDescription: Fay’s Factory is a story-based RPG at heart, with deckbuilding elements on top. Manufacture magic and fight duels. Go on hand-crafted adventures. Investigate, argue and lie. Become a great middle manager or a decent human being.

name: Wizards: Wand of Epicosity
shortDescription: When the Wizard of Darkness awakened, it was up to one man to defeat him. When that man was accidentally killed by one idiot, Tobuscus (or "person of extremely low intelligence" - gently put), the responsibility of becoming an AWESOME WIZARD fell onto him...

name: Bird Watcher
shortDescription: Bird Watcher is a short story about a girl whose name is Claire that after her parent's death was made to live with her gloomy vicious aunt. Her life in the new house becomes similar to the life in the cage which is full of stringent prohibitions and rules. And every day is absolutely the same as previous one.

name: Hunahpu Quest. Mechanoid
shortDescription: An Indian Hunahpu has a simple objective- save his brother from the dreadful Mechanoid. However this objective is simple only at the first glance – in fact it is hard. You will need all your perfect reaction, strength and intelligence! Go ahead!

name: Christmas Santa Troubles
shortDescription: Collect all sweets during the game, avoid saws, spikes, icicles and falling to abyss - you will help main character come back all gifts and Christmas will be saved. Santa will prepare his sleigh and move on worldwide giving out presents for all kids on the planet. help Santa, save the Christmas!

name: NYAN DESTROYER
shortDescription: NYAN DESTROYER is a military squad of special purpose, whose main goal is to cleanse the universe of cute creatures. These creatures have already enslaved most of the human population that is why people prefer to play carelessly with them, and not to destroy them... Fight back against them!

name: Subscribe & Punch!
shortDescription: Subscribe & Punch! is an easy to play versus fighting game based on the wacky YouTubers universe. Roast the face of your opponents and experiment various humorous interactions inside with YouFight: the virtual platform hosting the craziest fights!

name: Dark Core
shortDescription: Help Alex and his friends to acquire the dark core fragments in order to get out of the castle which they were kidnapped. Who kidnapped them? and why? Help them moving froward and discover the mystery! This game is a classic RPG game. It is similar to classic final fantasy games. You have 4 characters which you can get while game playing.

name: The Evil Party
shortDescription: The Evil Party is a very difficult platforming game, you play a ninja, and you have to go through many levels to get to the party . But it will be very difficult to do this, the game does not forgive mistakes, the player dies with one blow and starts the level first .

name: Action Alien: Survival
shortDescription: Fight hordes of aliens in a completely destructible petrol station with many weapons to grab and aliens to fight !

name: Stinky Snake
shortDescription: Stinky Snake is a family adventure game about sibling rivalry between a snake and a skunk.

name: Panacea: Last Will
shortDescription: Panacea: Last Will (Chapter 1) is an Amnesia-like survival horror game with lots of notes, flashbacks and a storyline to tell you about what's going on, as well as monsters ready to tear you apart at first sight!

name: Primal Pursuit
shortDescription: "The Dark Souls of racing games" - Some guy possibly. Round up your mates, pick your animal and mount up to fight in these ancient death races. Finally the age old question will be answered: Who's fastest? The emu or the tortoise?

name: 谜桥 / RiddleBridge
shortDescription: "RiddleBridge" is an independent game based on this love story.Player play the role of Magpies, build a connected bridge.The game includes beautiful pictures and exquisite scenery, and classical Chinese music. You need to pay your imagination and creativity to find a "key" to solve puzzles.

name: The Hardest Thing
shortDescription: The Hardest Thing is a first-person game where you will solve puzzles with physics

name: Refight:Burning Engine
shortDescription: It's a military survival TPS game. The game is based on armored vehicles with a Battle Royal gameplay. No matter you are singer person，in small team or group，you will experience the exciting escape and kill game.

name: Magic Nations - Card Game
shortDescription: Jump into a fantasy world of the Magic Nations - turn-based strategy card battle game. Grab your card deck and fight against opponents from all over the world. The gameplay is based on tactics and adapting your game to battlefield conditions. Collect, sell, expand.

name: Boss Crushers
shortDescription: Boss Crushers is a multiplayer roguelike game. Play with your friends on randomly generated levels, confront enemy hordes, find valuable items and improvements, die and try again.

name: Log Challenge
shortDescription: Log Challenge is an arcade game where you will have lots of fun in a 'quest for diamonds' action trying to collect as many diamonds as fast as you can moving through a dangerous plank while avoiding heavy swinging logs.

name: Azusa RP Online
shortDescription: Azusa Online is an open world roleplay driven game, focused in developing the world and story of your character while interacting with other players. Compete in tournaments around the world to earn rights to wear the legendary Olympian armors and help defy gods; Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Hades and more.

name: Hill Quest
shortDescription: Run, Jump, Shoot, use Jetpack, Dive into the sea and more in this initial adventure, save your dad and in the way the mankind. An intriguing platformer with plot twists what will be used into other products of the same franchise. We use #GoodGuysGameDeveloper philosophy.

name: Quanero 2 - System Release
shortDescription: Imagine you are a detective in the future, with the best surveillance system ever developed. You can reconstruct crime scenes in virtual reality, move freely and manipulate the time to carry out your investigations.

name: Colony On Mars
shortDescription: You play as an astronaut in a colony on Mars and you need to upgrade your colony, build new constructions and collect resources

name: The First Thrust of God
shortDescription: Now, you are God, and you bring the first thrust of God.

name: Cannon Fire
shortDescription: Cannon fire is a game all about blowing your friends' ship to pieces, in Multiplayer or Split-Screen mode for the best experience.

name: Drifting Cloud
shortDescription: Play online in drifting cloud with up to 3 friends in 3 challenging gamemodes or chill out in a relaxing singleplayer mode where you can try to get a highscore and unlock new rockets with different special abilities and playstyles.

name: NOSTOI
shortDescription: NOSTOI is a narrative 3D puzzle and platformer game with a gameplay mechanics based on the physics and time manipulation. The game is about a boy who tries to escape his psychological trauma.

name: Dr. Trolley's Problem
shortDescription: Dr. Trolley's Problem brings the classic philosophical quandaries of the Trolley Problem to life and asks you to make life or death decisions on the fly. Compare your decisions to others! Explore your moral fiber in ways you never imagined (or asked for)!

name: Vector's Adventures
shortDescription: The blueprints are scattered and out of order! You must piece the worlds back together. Join Vector, a dot, the lowest form of geometry, in his adventure across the Shades of Blue as he battles a hierarchy of greater shapes. Wield the Architect's pen for puzzles and combat in the Land of Lines.

name: The Short Story of a Drifting Labyrinth
shortDescription: A fast paced 3D isometric action game which gives the player a choice between strategic, hack-n-slash, or mixed style gameplay. A newly entrapped resident of the Labyrinth, you must attempt to escape using the guidance of the long term captives.

name: Coaster
shortDescription: Experience the thrill and sensation of 4 unique roller coaster experiences. Feel the wind rush through your virtual hair as you ride some of the most enjoyable and immersive VR coasters on the market.

name: Dream On The Moon
shortDescription: Dream on the moon is a ragdoll, physics Stick Man sandbox game with different dreams (game modes) on the moon. Play sports and combat against each other with swords, guns etc.

name: Super Jet Juck
shortDescription: Super Jet Juck is a dynamic puzzle and adventure game. Join the soldiers Juck and Tom!

name: Nostradamus - The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
shortDescription: Play as Nostradamus and solve puzzles and riddles to thwart the plans of the Four Horseman of the Apocalypse.

name: MIAZMA or the Devil's Stone
shortDescription: MIAZMA is the second Jonathan Hunt adventure, sequel to award-winning FMV title Yoomurjak’s Ring. The agile NY journalist embarks on a new investigation after a curious meteorite. What is inside the devilish stone? Is it a huge gem, a magic formula or a devastating substance?

name: YOOMURJAK'S RING
shortDescription: Jonathan Hunt, a journalist from New York, arrives in the city of Eger in Hungary for a break. In the heritage of his great-grandfather, he found two letters dated back in 1898, about a time machine. Hunt wants to find out what happened to invention. But he soon realizes that someone isdesperately trying to stop him...

name: Steampunker
shortDescription: Discover Steamburg's developers new game ! Steampunker is an award-winning point and click adventure game involving a search for hidden objects. It's set in an astonishing steampunk world.

name: Car Puzzler
shortDescription: Car Puzzler is a line puzzle game variation. Drag all cars to their destination in levels with varying game mechanics. Build and share your own levels. Beat others in leaderboards.

name: Nekomew's Potty Trouble
shortDescription: Nekomew’s Potty Trouble is a one player rhythmic videogame.You must help Nekomew get to the toilet before he pisses on himself! As you progress in the game the difficulty will rise and new monsters will appear trying to stop him.♫ Follow the music and you will make it! ♫

name: My Little Bomb
shortDescription: You are a scientist and engineer of the North Korean army and you need to grow your little nuclear bomb.

name: STARBO - The Story of Leo Cornell
shortDescription: STARBO tells you the story of a dead man's journey through a mysteriously blue world filled with strange messages and beings all trying to tell you a story, the story of Leo Cornell.

name: ASH OF WAR™
shortDescription: The story about an uneasy journey of one man. You will experience certain situations, those, that could have happened with our parents, children or even a neighbours on just any other war. Through the eyes of our hero you will see his struggle in a modern war, struggle with oneself.

name: Scrap Attack VR
shortDescription: Enter the mysterious caves of Botanika, where the Boltheads are hell-bent on the destruction of the ancient Botanite Crystals. Your mission: Defend them at all costs, against unrelenting waves of frenzied robots. How far can you push yourself to protect the crystal from the robot onslaught?

name: Temple of Xiala
shortDescription: Temple of Xiala is a smart puzzle game where you control the gravity, and have to move boulders in slots to clear a path to the next level.

name: Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation
shortDescription: Welcome to Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation. In this VR experience, you will be transported to a northwestern forest, surrounded by trees, plants, insects and animals. Use the tools at your disposal, a stick and flashlight, to interact with the world around you, in day or night. Try it, it's free!

name: Among the Dead
shortDescription: Among the Dead - is an episodic choice-based visual novel about life after the zombie apocalypse. You need to fight with zombies and make decisions which can affect the further story. This is the first episode.

name: VR Soccer '96
shortDescription: Feel the soccer once again!

name: Snail Trek - Chapter 4: The Final Fondue
shortDescription: Relive 1980s nostalgia in this text parser driven graphic adventure game. You and your molluscan crew embark on an epic journey to find a new home world. In Chapter 4 - The Final Fondue, the story concludes. Your entire civilization is heading towards its doom, and it's up to you to save the world.

name: Football Heroes Turbo
shortDescription: Fight your way to the end zone using skill, strategy, and super moves to smash the competition. Collect and upgrade hundreds of unique players to build the ultimate football team. Get online and experience the most action-packed football game in the universe!

name: Rym 9000
shortDescription: Rym 9000 is a hyperkinetic shooter inspired by Akira, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Guxt. A treasure-hunting journey to the Moon developed by Sonoshee and composed by Roex. A unique high-octane experience conceived to stimulate your senses and make your eyes and ears bleed!

name: Filthy Frank Kart
shortDescription: Join Filthy Frank and many other known characters from the Filthy Frank Show and race trough all the different places of the Omniverse while proving that you are the Filthiest kart racer that ever lived.

name: Fenix Box
shortDescription: This is a hardcore minimalist 2D platformer that tests how much of a hardcore gamer you are.

name: Pure Football 2018
shortDescription: Pure Football 2018 is an American Football Simulator where you play GM, Coach, and Player. Play through endless seasons as you master player contracts, assembling your coaching staff, free agency, and the draft. Lead your players come game time or use the advanced game simulation system.

name: The Master
shortDescription: Climb to the top to learn The Master's teachings. Extremely short game.

name: Powerless
shortDescription: An outbreak has turned mankind into walking zombies, will your guns be enough to purge them all or will you be powerless against the zombie horde?

name: They have HORNS
shortDescription: They have HORNS is a fast topdown shooter in which it is essential to listen to his intuition in order to stand as long as possible the enemy hordes. Easy to learn, but hard to master. The up to 4 player coop mode works very simple via plugn play.

name: Blood of Patriots
shortDescription: Now with Nancy Pelosi! Choose from 18 patriots (and tyrants) and fight your way through the tree of liberty. Are you the patriot that is going to save the republic?

name: [TDA03] Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 03 REMASTERED

name: Ghost Platoon

name: City Patrol: Police

name: My Little Riding Champion

name: Blind Boris

name: Twilight on Yulestead
shortDescription: Break the curse on your town and yourself with only your cleric's staff and being half your normal size.

name: Lightfield HYPER Edition

name: Hexer

name: Porcelain Panic

name: ZEROCAR: Future Motorsport

name: Project Tank

name: ORE

Defeat the planet’s corrupted Core Wurm, save the planet, and get rich before time runs out!

name: Fairly Certain Doom

Live through crazy scenarios where you're pretty sure you're doomed.

name: Neon Knight: Vengeance From The Grave
shortDescription: An atmospheric 2D side-scroller that combines fast-paced combat with cinematic storytelling, pulling you into a dark dystopian world and an epic journey of vengeance, hope, and betrayal.

name: Zombie Clicker Defense

name: Bloodgeon

name: Lonely in the Winter

name: Puzzle for Kids
shortDescription: This puzzle game helps your kids develop matching and fine motor skills. Your children will just love these wonderfully hand-drawn pictures and will improve their spatial skills while having fun!

name: Obsession
shortDescription: In a dark world where reality blends with illusion, you strive to uncover the mystery of your sister's death. Explore locations, interact with characters, and gather clues. Gradually, your mind begins to betray you, and each step could lead either to the truth or to madness.

name: The Inner Friend
shortDescription: Descend into an eerie world made of scattered memories and unresolved traumas and explore a nightmarish landscape where you will come face to face with childhood fears and nightmares.

name: The Revenge of Johnny Bonasera: Episode 2
shortDescription: Hilarious adventure game in cartoon style.

name: ANYKEY

name: Monktastic

name: Innocent VR

name: Stormbound

name: BugOut
shortDescription: First Person, Exploring, Surviving, Hunting, Foraging, Buiding, Hoarding, Looting, Prepping, Crafting Work against Time and Survive, Storms, Earthquakes, Nuclear Events, Radical Weather, and much more

name: oVRshot

name: Space Chip
shortDescription: Space Chip is a fun game set in Space with a nostalgic playmode which you have to pass through different levels full of adventure, teleporting through space gates and avoiding energy balls, spaceships, meteorites and “alienoids”.

name: Impossible Runner
shortDescription: World's hardest game. Impossible Runner. Try to complete all 10 'Impossible' levels.

name: Ascent Spirit
shortDescription: Equipped with two improvised ice axes in Ascent Spirit, your only chance of survival is to reach the top of this sacred mountain and get back to your hot air balloon before the winds free it.

name: Voxel Baller
shortDescription: Challenge your breaking skills and tackle the obstacles in this frenzy action game! Voxel Baller invites you to rediscover the brick-beaking genre with 50 unique levels. Will you clear them all?

name: Epiphany!

name: Chocolate makes you happy 3

name: Feed Eve
shortDescription: Next-Gen VR Action-Shooter experience. Battle hordes of zombies in extremely realistic environments and varying exciting game modes.

name: Beer Ranger
shortDescription: Logic platformer in the Oldschool style. The dwarfs are on a quest to find as much beer as they can. Only smart mind and skillful hands will bring them to the desired goal. Will you manage to beat the most hardcore levels?

name: GOLFY GOLF

The nuclear core you have to steal is leaking radiation, so you need to hurry and escape! Manage your ammo carefully and collect power-ups to enhance your ship.

name: I Hate Heroes: Rocket Man

Play as a Rocket Man, a superhero trapped in the hell-prison of the greatest supervillain the world has ever known. Use your rocket thruster hands to zoom on the ground, grab massive air, avoid death, and collect keys to escape.

name: Shatter EVERYTHING (VR)

name: EV3 - Drag Racing

name: Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles

name: Pandora: Chains of Chaos
shortDescription: A 17-year-old girl named Pandora has opened a box containing evils that could destroy the world. Kome Village, her home, is invaded by creatures spawned from the darkness and the legendary Titans. During the invasion, Pandora must battle countless enemies and demons, including her own inner turmoil.

name: Space Ball
shortDescription: Space Ball is a casual adventure game, In this game, you need to control the ball, through the spikes, jump over the magma, collect gold coins along the way, and finally reach the end.

name: Canek: Quest for Corn [Demo]
shortDescription: Canek: Quest for Corn is a single player action platform game (under development). Meet Canek, a legendary hero on an epic quest to save the Maya civilization from the curse that threatens its people.

name: Zahalia
shortDescription: Zahalia was a peaceful land until The Dark Wizard came and stole all the crystals. Defeat his group of monsters and reclaim the Crystals to save Zahalia from darkness.

name: Xploquest 2

name: Way Out

name: From Village to Empire

name: DYO

name: Gladiators Of The Arena

name: Mind Over Mushroom
shortDescription: Mind Over Mushroom is a turn-based, tactical strategy game where movement isn't locked to a grid. Command a diverse array of unlockable characters including giant snails, walking bombs, and necromancers. Use clever tactics and a variety of status effects to defeat a grave fungal threat.

name: Essence of Illumination: The Beginning
shortDescription: In this first episode is a mystical immersive adventure that this relaxing, mesmerizing, and an exciting underwater experience as you explore an ancient world of a lost civilization with a Goddess who’s light and magic gives you the Power of Light to cleanse the dark matter that destroyed the civilization long ago.

name: Hiking Simulator 2018

name: Cactus Jumper

Twenty of the fiercest pillow warriors from around the world gathered to find out who was strongest.

Keep power to the energy pylons while maintaining the defense shield protecting Earth to earn powerful upgrades for your ship. Do you have what it takes to protect our world?

The game has five factions and about 500 magic cards to choose from, filled with infinite possibilities of deep strategy combinations. Players can build their decks with their own preferences to compete with others.

name: PLANET RESERVE
shortDescription: new version . Better graphics, better sound, several difficulty levels.

name: Albedon Wars

Clark is an ex-farmer, husband, and future bounty hunter-who escapes to Mars after losing everything. But when alien tech surfaces and visions of your ex-wife Angela pull you into the Hive, reality begins to fracture.

name: Little Dragons Café

All was routine until one morning when the twins discover that their mother won’t wake up. Suddenly a strange old man appears and tells them that they must raise a dragon to save her.

The game's endless Arcade mode ramps up difficulty over time, and challenges and cheatcodes keep things fresh and exciting!

name: Zettavolt Trigger

name: A Summer with the Shiba Inu
shortDescription: Syd the Shiba Inu quits her job in Canine-da, and goes to fight other dogs on an Island. What could go wrong? Your choices matter - there are multiple drastic ways to change the fate of Shiba Island, with 10+ variants depending on how you treat the dogs you meet along the way.

name: SFD : Rogue TRPG

name: Telefrag VR

name: Rascals

It plays much like any other board game where you throw dice to move your pieces, until you sneak up on one of your opponents and shoot him in the head.

name: Meet the Miner - WDR VR Bergwerk

name: Here Nya

name: Doodle Derby

name: MADievals - The rise of Rusty Steelknee

Set in a completely inaccurate Middle Ages, if you love the craziness of 90s adventures, you can't absolutely miss it!

Control up to three different natural elements and interact with your environment to progress through puzzles and grab the coins dispersed around the world!

name: Team Up VR (Beta)

name: The Con Simulator

After an attack on said post, it is up to him to retrieve the fabled Fang Shards. Turn your Beast Mode on, you're going to need it.
