shortDescription: AV-17 is a FREE 2D action platformer inspired by information technology and BUBBLE BOBBLE!!

name: Puppet Blaster
shortDescription: You wake up in the desert and find yourself surrounded by some not too friendly ghouls. Blast your way out with your twin blasters! A unique control method lets you control a violent little action figure's arms and shoot Ghouls (not Zombies!) right in their dumb looking faces!

name: The Energy Lab
shortDescription: You find yourself at the threshold of an abandoned lab containing technology of unknown origins. Welcome to The Energy Lab. You've found your way in, now find a way out.

name: 11th Dream
shortDescription: 11th Dream is a fast-paced third person abstract shooter aimed at hard-core difficulty enthusiasts and fast runners. Visit a place after biological history, where bots became tools for other tools.

name: Lost On The Island
shortDescription: Your dream holidays have never been so instantly accessible. We invite you on unique immersive vacation experience to enjoy the breathtaking views, swimming with dolphins, teleporting and jumping from beautiful cliffs and diving in a deep water around corals and colorful fish.

name: Time Splatter
shortDescription: Time splatter is a small episodic rail shooter game where our protagonist, after touching an ancient monolith, is transported to the times where the black plague transformed people into zombie like creatures and knights protected the land.

name: Rand-O-mazE
shortDescription: Randomly generated maze game

name: Here Come the Mystery Teens!
shortDescription: A comedic Narrative RPG about teenagers, ghosts, art, and Inspiration!

name: Event-D
shortDescription: Sci-fi Visual Novel (Linear Story). A group of astronauts, scientists and robots is sent to space on a mission to investigate the disturbing disappearance of the first manned spaceship in its journey to Mars.

name: Spitkiss
shortDescription: Spitkiss is a colorful platformer that lets you enter into the lovely world of the Spitkissers, tiny creatures that communicate through body fluids and emojis.

name: Crazy Washing Machine
shortDescription: You are a Soviet Bear and you’ve decided laundry a Brick! For us, Humans it is obvious than this idea threatens this and it’s better not to try to do it. But how unhappy Bear will know it? Well, he still has to learn what will be if to try to wash a brick.

name: ICARUS84
shortDescription: Recreate yourself and break free from the simulation, in ICARUS84, a focused retro ARPG that will take over your mind and heart, but not your life. Make the build that plays the way you want to play, unravel the mystery behind why you're trapped, and find a way out.

name: Goalkeeper VR Challenge
shortDescription: Have you ever got frustrated with a goalkeeper? Think you could do better? Congratulations, this immersive virtual reality experience offers you a challenge. Protect the gate like a pro. You can choose a standard mode for a realistic feel, as well as many alternative-ones to goof around in.

name: Ninja Code
shortDescription: Ninja Code is a simple to play, but cute turn-based strategy game set in a stunning cyberpunk virtual space. You will strategically navigate fixed spaces on a grid to avoid enemies and reach the exit or take out your target.

name: Physical Exorcism: Case 01
shortDescription: When the two exorcists, Brucie and Jade, were starving to death, a high school student named Lucy was kind enough to share food with them and hire them to protect her friend from an evil spirit. However, it turns out that the spirit has an unusual past.

name: Refill your Roguelike
shortDescription: Refill your Roguelike is a casual run and gunner, in which you battle against enemies created by the community. Traverse through procedurally generated levels filled with platforming gameplay and chaotic shootouts. Or build enemies for other players to encounter in our advanced creature editor.

name: Best Life Simulator
shortDescription: Try playing Best Life Simulator now. This game is made specially for you. What are you waiting for? Go!

name: Magical Monster Land
shortDescription: Use your platforming skills to guide Buster on an adventure to uncover secrets, collect treasure, and defeat challenging bosses!

name: Evidence of Life
shortDescription: You are a Space Traveler searching out alien DNA on distant planets. Harvest the minerals and flora of endlessly generated worlds. Destroy inhabitants you encounter. This game is a retro 2d side scrolling action game with an addictive mix of alien fighting and planet mining.

name: Miracle Circus
shortDescription: Qi joins the miracle circus as a genius magician. The other members all welcome Qi’s coming, like Liao, Liu, Ji, Xiang,Ning. But as the night is near around, something is approaching, straightly to their heart. Who is watching? And who are the demons of night exactly? Qi starts his investigation on a common day like this...

name: SUFFER
shortDescription: SUFFER is a brutally difficult retro-styled first person shooter! Become the Spirit of Anarchy and take on the police state in this horror-punk twist on classic PC gaming.

name: Elephant Rave 2
shortDescription: The rave goes on! 14 years after his first rave, the elephant has returned for monumental challenge: avoiding very, very deadly beams of light

name: Rise of the Pirates (Classic)
shortDescription: Throw yourself into a world of fantasy and create your own character to embark on an epic high seas adventure of your own making.

name: Halfway Home
shortDescription: Halfway Home is a stat-management visual novel game created by students at DigiPen Institute of Technology. As the house’s most reclusive resident, get to know the other residents, manage your time between different rooms, and improve your social skills.

name: Divenia
shortDescription: Divenia is a Retro-Futuristic Hard-to-Beat Action Sidescroller with Comic Style Graphics and SciFi Story.

name: Glo Phlox
shortDescription: Glö Phlox is a top down twin stick shooter in a deep interconnected metroidvania world. Explore a unique narrative-based experience with easy to learn combat that’s difficult to master.

name: OIL PATCH SIMULATIONS
shortDescription: A surprisingly complex and fun business strategy sim. It is more difficult than you might think. Wildcatting Oil Speculation with a Stock Market twist. Endless business sim entertainment for all ages.

name: Hang Up
shortDescription: Players find themselves in a small room with a telephone switchboard. They must complete the correct cord circuits to connect calls. In doing so they can listen in on the different conversations and uncover the unsettling secrets that make up a larger mystery.

name: Volcan Defend the Tower
shortDescription: A solo development and the first game of Processor Game Studios presents "VOLCAN defend the Tower". A third person shooter on an open world sci-fi game, play as Sollum to defend your Volcan Towers against your enemies while exploring a planet earth with nature restored

name: Mojo 2: Mia
shortDescription: "Mojo 2: Mia” is a new version of the famous game “2048”, an original approach to this well-known puzzle. Beautiful Mia will keep you company during the game. The more points you get, the less clothes remain on the girl.

name: Bitworm
shortDescription: Collect bits to grow your worm — but don't bite your tail! Outwit (and out-eat) an army of hungry ants and fast-moving centipedes in this challenging, 8-bit quarter game. Includes 10 Steam achievements.

name: Fallen Sky -Online-
shortDescription: Immerse yourself in a world after the nuclear war and experience tough adventures in the wastelands! Play online with others and experience the exciting story of Fallen Sky!

name: Dega Madness
shortDescription: Play through 15 different heroes and use your abilities as you work towards the end of an orbiting platform without being destroyed.

name: PRATAGON
shortDescription: MOBA shooter. Five heroes, two lines with creeps and towers, one forest with neutral monsters. Target: destroy enemy base. FEATURES: Headshots. Homing bullets. Shoot down enemy bullets. Neutral monsters with advanced intelligence. Rune of random ability. Flight.

name: SquareWorld Unpixeled
shortDescription: Explore a randomly generated universe full of unique planets! Build whatever comes into your mind with hundreds of blocks available! Mine for precious treasures and dungeons! Play alone or with friends, create or destroy, explore or build up a home. Choose your way of playing.

name: The Window Box
shortDescription: Wander from room to room in this whimsical and dark visual novel as you follow five friends trapped during a freak storm. Listen while they have hard conversations and tough realizations as they confront the conflict in their lives. For what is a house but a box with windows?

name: Game Master Plus
shortDescription: Game Master Plus is an expanded and streamlined RPG-Maker-MV remake of Game Master (RPG Maker VX Ace, 2014).

name: In The Dark
shortDescription: New york 1996, you play Michael Corvin a paranormal investigator. You have been contacted by the Mayor to investigate inside a former psychiatric clinic.

name: Zero spring episode 1 English translation version
shortDescription: One day she brought home the spring water. A story about mysterious water begins now. This game is an FPS game created using the GameGuru FPS engine. This is Sonic Alpha's first work.

name: Derelict (DO NOT BUY)
shortDescription: DO NOT BUY... A massive Space Station was found after 20 years of being lost, your mission is to walk among the infested interior in order to carry out your mission. Dangers beyond comprehension lurk in the shadows, be ready...

name: Another Hardcore Game
shortDescription: Just another game that you will hate but try to complete.

name: The Adventures of Team Australia
shortDescription: The Adventures Of Team Australia is a role-playing game in which you take control of Australia's favourite* ex-PM as he leads a band of conservative warriors in an insurgency against the filthy moderates who have taken control of the Liberal party.

name: VR Cricket
shortDescription: Play cricket in the VR World!Fully immerse yourself in the 3D world of Virtual Cricket!Take your mark, note the location of the fielders, watch as the bowler comes off their long runup. Listen to the crowd as their cheer get louder!You stand alone in the arena, facing your enemy.The bowler bowls the ball...

name: 心之檻
shortDescription: ——妳可以暫時收留他嗎？ 某天晚上，多年不見的好友安迪來訪，拜託妳照顧跟在他身邊的孤兒雅克。 ——突然要我照顧一個孩子，太強人所難了吧！ 合理的抱怨，合理的不滿，不過看著好友和男孩的臉孔，不合理的答案似乎才是適合的回答。 由這一刻開始，妳所做的每一個決定，都將引出不同的命運……

name: JUMP UP
shortDescription: Enter the world of Jump Up, take on the parkour challenges and discover all the secrets of the game!

name: Ancient lands: the Tsar awakening
shortDescription: Manage a squad of three heroes in the turn-based tactical game with card management.

name: Pumpkin Death Garden
shortDescription: Action-packed bug shooting game! Grow your pumpkin patch ever larger by defending it from the swarms of insects! Try out guns to find your favourite. Shotgun, sniper rifle, or assault rifle? Each has a unique play style with pros and cons, and different mods to choose from as you level up.

name: Not Heaven
shortDescription: Not Heaven is an interactive world built as a platform for Wealthy Relative's 6 song rap EP with the same title. The game experience contains 6 music videos, multiple art galleries, god-like abilities, and more. Not Heaven is the first Rap record to be released as a video game.

name: DoVille
shortDescription: Three Episodes now included! If you're looking for an adventure, look no further than DoVille VR! Whether you want to sleuth-cation on Juniper Beach, rescue Bigfoot Mountain from destruction, or time travel to Dino Gulch, there's something for everyone in DoVille VR.

name: Not My Day!
shortDescription: Every person in life had a bad day, when in an instant everything went out of hand, this story will tell about one farmer, who had what usually happens only in films of a different format.

name: Weaponry Dealer VR
shortDescription: Welcome to the gunshop tycoon game in VR. During the day, you can sell guns legally to a buyer with a valid permit and reject those who don't have a valid permit. However, at night you can sell guns illegally to the very same buyers you rejected, as long as police don't notice you, of course.

name: Super Potato Bruh
shortDescription: Super Potato Bruh is a difficult platformer that uses some elements of the bullet hell genre to create an intense platforming experience. Potato Bruh is on a journey to save Princess Lechuga from Mr. Ladle. Play through 6 worlds while dodging tons of projectiles, flying "Beef Moocows", and more!

name: Drawkanoid
shortDescription: Hyperspeed neon brick-breaking with bullet time and explosions. What more do you need? How about ludicrous powerups and multiple game modes? You're welcome.

name: Refraction
shortDescription: Refraction is a top-down, arena action game where you use quick reflexes to take down hordes of enemies. You must rely on your skill and your wit as you fight to survive, in the hope that you can live long enough to take down the core of all corruption.

name: Fit It
shortDescription: Participate in the TV show „Fit It“ where you will have to test your stamina, flexibility and even math knowledge to fit through the walls that will be coming right at you!

name: Unrest Indigo
shortDescription: The idea that all feelings have a single definition is about to change. Unrest Indigo is a first person game of the horror genre that explores the dark depths of a great change.

name: Auto Brawl Chess
shortDescription: Auto Brawl Chess is a balanced blend of Auto Chess, Idle RPG, and CCG mechanics given form on an epic battlefield! Build your unique band of heroes, level them up, and set out on a thrilling Journey into the mythical world of Pangea waiting to be saved!

name: Stream Battlecards
shortDescription: Stream Battlecards is an overlay for Twitch livestreams. Your viewers can fight against hordes of monsters or compete in Battle Royale. Your whole community may vote via chat which actions to perform and support with items.

name: Bygone Dreams
shortDescription: Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy Action-Adventure set inside a surreal dream world. Face fantastical adversaries, solve puzzles, and fight your way through challenging bosses in your quest to save the world's matron deity and stop the nightmare consuming the dream.

name: Gangsta Sniper
shortDescription: Thirdperson shooter and survival game, where player is gangsta criminal. Mission to rob and collect hidden money bags. Also avoid or kill different enemies like zombies, mutants and cyborg soldiers. Also use armored vehicle

name: Surge
shortDescription: You play as the brilliant Dr Lazarus. The newest energy source, Infinium, is used everywhere & threatens your memory. With Galatea by your side, hook & fling yourself with your mechanical arm, unlock new abilities, fight powerful bosses and stop Infinium’s progression before it’s too late!

name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space
shortDescription: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space is your game. Visit the infinite space enjoying its comfortable and intuitive interface and its relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these beautiful photos that suppose a real challenge for puzzle lovers.

name: Nice Shot! The Gun Golfing Game
shortDescription: Golf meets FPS in this unique twist on the beloved golf genre. Use a variety of guns and your skills & finesse to rack up bonus points and come in under par! But beware-- this is one golf game that won't hold your hand! Unlock courses and a secret gun in single player, or play against your friends in multiplayer!

name: Zombie Deathrace Feeding Frenzy
shortDescription: Zombie Deathrace Feeding Frenzy is the first competitive VR aquarium style game, available on PC and Android. Play against your friends on dedicated servers, or play against the single player computer generated AI and progress through the game levels and get the high score.

name: Charlie's Conscious
shortDescription: From rags to riches, a story is told of one man, a colorful metropolis, and a conscience raging with lust for money and power. Help Charlie traverse through his exciting low-poly life. Raise up from the dark depths of homelessness and become a success any way you see fit.

name: Typing Incremental
shortDescription: In Typing Incremental, type words to earn money, spend money to unlock new words. Repeat until you can prestige to gain permanent bonuses.

name: Pepper's Castle
shortDescription: A JRPG made with RPG Maker MV. Play as a mercenary from a land far away hired by Lady Clipboard to destroy all humans. Or rebel agaisnt her and aid Queen Pepper and her request to defeat all the evil monsters called Titans.

name: Be Vigilant!
shortDescription: Be Vigilant! is a multiplayer cooperative action RPG. Take your friends on an adventure across three acts. Use vehicles, find loot, fight enemies, while increasing your characters skills and equipment.

name: The Martian Job
shortDescription: Rob the first Martian casino and find out who really rules the planet! Crack a safe, break some hearts, start a revolution, or get rich beyond the stars!

name: Love at Elevation
shortDescription: Romance is as easy as one, two...three lovers! Find love and ascend to new heights in your new home of Boulder, Colorado.

name: Gilded Rails
shortDescription: It's speed dating for the railway-tycoon monopolist robber baron! To obliterate your competition, you must marry a suitable partner before time runs out.

name: Buddinpals
shortDescription: WOW! A Buddinpal! Yes, a Buddinpal of your very own. Buddinpals is a virtual pet game starring a cute race of creatures that eventually shows more depth.

name: Bad Pixels
shortDescription: Back in the days of the wild west, everything was much more rudimentary and raw. Drinking water had bits in it, shoes had holes in them, and computers only had 8-bits of processing power. With limited colors, resolution and audio, you too can relive those gritty days of old. It was Bad, Bad Pixels.

name: 阿达三国志2019  竖版 Three Kingdoms 2019
shortDescription: 最具人文气息的策略三国志游戏，正统得天下三国游戏的手机版本，三国志2013的正版续作。

name: Surrogate
shortDescription: Your memories are beyond reach, a side effect of a life-saving operation. Stationed at an oxygen production facility you must oversee an exodus to the surface. When an army of rogue security robots is unleashed you commandeer a vehicle and choose your own unique path through the facility.

name: 5 Star Miami Resort
shortDescription: Exciting Match 3 resort construction in Miami! Master linked boards, discover hidden obstacles and choose from various buildings which impact your gameplay experience.

name: SEPTEMBER 1999
shortDescription: A free, VHS styled, first-person found footage horror game, which runs exactly for 5 minutes and 30 seconds.

name: Boat Basketball
shortDescription: Boat Basketball is a wobbly basketball arcade game, where you are a boat shooting hoops on a very wobbly sea. There is a Single Player mode with 105 levels distributed amongst 11 theme areas, as well as 52 local multiplayer levels where you can play a friend as another boat.

name: Blackfoot Burrows
shortDescription: Sidescrolling. Base building. Tower defense-ing. Rabbit breeding. That kind of stuff.

name: The Curator - Prologue
shortDescription: In The Curator - Prologue you are responsible for the collection of a museum and have to excavate objects by finding search areas in order to exhibit them in the museum.

name: Armored Fighter
shortDescription: This is all directional shooting game. Edit your fighter to engage. Assemble various type of fighter. Like Balanced type, Heavy type, Speed type and so on. Get new weapon and parts by destroying enemy. Assemble your best type of fighter, and fight various enemy!

name: Oculto
shortDescription: A mining space station doesn't respond to communications. An investigator tries to find out what happened to the crew. Oculto is a zero-gravity narrative action adventure full of danger and mystery.

name: Lovecraft Quest - A Comix Game
shortDescription: 🐙Original сomics style game inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft - a recognized master of the horror genre. You have to avoid traps, solve puzzles and react very fast fleeing from Lovecraftian horrors which fill the labyrinth of the Temple of Nameless Cults.

name: Chronicles of Lurra
shortDescription: The Chronicles of Lurra is a free to play RPG set in the fictional world of Lurra. You follow Trent, the main character as he is dragged from his home through time and space to the world of Lurra.

name: Blind Girl
shortDescription: A girl who lost her eyes to the witch is weeping in the darkness. The shadow fairy heard her cries and opens his eyes. This is how their adventure starts. Will they be able to retrieve her eyes? The tale of a blind girl and her shadow fairy begins.

name: DEAD
shortDescription: a classic arcade shooter game. You can play with up to 4 people locally, or using Steam Remote play.

name: 18层
shortDescription: "18 Floors" is a psychological horror indie game set in 1930s Shanghai. Players awaken in a grand hotel, trapped as fate and soul intertwine, leading them deeper into the unknown.

name: 败家仔 Last Wish
shortDescription: This is a casual simulation game where you have a very rich dad. The goal of the game is to spend all the property your father left to you by eatting, drinking, playing and etc. Besides, you also need to fight with the other three opponents of your family. While playing the game, you also need to pay attention to their behavior.

name: Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest
shortDescription: Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest is an RPG inspired by West-European fairytales and mythology, and based on older games like Quest for Glory and Eye of the Beholder.

name: Hoyeonjigi
shortDescription: 'Hoyeonjigi' is a point-and-click adventure game with a beautiful pixel art. Play as the water strider Hoyeon, the guardian of the pond, who takes a journey to meet the Buddha with a small lotus flower.

name: Stick to the end
shortDescription: This is a well-optimized vertical plane shooting game. In this game you can use a wealth of weapons to attack enemy planes and bosses.

name: Torn Earth
shortDescription: Welcome to Torn Earth. Take a journey through post epidemic earth avoiding dangers while being actively hunted for being immune to the devastating virus.

name: Dread of Laughter
shortDescription: Dread of Laughter is a survival horror game where the player has to survive the attack of a serial killer by making choices that will either help the player or make the killer stronger.

name: Go to IT
shortDescription: Have you ever wanted to run your own software company? Go to IT is a business simulation game with a multitude of parameters to manage and meaningful choices to enjoy. Build your company and bring it to the top, surviving almost 30 years of software industry ups and downs.

name: ADK
shortDescription: A.D.K is a third-person survival horror inspired by the iconic classics of the '90s. Face ruthless enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets — every step brings you closer to the horror… and the truth.

name: TrivaTune
shortDescription: TrivaTune is a music Trivia game where users compete in a multiplayer world to prove they are the music king, you will be asked questions with multiple choice options and possibly even get an audio question where a track is played to you and you have to guess who the artist is or what the title or album are and maybe even the release year

name: Witch's Tales
shortDescription: An evil Witch turned the famous Prince into a frog! Help poor Prince remove his curse and find his lovely Princess.

name: Dream Walker
shortDescription: Sandman, the evil spirit of nightmares has trapped your husband inside his own nightmares. Do you have what it takes to save your love?

name: Corrupted Commander
shortDescription: Take command of your troops and send them into battle or if needs be lead your troops to victory! Build offence units Tanks, Jets, Annihilators or Juggernauts Defend yourself with base turrets or choppers. Send scouts to claim more resources or neutral turrets. Or just send a nuke and finish the job!

name: Emirati Tales
shortDescription: Dive into Emirati Tales, a family-friendly 3D platformer where players explore the rich folklore of the UAE while learning essential life lessons. Journey through diverse levels, face unique challenges and mythical creatures, and enjoy adaptive difficulty that suits all play styles and ages.

name: Dinosaur Safari VR
shortDescription: Go on Safari and explore a tropical island filled with awe-inspiring and dangerous Dinosaurs. Discover their secrets and experience first-hand how these wonders of a bygone world lived and died right before your very eyes!

name: Hyper Echelon
shortDescription: The Cyan Galaxy is in peril! Your trusty little star fighter and rag tag squad of wingmen are the only hope against the evil EXODON! Level up from a pea shooter to an offensive powerhouse as you engage in frantic combat across many wondrous locales.

name: Colourless
shortDescription: Once Upon A Time, There Was A land Called colourland. The citizens,praised and love the coloursphere which made everything colourful. But nobody knew... the black and white days... were about to come...

name: Flipside Genesis
shortDescription: Blast your way to fame and fortune as an independent space fighter pilot in Flipside Genesis! Each mission earns you salvage and cold hard cash. Use your riches to improve your ship and facilities... but don't forget to pay your bills or you will loose it all!

name: Temple Scramble
shortDescription: A fast-paced, asymmetrical two-player game that pits keyboard against mouse. Will you become an adventurer, exploring an ancient temple in search of valuable artifacts, or will you take control of a guardian spirit, protecting the temple's treasure from would-be thieves?

name: 3C Wonderland Coaster
shortDescription: Experience breathtaking roller coaster ride to enjoy madness in your fingertips! Pop colorful balloons, crush lip-smacking candies and shot evil creatures to come out a valiant king. Turn rags from riches in a wonderland filled with chocolate rivers and hills of candies.

name: HOT GIRLS VR
shortDescription: Welcome to the world full of beautiful, hot girls, meet them all, play with them at the party and... Do what you want. Everything depends on your imagination.

name: I'm an adventurer
shortDescription: Want to be an adventurer, but the reality is not so simple. If you can't become an adventurer, why not to be the boss of the adventurers! Set up an Adventurer's guild! chatting, hiring, solving quest, making adventurers stronger.

name: 尸如潮水
shortDescription: 开放世界探险解谜类游戏（末日丧尸，第三人称射击游戏）

name: The Masked Mage
shortDescription: The Masked Mage is a slow paced, peaceful metroidvania game focusing on exploration, atmosphere and a story about friendship, mystery and of course magic. There are no bosses to fight. Think of this as a sort of 2D walking simulator.

name: Gravity Spin
shortDescription: Gravity Spin is a tough as nails 8 bit retro metroidvania (retroidvania) with a literal spin - on gravity. Spin the world on its head and be careful not to get too confused.

name: 无敌荒野/Unbeatable wilderness
shortDescription: This is a 3D game. The game simulates a real field environment, with real day and night alternation and variable weather effects. Both in the land and underwater can catch prey, the player in the capture of prey but also beware of the attack of beasts, players can also hunt beasts.

name: Parkan: Iron Strategy
shortDescription: Parkan: Iron Strategy is a perfect mix of advanced real-time strategy and futuristic warbot simulator with FPS elements in a highly realistic environment.

name: Palace of the Azure Dragon
shortDescription: This game focus on highlighting the immersive experience of virtual reality features. For the players to bring immersive "strong interaction" gaming experience.

name: Kubble
shortDescription: Destroy all the cubes! Use the laser to launch your cubes and match your colors by 3 or more, to remove all cubes from the level to move to the next level.

name: Cosa Nostra
shortDescription: In Cosa Nostra you follow the life of a hit man for the American Mafia during the early 1980's. Complete contracts by using your own expertise, whether that be sneaking, setting up traps, or by using pure brute force. Work your way up the crime ladder through honesty or through deception.

name: Definitely Sneaky But Not Sneaky
shortDescription: Definitely Sneaky But Not Sneaky is a fast-paced action game featuring tight controls and slow-motion combat. Unlock items, customize your gear, and take out your enemies one by one! Co-op included.

name: Beat Boxers
shortDescription: Beat Boxers is the world's first Rhythm-Fighting Game. In order to win, players have to attack to the beat of the music. The closer you hit to the beat, the stronger your attacks. Keep up the rhythm and outplay your opponent!

name: Nowhere Girl
shortDescription: If you love someone, let them go. Unfortunately, you've got to love her first! That's the only way to get rid of Pseudo, the mysterious ghostly woman who has been chained to your leg! A short romantic visual novel from Wilson Taylor, the writer of the critically acclaimed dating sim Animal Lover!

name: Angelus Brand VR Experience
shortDescription: Enjoy the Angelus Brand VR Experience with a few games and a show room. Look at Angelus products while playing basketball or running through a challenging dodging game. Try to get the high score on both games for bragging rights!

name: Backyard Brawl
shortDescription: Welcome to Backyard Brawl! A third person laser tag game.

name: Symphonic Mayhem
shortDescription: A multiplayer death match with tanks. Choose the best upgrades and attempt to destroy your enemies. Can YOU survive?

name: Cuboid Keeper
shortDescription: Cuboid Keeper is a fast-paced arena shooter with a gripping storyline and an unique spaceship building system. Take control of the legendary Guardian of the Cube and face four advanced civilizations hell-bent on defeating you.

name: LOGistICAL 2
shortDescription: LOGistICAL 2 is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state or country. Thousands of towns and thousands of businesses to complete across the world. Many free sub-modules to get you started.

name: 6 Keys: The Gym
shortDescription: Please obey the school rules You're on key duty in charge of the gym. Find and organize the keys scattered in the gym and leave school. Organize your keys and organize the phenomena around you together.

name: Color by Numbers - Halloween
shortDescription: Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.

name: Color by Numbers - Christmas
shortDescription: Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.

name: Color by Numbers - Animals
shortDescription: Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.

name: DotX
shortDescription: DotX is a 'mouse only' game, where you will challenge your ability to control the mouse, as well as verify your emotional resistance. Pick up the dots and avoid bumping into the walls, as long as your health bar doesn't reach zero.

name: TEXT
shortDescription: Want to learn how to type on the keyboard at the speed of light? Then this simulator is for you! Choose 1 of 9 game types and train your typing skills!

name: BlockDoc
shortDescription: Block dock is a simple fighting type block breaking game. Let's destroy the enemy's block with items. Have fun at cheap prices

name: The Shedding
shortDescription: The Shedding is a first person horror game.An unsettling dark and disturbing game set in an abandoned prison. The game is short, about 15 minutes.Will you be able to make it through or will The Shedding be a nightmare of terror for you?

name: The Cells
shortDescription: Put the colored cubes in rows both horizontally and vertically. The completed series is erased and frees the place.

name: Zombie Soldier
shortDescription: Face off as the Zombie Soldier against the undead army. Explore graveyards and army bases to eradicate them all. Shoot, jump and destroy in this simple retro styled 2.5D metroidvania throwback game. A casual yet challenging introduction to the Zombie Soldier world.

name: Mad Cat's World. Act - 1: Not by meat alone...

name: Slime Research

name: Lost Marbles
shortDescription: Lost Marbles is a fast pace physics-based rolling platformer. The game includes 3 game modes; Time Trials, Gem Arenas and Arcade Playlists. The game is broken into 5 difficulties, so no matter your style of gaming, there will always be something to play, and every level has a global scoreboard.

name: Tippy Tree
shortDescription: Christmas is just around the corner and it’s time to decorate! Tippy Tree is a virtual reality puzzle game that has you decorate the tippiest of trees. Celebrate the holiday season with trinkets aplenty, but watch out, without careful planning, all of your work may come crashing down!

name: Ocean's Treasures
shortDescription: Ocean's Treasures is a VR underwater treasure hunt that places the player on the bottom of the sea to explore shipwrecks and recover lost treasures. Within 12 different scenes, you will be surrounded by some spectacular environment and fishes.

name: Homestead
shortDescription: Raise livestock, make friends, and have fun farming!

name: Bravado
shortDescription: Bravado is a game that will test your ability to endure waves of various enemies while fighting in a medieval arena. The advanced sword fighting mechanics creates a thrilling battle experience in the castle environment.

name: Speaking Simulator

name: Hell Breaker

name: I'm the Koala
shortDescription: In this extremely challenging 2D platformer, you'll be faced with many obstacles and enemies that need to be avoided in order to pass 10 different stages. But be warned, you only get a set amount of lives. If you run out of lives, you start at the beginning.

name: Tale of Ninja: Fall of the Miyoshi
shortDescription: Play as a ninja through the Sengoku period of Japan. There are many possible ways to assassinate the target and find your own nindou.

name: Bedtime Blues
shortDescription: They say that child’s imagination is pure and innocent, but what if said imagination becomes a nightmare? Enter the pixelate world of a young, troubled mind, and survive the night!

name: Zquirrels Jump
shortDescription: Why do Zquirrels Jump? Why do they risk their health and life? In the name and glory of the one and only true love. The love for peanuts! Join the Zquirrels, strap in and jump. You have only a few seconds before the nuts hit the ground. Make us proud, jump now!

name: Beat Blocks VR
shortDescription: Beat Blocks VR is a VR Arcade Puzzle game where your goal is to assemble blocks and make best combinations to be the best player in the world. Very innovative game, you will interact directly with shapes linked to the level soundtrack.

name: Invisible Fist
shortDescription: Create a billion-dollar startup, try to pay off your student loans or wait in the line for Food Stamps... And fight the Invisible Fist of the Free Market in this Late Capitalism Card Game!

name: Pumped BMX Pro
shortDescription: Pumped BMX Pro is the next installment in the high adrenaline, fast-paced arcade BMX trickathon. Master 60 levels and over 200 challenges while pulling off as many radical stunts as possible on one of 15 bikes.

name: Leprechaun Shadow
shortDescription: Leprechaun Shadow is an absurdist comedy point & click adventure game following Sir Typhil of Creulor as he attempts to catch a rutabaga-stealing killer leprechaun in Yorkwen city.

name: Curfew
shortDescription: Help a tired working robot to get home in the middle of a Curfew. Puzzles, hard jumps and obstacles, all while fighting killer robots . This is a homage to the 80s, retrowave style with some pounding synthwave music. Relive the good old days with this fps style gameplay

name: Cursed Mansion
shortDescription: Rose must escape the Cursed Mansion - a demonic space that preys and feeds on fear and despair. In this horror RPG you'll solve puzzles and learn the mansion’s history. Mystery, malignant spirits, and misery everywhere. Cursed Mansion brings an eerie atmosphere which leaves one with goosebumps.

name: Spark Five
shortDescription: Welcome to Project Spark. Help our little android friend navigate across multiple, challenging levels in search of bio-matter. You see, we are in desperate need of those primarily to restore human civilization and undo the damage caused by our own problem child - Artificial Intelligence.

name: Mò The Frog
shortDescription: Mo the frog is a classic 2D platform in which you will have to committ fully to ho through many levels that are present in the game. Dress the part of Mò the frog in the epic adventure to free Avalaar's kingdom from the oppression which the terrible Peter's the troll and his henchmen, the black captains, try to bring by conquering it.

name: Starfighter: Infinity
shortDescription: A space based MMORPG with a focus on ‘dogfighting’ style action and exploration. Features a huge array of ships, imaginative weapons and ship upgrades with more being added all the time. Explore the galaxy, fight other players, form your own organisations, mine asteroids to craft new items, loot rare weapons from alien races, and more...

name: Dungeons of Necromancers

name: Nights at the Clown Maze

name: Special Counter Force Attack
shortDescription: Get engaged in the Special Counter Force Attack plot to overthrow the oppressive rule of the drug cartel threatening the city. Make your way through different environments and brave the variety of tough game modes to get ever so closer towards bringing peace to the city.

name: Red Eclipse
shortDescription: Building on over 15 years of gameplay design, Red Eclipse continues to focus on fast paced, agile, easily accessible first person shooter gameplay. For creators, the full power of the Tesseract engine is at your fingertips in the included realtime multiplayer editor.

name: Microsoft Maquette
shortDescription: Microsoft Maquette makes it easy to sketch and iterate ideas quickly in 3D space. Maquette is a virtual reality tool which aims to make immersive spatial prototyping easy and fast, all from within a VR headset.

name: Galactic Incoming

name: Assault On Metaltron

name: Jump Jumpz

name: Predicate

name: Deported 2: Build That Wall

Grump, a secret agent hellbent on deporting illegal extraterrestrials from outer-space off of his home-planet! Brosie O'Shlongel is back for vengeance, and this time, this scumsucker means business!

name: Breathe Peace World

name: Perfect Life VR
shortDescription: Perfect Life VR You can relax in this perfect house. Customize your car. Customize your friend. Fire the fireplace. Just put your HMD on your head and relax. Roam in the house. Enjoy stunning visuals and relaxing sound.

shortDescription: Dynamic game in the genre of Bullet hell. Destroy your enemies dodging the hail of bullets!

name: Fururu Project : Ruby

name: Colonization of the Moon
shortDescription: Defend your homeland because of all the forces and do not let the enemy break through Prove that you can survive all the trials and save the moon !

name: Artist Idle
shortDescription: Draw pictures, sell them and become a famous artist.

name: Mine Royale - Battle Royale
shortDescription: Mine Royale - Battle Royale is the fun new blocky battle royale game. It's a fun single-player and online game! Alot of new updates are coming soon!

name: Bunny Mahjo
shortDescription: Classic Mahjong Solitaire is not single-player game anymore. You can play with friends in 3d-environment. Play together, win together, unlock more figures together.

name: Dimensum - Bizzarre Huntseeker
shortDescription: 「Run, Jump, Attack, Combo Attack, Dash !」 "Dimensum - Bizzarre Huntseeker" is a 2D Side-Scrolling Action RPG game. The variety of mysterious dimensional armies has released several bizarre creatures to attack the innocence from various worlds. Now, just get rid of them anyway.

name: A Bewitching Revolution
shortDescription: A Bewitching Revolution is a first-person adventure game about a communist witch living in a cyberpunk city. Use magic to help the city's residents organise collective forms of power and resistance!

name: Decks of Dexterity
shortDescription: The bullet hell card game! Decks of Dexterity fuses bullet hell shooter gameplay with a strategic turn based card game. Discover cards to gain abilities and unleash powerful combos!

name: Chaordic
shortDescription: Fight a horde of dark creatures that do not want you to get out of the underworld.

name: Halloween Puzzles
shortDescription: Halloween Puzzles. It‘s a clever and colorful learning experience. Puzzles are a challenging young minds, teaching and preparing them early in life some very important life skills. Halloween Puzzles will strike your imagination in assorted piece counts, shapes and levels of difficulty. Dozens of Halloween Puzzles to suit any puzzler.

name: Necro Story
shortDescription: Necro Story is a creature-collection RPG where you play as a (kind of) evil necromancer more into undead shenanigans than saving the world! Command quirky minions, outsmart foes, and snag their souls to power up your team. Expect strategic combat, laughs, and plenty of mischief.

name: Cult of the Glitch King

name: OkunoKA Madness

name: Death Space

name: Siam Twinstick
shortDescription: A badass, adrenaline pumping twinstick-shooter!

What role do I play in the story?

shortDescription: Your life is a peaceful one. Each day, you work alongside your (otherwise?) all-female workforce in the pursuit of creating otome games. Will you complete your life with a cute girlfriend? Will you be doomed to a life of normalcy? Or...? Find out in this (mostly...?) normal visual novel!

name: Descent of Man
shortDescription: Descent of Man is a stealth, survival horror game. Experience fear, a historically inspired narrative, and puzzle solving while hunted by intelligent and nightmarish enemies. Use deception to escape and unravel the dark history of a dystopian world's past and it's horrifying present.

Can you liberate the floating island world of Emerald Shores from its captors?

Gain experience and customize your equipment to show your opponents what you are worth.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Earth Chronicles

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: London

name: Steel Alcimus
shortDescription: Steel Alcimus is a top-down helicopter shooter. Complete various tasks with your ally aircraft; such as saving the carrier, taking down the buildings, carrying objects, etc.

name: Super Ninja Meow Cat

name: Circus Interstellar
shortDescription: Circus Interstellar is a brutal arcade shooter featuring high-octane action, and killer music! Earth voyagers encounter a sadistic alien race with a terrifying clownish appearance and a nasty appetite. Will the survivors escape the gory circus? Or will they be assimilated like all the rest?

name: Chaos Theory

The 'Butterfly Effect' gameplay gives you a blend of RPG, RTS, and city building in a vast open sandbox environment. Manage all aspects to secure the future of your civilisation. You only have one life, so use it wisely...

name: Christmas Carol

name: SYNTHETIK: Arena

name: Seven Chambers: Zodiac Adventure

name: Red Tractor Tycoon

name: Robozarro

name: Pocoman
shortDescription: Welcome to the world of PocoMan! A logic and strategy game featuring the clever and funny character PocoMan. A 21st century super-hero of microscopic proportions!

name: Super Crome: Bullet Purgatory
shortDescription: In the dark depths of space, an unknown threat called Purgatory has begun to consume colonies throughout the cosmos. Now it’s up to Crome, the Consul’s best star pilot, to travel into the unknown and put an end to Purgatory before it overcomes the entire galaxy.

name: Adventure Boy Cheapskate DX
shortDescription: Swap-quest adventure game, with puzzles, secrets, and humorous dialogue. A huge cast of funny, weird and thoughtful characters await, as you guide Benson, the wise-cracking teen through a journey to reclaim his stolen bike.This is the definitive version of Adventure Boy Cheapskate with new puzzles.

name: Weightless: An immersive and relaxing experience
shortDescription: Weightless is an immersive and relaxing experience. It is a beautiful game that is designed to clear your mind from any stress, by coloring and listening to music.

name: Hostile User Interface
shortDescription: Your basic get through the maze game with a twist, your controls have been designed in a way to trip you up by triggering different Windows Hotkeys such as Alt + F4 or Ctrl Alt Del.

name: Chess Sphere
shortDescription: Chess Sphere is online multiplayer.

name: Trinoline Genesis
shortDescription: Trinoline Genesis continues with all new stories for the original and side heroines of the original Trinoline!

name: Mech Merc Company
shortDescription: Mech Merc Company is a 90s style mech combat simulator with business management elements. Buy and sell mechs, customize your mechs, hire and fire AI pilots, manage your business expenses, and complete tactical objective-based missions.

name: Strike of Horror
shortDescription: Scary game PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK

name: Battles For Spain
shortDescription: This game represents Four Battles of the Spanish Civil War, battles of Ebro, Teruel, Guadalajara and Merida or La Serena. Players can play as Nationalists, Republican or both in player vs player game. Unit size is battalion for infantry and cavalry, company or battalion for armoured cars or tanks, batteries for artillery and squadron for...

name: It'sRoachTime!
shortDescription: It'sRoachTime! - is a hardcore, third person 3D online pvp fighting arena game! Fight as a mutant cockroach in real time insect simulator, find your way to survive, destroy them all!

name: Nightmare Trails
shortDescription: Fight off monsters in a national park and send them back to their own dimension!

name: Magician of Fire
shortDescription: Burn enemies with the power of fire!

name: Tecroroid Assault
shortDescription: A synthetic race has come to your planet to steal your technology, And you have to fight them off. Fight off the Tecroroid invasion as they sent wave after wave of enemies to the planet.

name: Rocket Golf - Drive
shortDescription: Rocket Golf is a game that brings a new dimension to the traditional game of golf. Choose a launcher instead of a club. Pull a trigger instead of taking a swing. Through the game we take you from classic courses to environments you never imagined playing golf within. Thanks for coming!

name: The Black Widow
shortDescription: Communicate with the dead using a spirit board to solve an actual murder case in this interactive mystery. Ask your own questions to determine whether “the Black Widow” was truly guilty … or unjustly executed.

name: Alien Jelly: Food For Thought!

name: Potion Paws
shortDescription: You’ve decided to take the risk and purchase a run down house in the middle of a spooky forest near a dungeon overrun with monsters.

name: Three Kingdoms：Ancient battlefield | 三国古战略
shortDescription: 这是一款三国开房间即时联机游戏，玩法上你可以想象以前我们所玩的《三国群英传》或其它单机攻城类三国游戏的一种联机化改编，游戏可以多人对战，混战，组队打电脑等，一局时间在10~60分钟之间，具体视不同模式而定，比如混战会久一点，因为你要打败大部分对手，争取高分，而对战就短一点，因为对方一旦弱势可能就认输了。总之这个游戏玩法经过我2年多的折腾，现在结构算比较合理，当然里面也包含了一般的养成元素，游戏免费，但充钱玩的舒服无法避免，不过我尽量控制平衡（作者提示里说的内容），总的来说游戏倾向玩家自身技术硬实力，花钱为辅助，游戏中最强的玩家一般是弱氪，但很擅研究的人，整体比例是（技术70%）（氪金30%），我不隐瞒任何收费情况，真实坦荡，所以喜欢的就请加入进来吧。

name: Darkheart: Flight of the Harpies
shortDescription: Challenge the evil presence in this magic Hidden Object Adventure game. An evil mage sent his Harpies to seize a fresh supply of souls. This time they took your parents! Only you can save them and defeat the dark mage.

name: Color Knight

name: Woodfel
shortDescription: Welcome to Woodfel! This untamed fantasy land is yours to explore as you go forth in search of adventure. Discover treasures, fight monsters and build amazing things as you and your friends travel the landscape!

name: The Trials of Olympus
shortDescription: A thrilling match-3 game that tells the story of Angelo, a young god from Olympus. Banished to the mortal realm, Angelo must prove his worth to the Grecian king by building the most majestic palace. Play 79 thrilling match-3 levels in 5 unique worlds.

name: Secret Savings
shortDescription: Oh my god, my wife robbed my property!! She has hidden them everywhere in my house. I'll get them all back!! VR-only treasure hunting(?) adventure game.

name: Esc: From Planet

name: EF Universe: Reclaiming the World

name: Hunter

name: Amanda's Sticker Book

name: Fall In Love - My Billionaire Boss

shortDescription: What! My house is occupied!" Our male protagonist utters an incredible howl. He clearly lives happily in his big house. His parents can work outside all the year round, but they are occupied by three sisters in the best three bedrooms. Liao Feiluo, Xiang Yuyao and Zhu Nanjun! What are you three doing?

name: Geeksos

name: Super president How to rule the country

name: Kadath

name: Jewel Puzzle Click

name: Coffee VendoR

name: VortX

name: Dark Sauce

name: M.E.M.E.S.

name: Echoes of the Past: The Citadels of Time Collector's Edition

name: Redemption Cemetery: Children's Plight Collector's Edition

name: Maestro: Dark Talent Collector's Edition

name: Death Leak

name: Dark Data

name: Quest for the Golden Duck

name: Cryptofall: Investor simulator
shortDescription: Cryptofall is an investment simulator. Start as a trader during a cryptocurrency boom and explore all the possible ways to invest your wealth. Trade and even mine trending cryptocurrencies, growing your mining pool.

name: Watch Me Stream My Mental Breakdown
shortDescription: Deckbuilder in a Visual Novel form. Embark on an epically misguided quest to streamer stardom! Play games all day, keep your mental health above zero, and prove your father wrong by grinding your way up to a minimum wage... also pay rent. Mental breakdown guaranteed!

name: Pilot Sports
shortDescription: Rise through tropical air with PILOT SPORTS and master airplanes, jetpacks, hang gliders and parachutes. Get together to form a group of up to 4 friends on a couch for maximum multi-player party fun. The sky’s the limit? No way!

name: 7th Sea: A Pirate's Pact
shortDescription: Fight for what's right—as an up and coming pirate! Battle slavers, sea monsters, and your own corrupt government to become a hero of the high seas. But will you betray your own crew for wealth and power?

name: 持猫少女凯蒂/Kaidi, armed with a cat
shortDescription: A game about a girl, who is armed with her cat as a gun, fighting with aussie animals. This silly game offers you a once in a life time chance to misunderstand life in Australia!

name: LCD Sports: American Football

name: A Christmas Peril

Players are engaged in a snowball fight through colorful and snowy arenas, frantically tossing snowballs at anything that moves. Jump, duck, hide and try to land that perfect shot to cover your opponent in snow.

name: RockTop

name: 天火(TianHuo)

name: Final_SIM

name: Diggerman
shortDescription: Dig, dig, dig! For love, for fame, for money! Fast arcade digging game with story, treasures and boss fight! Let’s dig together, let’s find some treasures, let’s put them on the ground and make some money!

name: Where the Bees Make Honey
shortDescription: Where the Bees Make Honey tells a story about reflecting on different moments from a childhood, which are played and experienced from an adult perspective. At its core Where The Bees Make Honey is a narrative puzzle adventure game, with playable childhood moments filtered throughout.

name: The Demon Crystal
shortDescription: The Demon Crystal, produced in 1984 by YMCAT, achieved great success as the pioneer of the action RPG genre and became a nation-wide hit. The first game in a trilogy, it is known as a "legendary game."

name: Mars Flight VR
shortDescription: Mars Flight VR is a helicopter simulator that lets you explore Jezero Crater, the landing site of Perseverance rover on mars.

name: Twisting Mower
shortDescription: Lawn mower cart race!? This is race game that competes by time attack with people around the world. The place where you cut the lawn can run fast. Let's aim for the fastest record on the changing track. Run with the ghost of the time attack record of players all over the world and aim for the ranking first place!

name: Diamonds
shortDescription: Pick up diamonds as they fall from the sky, shoot enemies to make them drop the diamonds they've gathered, and bring the spoils back to your base to win.

name: Casual Desktop Game
shortDescription: Casual Desktop Game is a fanmade revival of the old Desktop Destroyer game featuring community content. Relieve stress by smashing your desktop or unleashing battles between various entities. Create mods for the workshop and share them with the community.

name: RoboVirus
shortDescription: Enjoy chaotic multiplayer with your friends in a game filled with dynamic level mechanics, different robots and weapons that you annihilate your friends with!

name: aMAZE Valentine
shortDescription: aMAZE Valentine is a straightforward and surprisingly - difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with romantic art and calm soundtrack.

name: Fused
shortDescription: NF-01, A Nanobyte who refers himself as Nigel, is spawned after a cascade failure within the Skystar System. His duty is to navigate through the system levels to fix the fuses, avoid the damaged shock traps and bring the system back online.

name: Tau Cubis
shortDescription: Tau Cubis is a mazing tower defense game set in colorful sci-fi landscapes. Use your strategic skills to overcome numerous challenges and advance through the leaderboards.

name: Zibbs - Alien Survival
shortDescription: Zibbs - Alien Survival is an open world game where you play as an alien trying to survive on the unknown planet - Earth.

name: Rhythmy
shortDescription: "Rhythmy" is a new arcade-style rhythm bullet hell game, try to dodge and survive many levels while listening to Thaehan, F-777, Boom Kitty and more! If you're seeking for some hardcore bullet hell challenge, while listening to some epic music, you better be ready!

name: Archeo: Shinar
shortDescription: Explore the deepest caves with a cup of tea in your hand, reach the heart of the jungle with your finger on a globe, send your highly educated employees to uncivilized tribes and don't let them convince you it's a certain death! The worst case scenario? You will hire new ones.

name: WARED
shortDescription: There is a belief that wars are won by soldiers. But sometimes, wars are won long before even beginning. Have mode 1v1 to play with friend at evening.

name: SPITLINGS
shortDescription: Frantic Gameplay, Juicy Visuals, Hypnotic Beats: SPITLINGS is a cute but unforgiving Hardcore Arcade Game for 1 - 4 players in which you waggle through a gauntlet of bouncy bubbles.

name: Rebellion Again
shortDescription: A short demo featuring a single procedurally-generated level, in which you need to eliminate the occupying enemy soldiers. An intriguing tactical action thriller is intended as the final game

name: Negligee: Love Stories (all ages)
shortDescription: A series of four stories following the characters Karen, Charlotte, Sophie and Jasmin in their early lives as they have to choose what they really love and what path their lives will take.

name: AUSSIE BATTLER TANKS
shortDescription: Multiplayer ww2 tanks fps and 3d shooter game, and rated as fun.7 ww2 tanks, 2 to 12 players with hassle free multiplayer hosting on cloud network , 3 game modes and 5 ww2 maps.Physics tracks and hit point damage system with AP and HE shells.Not pay to win with expencive ammo unlike some other tank game.

name: Vasilis
shortDescription: Vasilis is a hand-drawn adventure game. The main character – Vasilis, lost her husband – Peter, in the rebellious city center. The city is in riots for a long time and almost everyday something burns or someone dies.

name: 孤岛(Isolated Island)
shortDescription: 这是一款玩家扮演主人公，探寻世界中各个孤岛，并聆听他们故事的游戏。整个游戏由大量的对话组成，影射了现实世界中的很多东西。没人是座孤岛，每个人的命运都紧紧相连。

name: War of Three Kingdoms
shortDescription: This is a strategy type game, players can capture the city, the final one continent, in this process, players can collect hundreds of heroes, different heroes have different skills and abilities, you can also train the hero, build a strong army.

name: PiiSim
shortDescription: This game with absurd humor. Pee on everyone, destroy the city! Make apocalypse!

name: The Far Kingdoms: Elements
shortDescription: "The Far Kingdom: Elements" is a mixture between Match3 and hidden object game. Find the essential elements and stop the evil enchantress Morgana by helping princess Arianna to remove the curse from her kingdom!

name: 某1种青春
shortDescription: 平淡无奇的校园青春类文字游戏！在拥有非常多奇怪社团的育仁中学里，有着名为「冲饭堂社」这样匪夷所思的社团。围绕着社团存亡以及各种各样的青春问题，共有5+1种剧情分支！当然，还有男主角的高中生活到底如何？这里一定有属于你的某1种青春。

name: The Childs Sight
shortDescription: See the word through the innocent eyes of a small child. Slowly unravel the story of what has happened, while you were laying in your crib, observing the world around you... Something’s may remain faded but one story sticks with you to this very day.

name: バグダス - デバッガー検定 -
shortDescription: 架空のゲームに仕込まれたバグを探して出す、ゲームデバッガーの気分が味わえるゲームです。

name: The Five Cores Remastered
shortDescription: Heavily inspired by the 90s graphic puzzle games, The Five Cores Remastered is a surreal and poetic adventure that you can explore in VR.

name: Agartha
shortDescription: Agartha is an puzzle platformer where you play various adventurers carving out their way through countless levels using very limited resources.

name: Fantastic Creatures
shortDescription: Mythological Units. Ancient China. Experience a turn-based 4X strategy game where the land around you is slowly dying. Incarnate one of the four Fantastic Creatures: Dragon, Tiger, Turtle or Vermilion Bird and fight for survival.

name: HOSHIOMIO -Stella Attacks-
shortDescription: Blast away the glowing aircraft descending from the night sky with your cannons and missiles. Construct your base and fight your way through countless stages, facing off against cosmic spiritual entities and colossal battleships. A mysterious mode fused with mini-games also awaits.

name: Condors Vs Ocelots
shortDescription: Condors and Ocelots have been at war for generations. Customize your army to reign supreme in this Tactics RPG focused on customizable armies!

name: Roulette Simulator 2
shortDescription: Roulette Simulator 2 is the redesigned fan-favorite simulation that allows players to enjoy a modern Roulette gambling experience. Players can continue to experience the thrills of roulette in real-time as the roulette wheel is back in the second edition of Roulette Simulator!

name: M.C.I. Escapes
shortDescription: M.C.I. Escapes: Solve a miracle to help a friend you haven't even met before, as you journey through Space & Time - In your Mind.

name: The Spell - A Kinetic Novel
shortDescription: After the death of her parents, Eloise is forced to live with her uncle. Though she’s reluctant to the idea, she soon finds out that it’s not nearly as bad as she had envisioned. That is, until she found a weird note concerning her parents’ deaths next to the garbage bin.

name: Eggys Games Flash Collection
shortDescription: The Eggys Games Flash Collection is a gigantic collection of all games released by Eggys Games which includes 22 full games! This is the collection of over 10 years of work that have been released over the years.

name: HA/CK
shortDescription: HA/CK will puzzle your mind with a variety of challenging levels. You have to solve a series of tests devised by The Programmer. Devise unforethought solutions to achieve top times amongst your friends or worldwide.

name: Cell Defender
shortDescription: Four warriors take risks in the human body. They will encounter many enemies from outside, including bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites and so on. They will also face infected cells and cancer cells. Finally, they will strive to wipe out the enemy and usher in victory.

name: N-GON
shortDescription: An acid trip back to classic vector arcade action games with the unique bullet magnet mechanic. Dodge ruthless attacks, bend your projectile trajectory, destroy waves of enemies with the massive explosion chains. Die a lot! Then try again and get yourself to top of the leaderboards

name: Temple of Pizza
shortDescription: Deliver pizzas to a mysterious party taking place in a previously abandoned temple in the woods.

name: AWAKE - Definitive Edition
shortDescription: It was supposed to be a romantic trip… but turned into a brutal murder scene. When Marc and Caroline planned their romantic getaway, they didn’t know that it would turn their lives into jeopardy. Can you find a way to prevent this terrible crime and put the murderer to justice?

name: Puttin' Around
shortDescription: Ever wanted to experience life as a golf ball? Well now you can! In Puttin' Around, putt yourself across various custom physics-defying worlds! Enjoy friendship-ruining victories with custom maps and game types.

name: SOF - RAIDERS
shortDescription: Special Operations Forces / Raiders - Restore the balance of power. The enemy will adapt, we offer a challenge to the right operator. This is a First Person Shooter with Role Play elements where your choices matter. Take the right mission at the right time or face the consequences.

name: Hand of Horzasha
shortDescription: When a headstrong knight from the sealed-off human world witnesses the neglect of an orphaned child, she abandons her former life as an explorer to protect her newly adopted daughter in life-risking ritual combat in a strange town of monsters. Let our search for "Horzasha" begin!

name: Ordo Et Chao: New World
shortDescription: Inspired by famed series like "The Settlers", "Battle for Middle-Earth", "Anno" and "Age of Empires", Ordo Et Chao is a solo-player strategy game combining elements of real time strategy, resource management and city building.

name: Tsumi
shortDescription: Tsumi is a small arena-type action game where you try to survive as many waves of monsters as you can. Slash your way through the foes and delve into some dark secrets of this world.

name: Latte Stand Tycoon
shortDescription: Come, join Maya and Mia as they attempt to restore an old family home, and assimilate into the town of Falling Leaves as you learn to mix the perfect latte to fit the ever-changing weather. Can you become a master barista, and change the mood of an ever-gloomy town?

name: 古战三国 Ancient War: Three Kingdoms
shortDescription: 《古战三国》是一款回合制战棋游戏，玩家可以招募武将、组建军队，使用多样化的技能和丰富多变的战斗策略击败敌人。剧情战役完整重现了三国历史，匹配对战能够与其他玩家一决高下。创新的战斗玩法与独树一帜的美术风格碰撞，给你带来全新的三国游戏体验！

name: Magus Over Fool

name: Galaxity : Beta VR

name: Twisty Puzzle Simulator
shortDescription: Play in 2D or VR with a virtual toy box filled with over 50 original puzzles.

name: The Last Dinner
shortDescription: "The Last Dinner" is a horror experience based on virtual reality technology. The game uses the first perspective to bring an immersive horror experience. In the game, the player will use the handle to control the protagonist to explore the villa in the mountains, and unravel the horror secret buried in the villa in the guide.

name: War of Tanks: Blitzkrieg
shortDescription: Real-time tank RPG game. It recreates the classic tanks of World War II and restores the shocking war scenes with fantasy World War II plots. Command your futuristic tanks across history and rekindle your war spirit with the will of iron and blood.

name: Gravity Panda
shortDescription: Gravity Panda is a platform game that changes the direction of gravity and resolve the puzzle.

name: Freefall 3050AD
shortDescription: Tony Takoushi Presents... Freefall 3050AD - The first game where you can move,spin, shoot and airbrake while taking out the bad guys! '... There really isn’t anything quite like it out there in the wide world of video games that I have ever played.'

name: Symploke: Legend of Gustavo Bueno (Chapter 3)
shortDescription: Symploké: Legend of Gustavo Bueno is a classic point and click adventure set in a Spanish university and inspired in one of the most influential contemporary philosophers in the world. Play Chapter 3 ONLY if you got through Chapter 2.

name: Clicker Warriors
shortDescription: Get ready to battle the army of darkness. Join other players and lead your warriors to victory! Choose your strongest warrior and take an endless journey to defeat creatures of darkness. Improve your warriors, upgrade your items and progress through the infinite universe of Clicker Warriors.

name: Alluna and Brie Re-Tentacled
shortDescription: The definitive edition of the cult classic Aussie RPG! Alluna and Brie Re-Tentacled is a massive overhaul of the original game, featuring new bosses, way faster load times and heaps of quality of life improvements. It's the same great game but now with more tentacles!

name: Groomer
shortDescription: Groomer is a relaxing simulation game where take on a role of groomer, a person that takes care of dogs.

name: TRANSIT
shortDescription: You are not the chosen one who will save the world. You are just a person who is hoping for salvation.

name: Alpacapaca Double Dash
shortDescription: The characters of the books started fighting to decide who will become the protagonist of the story! Control Sophie and Elise's familiars, the Alpacas, and enter inside books to dispel the curse by choosing the side of the story you believe is the correct one.

name: AIRA VR
shortDescription: You believed tower defense is only about building towers? That's not quite right – because AIRA VR is not like other tower defense games in virtual reality. Once the battle starts you find yourself in the midst of the fight!

name: Be A Lord
shortDescription: Easy entertainment for everyone. Kill enemies in fantasy world.

name: Graywalkers: Purgatory
shortDescription: Graywalkers Purgatory is a turn-based strategy RPG set in a supernatural post-apocalyptic world where Heaven and Hell merged with Earth. You play the prophesied hero who is destined to gather all of the Graywalkers, and together lead the war to retake earth from its supernatural conquerors.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Journeys in Middle-earth
shortDescription: A companion app for The Lord of the Rings: Journeys in Middle-earth board game from Fantasy Flight Games, a fully-cooperative board game for one to five players! This companion app dictates the setup of each encounter, tracks your party’s inventory and skills, and resolves combat while you brave the looming forests, quiet clearings, and...

name: Terrorarium
shortDescription: Terrorarium is a 3D puzzle platformer about wanton destruction & adorable gore across a galaxy of community-designed murder gardens. Conquer dangerous alien worlds as a feisty granny with a chip on her shoulder and an army of cute but expendable walking mushrooms.

name: DESOLUS
shortDescription: Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game. Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes. Travel through time to make structures whole and save the city from ruin.

name: cat notebook
shortDescription: explore a cat notebook

name: 学院英雄梦 HeroDreamOfSchool
shortDescription: Return to the school world, explore different experiences, and get back to the campus time! What are you waiting for? Here you can find what you want and do what you want!

name: Crumbling World
shortDescription: Bridging the gap between old-school dungeon crawlers (Diablo I), arcade RPGs (Ghouls’n’Ghosts) and combo-driven fighters, Crumbling World is a casual dive into dark fantasy.

name: NashBored
shortDescription: NashBored is a surreal RPG in a dark and unique world.Nash just wont wake up. The dream goes deeper and deeper.What lies beyond the veil of your conscious thought? Who are you, really? Discover the truth of your dream reality.

name: Abandonment
shortDescription: Kevin found his wife missing when he returned home from a business trip. He was worried that his wife would be kidnapped by a "pregnant killer". Kevin decided to set out to find his wife and uncover the truth behind her kidnapping.

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger
shortDescription: Enjoy a beautiful collection of Hidden Object Scenes and puzzles set in the great outdoors. Tidy up the Park and do your bit for the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to Recycle. Earn extra bonuses for finding all the Lost & Found items scattered around the Park

shortDescription: CrossTrix is a crossword based puzzle game, where you are given 20 mystery letters which are revealed individually each turn. Each player is given 3 re-rolls that they may use across the match to re-roll a letter revealed for the chance at more matches on screen.

name: Sky Labyrinth

name: Soko Loco Deluxe
shortDescription: Soko Loco Deluxe is a cute train tycoon! 🚂🧱🎁💎 Transport resources, develop towns and build a giant monument! Choo-choo!

name: Aether Way
shortDescription: Aether Way is a 2D space RTS with action/roguelike elements. You play as some abstract life form that travels across the space and evolves.

name: Cold Silence
shortDescription: This is a minimalistic horror platformer about survival adventures at snowy mountains. Follow the mysterious voice from the radio, fight your fears and reveal the truth!

name: Dark Sun Pictures' Dark Sun - The Space Shooter
shortDescription: New free shooting game (almost free). Dark Sun is an Arcade RPG space shooter. Get a chance for legendary gear in one short raid for an upcoming full 3D MMORPG done via Amazon's Lumberyard engine.

name: Gravity Ace
shortDescription: Gravity Ace is a 2D twin-stick where you fight gravity in space caves. Descend into dark caverns, fly and blast your way past enemies, retrieve the reactor core and make your escape, all while fighting the deadly embrace of crushing gravity. Do you have what it takes, pilot?

name: Sky of Destruction

Your goal is to destroy the enemy aircraft carrier or buildings, breaking through the enemy air armada. Explosions and total destruction!

name: Invasion Zero
shortDescription: Invasion Zero is a multi-player online free to play first-shooter game where you are able to play against enemy AI bots or players from all over the world.

name: De Profundis
shortDescription: Un visual novel d’horreur qui se déroule dans le noir complet, où les paroles des personnages sont mises en musique.

name: Card Brawl
shortDescription: A mix of Сard games and Roguelikes. Fight with monsters, craft your unique deck and kill bosses. Try experimenting with different combinations and strategies to complete all raids. Start monster hunting in this new deckbuilding game!

shortDescription: Hilarious adventure game in cartoon style.

name: Maze 3D
shortDescription: moving from green to red, can move forward, backward, left, right, up and down, A total of 10 levels, 3 modes, 2 types, The first game will randomly generate a maze, and automatically load in next play, or randomly generated again if you want.

name: Area Cooperation Economic Simulation: North Korea (ACES)

name: Paper Cut Mansion
shortDescription: In this papercraft roguelite, explore a mysterious mansion floor by floor. Solve puzzles, battle enemies and complete quests as you unlock new abilities to aid you on each run as you solve the mystery behind the Paper Cut Mansion.

name: The Chronicles of Jonah and the Whale
shortDescription: A classic tale is brought to life in match3 game "The Chronicles of Jonah and the Whale". Follow Jonah as he goes from being an ordinary man to a true prophet of God in this memorable story of obedience, mercy, and forgiveness.

name: DownStream: VR Whitewater Kayaking
shortDescription: DownStream is a high-speed whitewater kayak racing game. Feel the thrill of paddling through beautiful landscapes, down awesome drops and through high-speed drifts. Gain XP for stunts and collect powerups to top the leaderboards or just enjoy the scenery and paddle DownStream.

name: Stickman Racer Road Draw 2
shortDescription: Stickman Racer Road Draw 2 is a legendary survival game where you have to do cool stunts on different vehicles.

name: Everpath

Embark yourself as a member of the Northbarrow army, choose and personalize your class to find what is lurking in the wilderness of Northbarrow

name: Microwasp Seekers
shortDescription: Pilot a BeeBot and keep the Seeker Mothership happy by defragmenting a constantly filling hard drive to chill synthwave beats!

name: Find-Life EP1

name: KungFu Kickball

name: Noel's Hope
shortDescription: If you are interested in magic, dark and dangerous dungeons with traps and enemies, unusual islands, bright weather conditions, mysteries, stories, sea voyages on your own ship, hiding deep secrets through the ocean, then this adventure is for you!

name: PsyOps Solutions

name: Argonauts Agency: Golden Fleece

name: Fabulous - Angela's True Colors

name: Fabulous - New York to LA
shortDescription: Will Angela's expansion into LA turn into a Walk of Fame, or a Walk of Shame?

name: Pixel Puzzles Trivia

name: Pixel Puzzles World War II Jigsaw Puzzles
shortDescription: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

name: Pixel Puzzles Musical

name: Pixel Puzzles Illustrations & Anime Jigsaw Puzzles
shortDescription: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

name: Snake vs Snake

name: The Polynesian Cultural Center VR Experience

name: Myths and Legends - Card Game
shortDescription: Battle other Guardians leading your favorite mythological, historical and literary characters in this adaptation of the popular TCG game Myths and Legends. Collect the cards, build the perfect strategy and crush your enemies.

name: Mental House

name: Cubians: Combine

It's a fantastic world created from the charming characters made with Voxel and the unique atmosphere, and the individuality of Cubian who can make various things through assembly.

Will you be the one to shoulder the burden of this mission, and persist in this cruel and dangerous world in order to shape its future?

Club Soccer Director PRO 2020 puts you in charge of the whole club, can you handle the pressure?

name: Wrecked Destruction Simulator

Make it happen Want to see an F1 car slam through a cow and ploy through a TV? Make it happen While in Early Access, the game will be updated 100% based on the community.

Speed and a good strategy are needed to rebuild the pirate ship and save Bobby in time.

name: Trucking

Easy? No! With different scoring categories, you can spend all night trying to get a new best score.

name: SUBARACITY

Find Lily.

name: 420 Button Clicker

name: BAD BILLY 2D VR

name: My Fair Princess

Overcome the deadly traps, figure out the secrets deep within from an untold past, converse with friendly spirits imprisoned within the dungeon to guide and cheer you on your adventure.

name: Coloring Game

name: Ultra Fight Da ! Kyanta 2

name: FIREGROUND Modern War

Rampage through a massive circular space station. Grab, stab, block, throw, and devour your enemies! More than run and shoot: improvise and CREATE!

Compete to do as many squats as you can, create your own custom workout routines, unlock flashy cosmetic items, try out a brand new exercise, and more...all while supporting charity!

name: Robohazard 2077

name: Bikini Surfer Girl - Wild Wahine
shortDescription: A cool arcade surfing game with lots of options and loads of fun!

name: Wampee Helicopters

name: Supernova Tactics
shortDescription: Customize your army with different traits and items. Unlock permanent upgrades to go deeper in this survival Auto-Battler/Roguelite hybrid!

name: It's Fun To Break Things

name: Mazania

name: Shmup Moments

With arcade-like gameplay, slick controls and sound, hot beats and lighting, and a classic bullet hell ambience, it's the perfect game to chill out with when you need a break from AAA titles, or to meditate with before going to bed.

name: FIL

Will you persevere and discover what purpose this testing serves? Includes over 40 levels and multiple puzzle mechanics.

name: Maze Ninja
shortDescription: With Maze Ninja, you become the hero! Navigate difficult mazes while slaying monsters that try to stop in your tracks. Sounds easy? Prove it! Maze Ninja features a variety of beautiful mazes and atmospheric soundtracks that will unleash your inner Ninja!

name: Fly Flew Flown
shortDescription: Fly Flew Flown is a game about flying with risk, collecting power ups and scoring points to make upgrades in the endless maps.

name: ZooKeeper
shortDescription: Become a Zoo Keeper, manage and build the zoo of your childhood dreams! Take care of the animals and create ideal conditions for them. Grow your zoo, add extraordinary species and prepare amazing attractions for visitors.

name: Sin; Vengeance
shortDescription: In this SRPG, you play as a man out to get revenge for his lost home. But how much of his own humanity is he willing to sacrifice to satisfy this yearning? You will make a crucial choice that determines the ending, as he faces demons within and without.

name: World Peace Simulator 2019

name: Speedrun Ninja

She is in fact kidnapped by border-line admirers who have set out to revive her career through the emotions she has made them feel.

name: Spare Teeth VR
shortDescription: Are you tired of bowling on the same greased up wooden planks? Do you love golf but hate rules? Does your heart yearn to throw a bowling ball at something other than a boring old set of pins? Do you love pineapples, trekking through fresh Alpine snow, and The Price is Right?

Uratuj Kiarę z rąk tajemniczego porywacza, rozpraw się z plagą Bot Of Legends i graczami strzelającymi zza pleców z bojowym okrzykiem NO PAL SIĘ KONIU! W końcu połóż kres sekcie JD z pomocą Nervariena, Kubona, Arquela i Kiary.

The task of the player-learner is to quickly identify characters that move across a playing field and match them to their respective reading and meaning.

shortDescription: Hardcore puzzle solving infused with roguelike action. Think quick on your feet and bring life back to Earth after a mysterious AI accident. Can you use your brain while being chased around by malfunctioning robots?

name: Bandits

name: VR Ping Pong Pro

Test your skills with a variety of challenging game modes, as you rise up the ranks to become the true Ping Pong Pro! Do you have what it takes? Pick up your virtual racket and find out!

Your only hope to save your homeworld is to activate the Seed of Life and rekindle the sun once again. Will you be the light that conquers the darkness?
