name: Aegis Online
shortDescription: Aegis Online is the virtual tabletop for all your game night needs. For classic role playing games, traditional wargaming, and more! Aegis Online has the tools to bring your friends to the table even when they can't be in the room.

name: Dominion

Discover the game that defined a genre, Dominion was first to popularize deck-building and remains a staple of tabletop. This is the officially licensed implementation.

name: Climatic Survival: Northern Storm
shortDescription: Northern Storm is a build strategy game where a blizzard comes along and destroys your builds. After climate change caused a deadly cold storm, survival can only be achieved through strict management of resources. Remember that I am only one developer without a team, so don't expect a large game.

name: The Ai Games
shortDescription: Ever wonder why cockroaches can't be irradiated? They re-spawn. Earth is a survival game made by cockroaches. You are selected to represent the Earth game as its AI champion vs the greatest AI in all the games they have made. Will you survive the games, and what AAA conspiracy will you uncover?

Since the enemy's attack sign is expressed visualiy,you'll not receive unreasonable damage and can avoid all attacks if you are an expert.

name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
shortDescription: Take to the skies in Choppa: Rescue Rivals! Pilot daring rescue missions in a Saturday-morning-anime story mode packed with high-stakes action, colorful characters, and a globe-trotting adventure. Save lives, outfly rivals, and become a legendary ace pilot!

name: Please adopt me. # AI needs repair.
shortDescription: The AI system has failed for unknown reasons. AI has lost its memory, and the system seems to have a secret that we don't know. Use your console system and play 3 games to repair your AI system! To repair it with AI, Spend more time with AI, and find the secrets.

name: Markov Alg
shortDescription: Markov Alg is a puzzle game where you can change the game field according to instructions that are written on the game field

name: The Battles of Spwak 2
shortDescription: A game with Unique Standard Turn-Based Battles, multiple Worlds and dozens of hidden Skills that allows for free redistribution of the Party Members' Stats and Skills. Help Spwak escape from the dimension he has been trapped at.

name: Goosebumps Dead of Night
shortDescription: In Goosebumps Dead of Night, the best-selling Goosebumps franchise has been reimagined as a first person spooky survival adventure game for PC. Experience three chapters of gameplay with 3D graphics and chilling AI monsters. Conquer the all new Extreme Mode! With more frights and challenges!

name: Zapitalism
shortDescription: Become a tycoon by starting with a tiny store and building a retail empire!

name: Profitania
shortDescription: Become a manufacturing mogul by starting with a tiny factory and building an industrial empire!

name: DE:VOID
shortDescription: An adventure psychological horror game which explores the themes of life and death in a unique way. Help a girl in the capsule to find her memories and escape from a mysterious world.

name: Gangsta Sniper 3: Final Parody
shortDescription: Last part of gangsta shooter series. Destroy enemies and finish levels in this meme shooter by finding magic key..

name: Lab 7: Cold Nights
shortDescription: In LAB 7: Cold Nights - wise foresight decides on the outcome of your fate. Wasted coins, reckless use of electricity, and poor time management will lead to your demise. Explore your surroundings, build defenses and fight your way to freedom.

name: VELVETIST: Prototype
shortDescription: VELVETIST prototype introduces the vision of a third person action open world adventure game set in an old, socialist occupied town of the second half of the 20th century. Prototype contains only a basic structure on top of which we wish to build the VELVETIST: The City Of Machineguns.

name: War Trains
shortDescription: The world as we knew it has been destroyed by the apocalypse... But the railroads have survived the war. And now you need to survive the post-apocalyptic era with their help.

name: Slapshot: Rebound
shortDescription: Slapshot: Rebound is a physics-based multiplayer game where you play an arcade style match of hockey. No shoot button, no puck glue, no RNG. It’s up to you and your team to take control of the puck, pass, shoot, outplay your opponents. Play with your friends or team up with other Slapshot players!

name: Kira's Contract
shortDescription: In order to defeat the dark creatures, the seer named Kira signed a blood contract with Ilgralun, a prisoner of darkness. Now they both become one to fight together against the forces of darkness.

name: Dominus Galaxia: KS Edition
shortDescription: Dominus Galaxia is a 4X space strategy game with a focus on amplifying strategic decisions and minimising non-strategic busywork.

name: MouseWars
shortDescription: MouseWars is a real time multiplayer cursor war game. The cursors have to fight until only one remains.

name: Survivor Jones
shortDescription: Vertical Platformer, Jump, Swing, Fight, Survive! When you die your soul is absorbed by the magical skull! Collect coins, purchase booster cards, try again!

name: Kontrol Flow
shortDescription: Repair connections to generators using interactive fuses in this energy simulation game.

name: Hexia
shortDescription: Hexia is a strategy game where your task, as King of your assigned Realm, is to create and expand territory, build new infrastructure, and command and guide your people. The Hexia universe is full of unexpected surprises and mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

name: Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+
shortDescription: A new edition of Woodle Tree 2 is here, with many enhancements! Will you be able to save Mother Nature in this vast open-world Adventure? This time a devastating menace is taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing life and energy from all living creatures!

name: Zombie Panic In Wonderland DX
shortDescription: The world of fairy tales has been overrun by a plague of bizarre zombies that wander along surrounded by a lovely yet pungent smell. Back to his hometown after a long time, Momotaro encounters these pests and finds himself forced to solve the issue.

name: Endless Knight
shortDescription: Endless Knight is an unusual fighting game inspired by the black knight scene from the Python classic 'The Holy Grail'. The game sees you cutting opponents' limbs off in a fight to the death!

name: Monsters of Kanji 2
shortDescription: Help Marty save his galaxy by understanding it.

name: Hero Lodge
shortDescription: Hero Lodge is a fantasy tactical turn based RPG with a focus on player strategy and knowledge. Now featuring a fully fleshed out Roguelite mode.

name: Uterine Supremacy
shortDescription: Uterine Supremacy is a 4 player local multiplayer game. Take control of the building blocks of life. To battle your friends through inspired mini games for the ultimate prize. Life itself. Inspired by true events.

name: Space Road
shortDescription: On the way to a new Galaxy! In Space Road get on board your spaceship and get all the stars!

name: Earthshine
shortDescription: Explore a deeply emotional story about love and sacrifice, and the hope that exists in us all.

name: Lands of Pharaoh: Episode 1
shortDescription: Lands of Pharaoh is a multi-camera-angle based adventure game. The hero, Heragos, tries to get to Cairo in order to find the messages, related to his divine duty, left for him by Nefertiti.

name: The Lost Cave of the Ozarks
shortDescription: Discover The Lost Cave of the Ozarks! As The Boy in the 1880s, you'll need your trusty lantern, wits, and imagination to navigate, solve puzzles, and confront the dangers lurking in the depths of the cave... or perhaps it's just your mind. Then, revisit the cave in present day to explore!

name: IKO 39
shortDescription: Find out what happened at the station, which had lost contact with the Earth. EMI – the artificial intelligence of the station – will help you to solve the mystery. But be careful. You are not alone on the planet...

name: Shiki
shortDescription: 2.5D fantasy adventure homage to "The Little Prince ". 2.5D world consisting of 3D sphere model and pixel art. A Fantastic world view with subtle original graphics.

name: Travel Mosaics 10: Spooky Halloween
shortDescription: Celebrate Halloween while travelling the spookiest places in the world with the Walker family, completing nonograms, and having fun!

name: ESPIONAGE: Mafia Evolved
shortDescription: A free-to-play Single-and-Multiplayer social deduction game in which role-based play rewards those who rely on strategy and their creative instincts. Also features full cross-play, cross-progression, and a story-rich experience. Supports up to 8 players with any combination of humans and AI.

name: Libertad o Muerte!
shortDescription: Libertad o Muerte!, the wars of independence of the Spanish Colonies is a turn-based game in 19th century America. Players are the Patriots, fighting for freedom, or the Royalists, trying to keep the empire under Spanish control. Who will prevail?

name: Space Shapes
shortDescription: Space Shapes is the finest retro arcade-style score chasing action game. Build your skill and command your ship to survive the onslaught of shapes that are threatening to destroy the galaxy.

name: A Zone
shortDescription: A Zone is a leisure game of black and white painting style It contains stubble finding and elimination elements

name: The Bad, The Worse & Djanky
shortDescription: A local and controller only western versus game featuring ricochets and 'realistic' weapon reloading.

name: Space Carrot
shortDescription: Arcade game about collecting carrot growing on asteroids. Perfect way to spend 5 minutes while waiting for something. Best played with a gamepad.

name: Bird Simulator
shortDescription: Bird Simulator is a crazy game in which you control the descendants of dinosaurs. Get them back to the top of the food chain and destroy humanity.

name: Adventures of musical tones and their notes
shortDescription: Adventures of Music Tones and Their Notes [/] is an educational computer game for children, with which children learn to sing songs in Bulgarian, to recognize the musical tones in them and to arrange notes.

name: Build 'm up, Shoot 'm down!
shortDescription: Build 'm up, Shoot 'm down is a challenging game, even hard to complete. Play trough 4 rage inducing platformer levels progressing in difficulty to gather all parts for Army Guys canon. While you Build it Up you will be facing hordes of enemies in the boss level. Shoot 'm all down to finish the game.

name: Nordic Warriors
shortDescription: Enter the real time tactical nightmare of Nordic Warriors and use your handful of brave souls to stem an endless horde of undead horrors. You'll need to take advantage of the terrain and your Hero abilities to heal and lead your units as you blast, smash or slash your way through the unfolding apocalypse.

name: Ashland Dossier
shortDescription: 1960, Cold War. Atrocities of WWII are almost forgotten. Nonetheless, a special task force is set out to hunt Nazis down. As its leader, you will be gathering evidence of war crimes against them and bringing these criminals to justice.

name: MONEY LOVES SILENCE
shortDescription: In the game MONEY LOVES SILENCE, you’re a bank employee and it’s your job to go after debtors. Everyone’s past catches up with them at some point and you’re no exception. You’ll need to help yourself when this happens. Buy everything you need and get ready to head out on an adventure.

name: Curse of the dungeon
shortDescription: You have to explore amazing places to get to the secret secrets of your soul.

name: Tower Of Heresy
shortDescription: Tower of Heresy is an Rpg Action game, with a fantasy setting and extensive and explorable maps. Choose a class and get ready to challenge the pitfalls of the tower among terrifying monsters and deadly traps. Will you be a slave of the tower or the Monarch?

name: The Magician's Workshop
shortDescription: When your master is murdered, you must uncover the magical secrets of Renaissance Italy, before your rival apprentices expose them first!

name: No Offence, But
shortDescription: "No Offence, But" is a hilarious turn-based strategy game where you must build a reputation for yourself by tearing down your enemies with insults, burns and put-downs in a series of slanging matches.

name: Blank
shortDescription: Dive in the metaphorical universe of Blank, a third-person puzzle-platformer game with stealth aspects. In a world filled with headless people, you must escape from the claws of the Metropolis, switch perspective to find the right path through this dystopian world and recover Blank’s true identity.

name: Kill or Love
shortDescription: A visual novel about obsession, loneliness, and, based on your choices, varying amounts of murder.

name: Empty Sharp
shortDescription: Play the part of Rosalie, a wicked girl forced to take a long journey due to an unexpected tragedy. Leave Lanya capital and go searching yourself; ask mysterious entities, dark creatures and mere humans to find a way to heal.

name: Sushi Pachi Panic
shortDescription: An anime-inspired pachinko game featuring the Sushi Girls and minigames!

name: Plunkocity
shortDescription: Plunkocity is a light hearted brain game that is simple enough to be enjoyed by all. Seven different versions allow seven different topics to be drilled, all while being amused by whimsical pain and rewards.

name: Cytoclash
shortDescription: Cytoclash is an action-packed lightgun-style shooter that calls upon you as Earth's best hope against a monstrous alien invasion! Suit-up and blast your way through hordes of enemies and massive bosses in the debut release from Setrino Software!

name: Queeny Army
shortDescription: Queeny Army, advance around San Romero, each girl has a different special ability and unique weapons, free your country, defeat your enemies to reach the heads of the criminal organization commanded by the president, will the girls be able to survive this adventure?

name: Human Simulator
shortDescription: Meet Mr Hugh Mann. Hugh loves humans, and he wants to be just like them. Help Hugh to fit in and learn what human life is like by manually moving his head, arms and legs as you work together to explore an array of fun and wacky jobs in the pursuit of helping Hugh to fit in and be accepted by all!

name: Survived
shortDescription: First Person Shooter tower defensive strategy game, gather materials, build, and see how long you can survive!

name: 单词训练营 | Word Training Camp
shortDescription: This is a fun game to teach, you can shoot, experience the fun of the game, while reciting words. We have many modes, such as practice, challenge, translation and so on. Each mode has a shooting range, so that you can learn English without being bored.

name: 群星战纪: 遗失的星辰 - STARS ERA: LOST STARS
shortDescription: 在可怕的噩梦中苏醒，岁月发现自己已沉睡了数万年。 自己曾经效忠的庞大帝国，因为突然爆发的“深渊侵蚀”，只剩下寥寥数人与最珍贵的“心智模型”。 面对外部极其相近的“类人类文明”与卷土重来的“深渊”，背负着仇恨与责任的岁月，又该如何抉择……

name: Vecter
shortDescription: Get in your ship, push the throttle to max, and try not to die. Daily leaderboards where your name stays forever if you're good enough. Custom colors, custom music, YouTube in-game. It's free. What are you waiting for?

name: Incredible Dracula: Vargosi Returns
shortDescription: It's time for the lady of the castle to take charge in this thrilling adventure featuring a role-reversal twist no one saw coming! Break from the ordinary and "unlive" a little!

name: House of 1000 Doors: The Palm of Zoroaster
shortDescription: Guide Kate Reed as she searches for the artifacts that can break the power of a cursed gem, solves clever puzzles and finds ingeniously hidden objects.

name: Incredible Dracula: The Ice Kingdom
shortDescription: Join Dracula on his most "chilling" adventure yet as he tries to stop the Ice Queen from turning the world into a giant snowball! It's the most fun you can have at subzero temperatures!

name: 妈妈，别走
shortDescription: 一款有人味的情感养成类游戏，教会你如何带给父母健康、快乐的晚年，也希望你的孩子学会如何关爱慢慢老去的你~ 毕竟，我们终将老去，我们终将成为步履蹒跚的他们，她们…很多事情就像时间~去了，就不再回来~

name: Eternal Kingdom Battle Peak
shortDescription: A "Japanese" MMORPG featuring renowned creators such as Yoshitaka Amano! Travel with your allies through vast fields where weather changes and dungeons where your role is crucial!! PVP is also possible on the field! Establish a legion and join a "Siege" where up to 200 players battle!!

name: 出门
shortDescription: RPG

name: Finders Reapers
shortDescription: Finders Reapers is an inventive third-person shooter. Experience items raining from the sky, collect them, sell them and discover a whole new concept where cash is ammo.Take on missions, fight it out online or battle against bots in custom skirmish mode.It’s time to prove you’re the best.

name: 黑暗之岛
shortDescription: Board the dark island, bravely explore the whole island, collect new CARDS to form their own deck, use CARDS and props to bravely defeat different enemies, finally eliminate the dragon, out of the darkness. Every time you explore a new island, your enemies, CARDS, stores, etc., are different.

name: Troll Control
shortDescription: Troll Control is an Action-Adventure RPG with procedurally generated environments set in the bizarre high-fantasy world of Anachronia. It is a top-down dungeon crawling experience to play solo or up to 4 players in true couch co-op style!

name: The Dreamwalkers
shortDescription: Take control of Morgan's destiny as his world is turned upside down. Explore the world of Dreams, where mythological creatures and Nightmares are real. A story-heavy adventure game with multiple endings, romance options and a symphonic music! Inspired by Neil Gaiman and Inception.

name: Imbroglio
shortDescription: Imbroglio is a smart and comfortably challenging puzzle game.

name: Project Starship X
shortDescription: The Rogue-Lite shooter where you CRASH-KILL comical abominations! ​Pilot your spaceship as Swagthulhu in this original and wacky "Lovecraftian Parody"!

name: Shine's Adventures 6 (Go! Girls)
shortDescription: This game is the sixth project in this series. You can play a racing game in sea with a group of cute girls wearing swimwear. This time,in addition to the catgirls,there are many bunny girls who are also your opponents.

name: Shadowrain
shortDescription: In complete darkness, all memories faded into obscurity, you wake up in a small apartment. Looking through the windows of Neo-Tokyo’s Highrise E5671, you see the city. The city, fallen completely silent. You are not alone. It’s getting closer. hide

name: Code Zero
shortDescription: Anime Hack and Slash with an intense 3D combat. Neutralize the irregular robots and recover the control of the factory.

name: Jack In Town
shortDescription: Vous êtes un criminel en monde ouvert. Faites ce que vous voulez!

name: Cerberus: Orbital watch
shortDescription: Get ready for classic top down space shooter gameplay! In near future scientists detected allien signals, you need to find out their nature.

name: Cyberless: Online
shortDescription: Cyberless: Online," a multiplayer, FPS, and Sci-Fi game, presents the government warfare between two factions, Forces and Rebels. While Rebels argue that elections are rigged, Forces hold the power. Engage in the battle to contribute to the storyline of the Cyberless game series!

name: Merge Towers
shortDescription: Your castle is under attack!!! Buy, merge and arrange your towers to defend against waves of bloodthirsty enemies. Give your towers super powers by adding ice, fire, lightning, poison runes and many more!

name: Vector Light
shortDescription: A 2D abstract puzzle game where the goal is to find the right pattern to maximize your scores!

name: JAGD LANZER
shortDescription: Destroy the legions of machinists! An easy to control mechanic 2D action game that attacks automatically when an enemy is in range. Customize your mecha to suit your needs. The key to success is to manage energy while standing around.

name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Unruly Clockwork Companion
shortDescription: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

name: Zombie Road Rider
shortDescription: Drive through cities and forests infested of zombies, crush all the undeads on your way, rescue the survivors in different environments and unlock all the vehicles. Achieve the best score!

name: UpMove
shortDescription: UpMove is a 1-bit-style typing game x cave flyer mashup about leaving behind the daily grind, pushing your limits in pursuit of an ambition, and maybe going a little too far. Pilot your ship through meteor showers, giant factories, and more, as you reach for your dreams in a dangerous universe.

name: DepowerBall
shortDescription: DepowerBall is a competitive dragon-feeding party platformer. Be the first to feed the Dragon Queen and score points to win three rounds. As you win rounds, the other players will even the odds by taking away your powers, forcing you to adapt your strategy...or get left behind.

name: MyStar
shortDescription: Please use Xbox controller to play this game. This is an action game of collecting stars developed by HAL students which contains 20 levels in 4 different worlds. we are sorry to announce that the game won't support update as it is a finished student project.

name: Dark Table CCG
shortDescription: Enter a dark Lovecraftian world where four supreme beings called Keymasters play a sinister card game over the control of worlds. The 4-player gameplay and fresh unique mechanics ensure there is no real meta, so you can enjoy endless deck combinations.

name: Gerritory
shortDescription: Let's party in Gerritory! Against each other, hit the highest score and take the only throne locally or get even more chaos on online mode! Moving around as a cube, coloring tiles as much as you can to defeat your competitors.

name: TopplePOP: Bungee Blockbusters
shortDescription: Welcome to the jumble! TopplePOP is a physics puzzle party with bendy animal acrobats on bungee cords for 1-4 players in solo, co-op & PvP. Instant fun for all ages. Deep mastery for spectacular eSports. Jump into couch parties & zen puzzles. Hone skills for team battles & speedrun leaderboards!

name: Command & Control 3
shortDescription: Assume the role of a special forces commander fighting against a terrorist organization named "Dawn of Freedom".

name: Chronicles of Galdurvale
shortDescription: Chronicles of Galdurvale is an action-adventure game where Amelia Moonglow, a skilled huntress rides a dragon to explore an open world, craft items, collect weapons, and face challenging bosses. A thrilling journey to collect the five sacred stones and reunite with her mother in the Sky World.

name: P.A.I.N.T.
shortDescription: In this cooperative third-person shooter, you take control of the P.U.N.K.’s. Rebels that shoot their way through an evil factory with high-powered paint blasters. Sabotage the tyrannical corporation and fight your way through their factory to achieve the highest chaos score!

name: Antares
shortDescription: Grab your gun and blast your way through the infested horde as you try to save humanity from the ultimate doom! Gather resources, upgrade your weapon and explore the story of why you are the only one left alive. Or are you?

name: Ray Eager
shortDescription: Traditional survival in classic performance! This game is crammed with the joys, dangers and surprises of the genre. Your main task is to survive in a dangerous world. Put on the mask of a good-natured or villain, creator or destroyer, to get your place. Survive alone or in the company of friends;)

name: Hibiscus Red
shortDescription: Almost classic point and click adventure game

name: 城市生存计划 / City Survival Project
shortDescription: The player will play as someone trying to make it in the big city. Within 90 days, the game abstracts the difficulties, pressures, and choices in the form of continuous decision making. This decision-making game is based on a combination of talented and professional pathways, there are over dozens of career paths to advance and over 50...

name: Toy Robot
shortDescription: You are a simple toy robot with no name, no memory and no serial number. You discover that your battery is damaged. Now the journey to repair your battery and save your life begins... In this journey you will need to: Run, Jump, Shoot and Solve Puzzles.

name: I Have Low Stats But My Class Is "Leader", So I Recruited Everyone I Know To Fight The Dark Lord
shortDescription: A comedy RPG where you play as 99 characters at once.

name: Wigged Out
shortDescription: In Wigged Out, two rival schools clash in a wild and wacky ball game! Dodge, jump, and attack, whether by launching a rubber turkey at your foes or netting a goal while riding a goat. Chaos and skill go hand in hand in this fast-paced, laugh-out-loud showdown!

name: Adventure Galaxy
shortDescription: Adventure Galaxy - an indie game with a first-person view, the game takes place on a space station in space.

name: GIRLS BATTLEGROUNDS | 性感大逃杀
shortDescription: Survive this massive girls' battle royal.

name: Space Candy
shortDescription: "Space Candy is a captivating Arkanoid game with a cosmic twist. Collect space sweets by breaking blocks with a ball-controlled platform, while battling pesky aliens. Enjoy diverse bonuses, challenging levels, and exciting power-ups in this action-packed space adventure!"

name: Contract Killers
shortDescription: Fast paced top down shooter, you need to be fast and deadly, choose your character, pick new contract, prepare your weapons and kill your target !!! Get rewarded and buy new more deadly weapons.

name: They Came From a Communist Planet
shortDescription: THEY CAME FROM A COMMUNIST PLANET is a first-person riot game where aliens reach earth and trigger a socialist revolution. Break through police lines with bricks and molotovs as you follow the aliens into a communist future!

name: The City of Time
shortDescription: The little girl comes to the City of Time, this place has the magic of making time back, you can use the magic of time backward to make time interlaced to help the little girl through difficulties.

name: Sunny Girl
shortDescription: Enjoy cute girls in the background of gentle music and complete puzzles. The game is a jigsaw puzzle, where players move puzzle pieces to restore the original image.

name: The Orphan A Tale of An Errant Ghost - Hidden Object Game
shortDescription: The Orphan is filled with emotional story of Sarah, the orphan girl who mysteriously disappeared with her family. You as Sarah’s cousin has lost your memory and has to find out the clues with the help of an unknown spirit while saving yourself from another ghost in an abandoned house.

name: Periodic Deliveries
shortDescription: As the director of your own space shipping company, design and optimize a galactic trade network to efficiently move goods to where they're needed. Start from nothing and expand your profits and technology until your influence reaches across the galaxy.

name: Seek Hearts
shortDescription: Set out on an adventure to discover Izen's mysterious origins in a sci-fi RPG! Upgrade Izen's abilities with arm/leg parts, core and chips, and activate the armament drive and fight with the support of fairies!

name: Nuclear Arms Race
shortDescription: Nuclear Arms Race is a revolutionary turn-based game that allows you to produce resources, spy on and sabotage your opponent in order to acquire the nuclear weapon before they can eradicate you.

name: Useless Box: The Game
shortDescription: This game is exactly like a Useless Box but better because it's a video game about hitting a switch on a Useless Box (still no purpose). Want to spend hours flipping a switch and accomplishing nothing? This game is for you! As an added bonus, the box will tell you stories as well as reveal unlocks!

name: The Airship Designer
shortDescription: Build your own airships by snaping engines, envelops, fins and gondolas together. Then fly it freely or watch it blow up in the sandbox!

name: GOOSE.IO
shortDescription: Establish the pecking order once and for all and rule the pond!

name: Bolf
shortDescription: Bowling and also Golf.

name: VECTORLORD
shortDescription: A retro-styled shooter that doesn't take itself too seriously. Warp between platforms and Dash through bullets. Beat up your enemies, or blast them away. Juggle your combo, and buy upgrades in the shop. Track down your corpse after you die.

name: Gigantosaurus The Game
shortDescription: The most exciting episode of Gigantosaurus yet is one you get to play in. But will you be the most roarsome explorer or the fastest racer? Play together with friends and family to help Rocky, Tiny, Mazu and Bill save the day – before dino-dashing to the next zone. Dinosaurs have never had such giant fun!

name: PONG Quest™
shortDescription: PONG Quest™ is a new take on the seminal arcade smash. Take control of a brave young paddle and traverse treacherous lands - each loosely based on various classic Atari® hits - in this uniquely PONG®-themed dungeon-crawling RPG.

name: Highway Game
shortDescription: Funny and dynamical race with nice graphics in which you have to driving between cars, get away from police and get to finish line first.

name: Geometry Hero
shortDescription: 2D Action, Casual, Arcade, Single Player, Hack&Slash, Time Attack

name: 末法时代
shortDescription: 踏上你的修仙旅途，用自己的方式，得道正果。寻找自己的仇人，为家门复仇。在探索中慢慢揭开世界之谜的神秘面纱，最终飞升成仙。这也许不是一个拯救世界的故事，但你可以。

name: The Sorrowvirus
shortDescription: Consumed by greed, Wyatt's parents subject him to a cycle of death without end, sending him into Purgatory each time to capitalise on the Catholicon, a cure-all they value more than their son, with the potential to reshape humanity. As he ebbs, Wyatt's only desire is to be free, forever.

name: Pooplers
shortDescription: Pooplers is a multiplayer game where up to four players take control over babies. Toddlers do not belong to the calm ones, as soon as nobody watches them, they crawl around the house, pooping. A humorous game, however, has a number of elements that diversify the gameplay.

name: Il Sole e la Luna 2
shortDescription: Embark on an epic fantasy RPG adventure! Engage in spectacular turn-based battles across a fully explorable open world. Level up, customize your gear, and uncover hidden secrets. Choose your class and shape your destiny in a realm filled with magic and mystery.

name: Imaginarium
shortDescription: Create your own story and your own world using only your imagination

name: Space zone defender
shortDescription: Space zone defender is an oldschool arcade style space shooter. You can choose between different weapon sets and ship skins and try to survive as long as you can.

name: Future Pool
shortDescription: Future Pool is a futuristic version of 8-ball pool. Players take turns to shoot a cue-ball on a circular pool table. The first player to knock out all of their balls, plus the black 8-ball, wins. A game for one or two players with a selection of computer opponents.

name: Billion Beat
shortDescription: Behold, Billion Beat! It's a brutal boxing bonanza. Beat the bicuspids off a bevy of bizarre baddies. Be a badass and bet on your brawn to bag a billion bucks! Booyah, baby!

name: Unification
shortDescription: Unification is about a cat chasing its own laser pointer into an ancient black hole engine. Unleash your cat instincts as Gumbot, tackling physics and critters alike! Leap and scramble up ledges, zoom with rocket parkour, shift gravity at will, and wield curious artifacts and dreamlike powers.

name: Molly: fear of clowns
shortDescription: Molly: fear of clowns - Platformer in a classic style and with modern graphics. The adventures of a little girl named Molly, inside her fictional world of fears and fantasies.

name: ArachnoSplat
shortDescription: ArachnoSplat is an arcadey VR game where you take jobs exterminating spiders. Kill them anyway you can. Be careful because the damage caused will count against what the job pays.

name: Future Snooker
shortDescription: Future Snooker is a futuristic snooker game. Players take turns to shoot a cue-ball on a circular snooker table. Score points by potting red then colour, just as in normal snooker. A compelling mix of tactics and skill for one or two players with a selection of computer opponents.

name: Immanence
shortDescription: Immanence is a 2D psychological Lovecraftian blend of religion and technology with surreal puzzles and dark atmosphere.

name: Dangerous Blaster

shortDescription: Void Breach is a low-res, retro point-and-click adventure game where an experiment has gone unpredictably wrong. Your daughter is whooshed through a tear in space! Embrace the void and follow her. The only way to bring her back.

name: How Stories Die
shortDescription: Time travel, assassins and one magical gangster rabbit! The demon king threatens your kingdom and it's up to you, the prince, to find a suitable hero to fight it. Not an easy task, as it will require you to shed a lot of blood and maybe even die. But at least you will save everyone... right?

name: James Town Courier Frog MD
shortDescription: Welcome to James Town! The Jungle driver is on drugs and is leaving packages in the wrong locations! It is up to Courier Frog MD to fix it. Using your Medical Degree, you must find the lost packages and deliver them!

name: Hotaru
shortDescription: Hotaru is a difficult space style shoot 'em up with different waves of enemies, bosses and power-ups.

name: Spacebase19
shortDescription: Defend Spacebase 19 from the asteroids swarming down on the station! Shoot down waves of stones and equip different powerful weapons. How many waves can you last? A simple nostalgic retro arcade turret defense shooter.

name: Tunnel Vision
shortDescription: Tunnel Vision is a Retro Space shooter that harkens back to the early 80s Arcades. Fun simple addictive gameplay.

name: REFUGE
shortDescription: The third-person singleplayer rogue-like adventure - REFUGE, with an massive, handcrafted open-world and hardcore challenging action. Choose your fighting way through hordes of monsters. Unlock new loot, and find a way to survive and finish that path.

name: Bionic Hunter VR
shortDescription: Hunt down Monsters in a Sci-Fi Horror Survival Shooter and test your Skills among other players! Live an immersive experience with latest generation graphics.

name: Hop Step Sing! Astral Piece
shortDescription: In its fifth installment, Hop Step Sing!'s VR Music Video series takes interactivity to the next level. Join Niina Nijikawa as she dazzles you with her singing and dancing with her classmates after school hours.

name: Shot in the Dark
shortDescription: Armed with nothing but a six gun the lone bandit will need a quick hand and a sharp eye to fend off the nightmares lurking in the dark.

name: Cecil Run
shortDescription: Arrows fall randomly on Cecil as he continues to run away from danger avoiding pits and gaps while collecting meat and treasure. Survive long enough and the dentist will become agitated, get into his B-52 and bomb Cecil like the Dresden Cathedral. Once Cecil collects 10 pieces of meat, the hamburger will drop.

name: Hell Pub
shortDescription: 这是一款独一无二的策略rpg游戏，难度和标题都是地狱级的。 您需要组织一支4人战队，去通过冥王试炼。您的对手实力恐怖是不会让您失望的。 从来没有人类能走到最后，这次轮到您上场了。来接受一次终极考验吧。 当您击败血量 伤害都是几倍于您的对手，您会爱上这款游戏的。

name: TriangleWingXXXX
shortDescription: A STG game. To prove your strength to the strange sound, you must defeat your campanions who have fought together with you.

name: Jack troubles
shortDescription: This is a first person shooter game,The player is a shooter with multiple weapons,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Enemies are scattered around the player and inside buildings,Players can kill enemies or avoid enemy attacks and maintain health,Players can also grab enemy weapons.

name: Rock, Paper, Scissors Simulator
shortDescription: First person view "Rock, Paper, Scissors" game

name: Dark Gravity
shortDescription: Shoot, destroy, collect, craft and destroy even more! "Dark Gravity" is a fast-paced, low poly vertical shoot'em up game that features non-linear campaign mode with lots of enemies and bosses. Craft new weapons, upgrade your fighter and build an ultimate aerial war machine!

name: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale
shortDescription: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale is a local splitscreen co-op game where you go on an adventure to find your lost grandpa. Use your unique abilities to work together to solve the mystery of grandpa's disappearance. Can you find back grandpa?

name: Calamari Clash
shortDescription: Calamari Clash is a multiplayer versus game which takes you into the role of a Calamartian who crashed on an unknown planet along with its companions. Dash it out against each other to charge the spaceship’s battery and escape. Only one can escape… who will it be?

name: Decadent Thinking
shortDescription: Over 100 short stories told by a mysterious girl. A "read" prescription for those of you who are tired of living.

name: Toy Killer
shortDescription: Zombies take the island. You! Come to the city, find new weapons, and kill a maximum of them to get the higher score.

name: Magin: The Rat Project Stories
shortDescription: Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler. The branching plot, comic book aesthetic, full voice-over, and game mechanics are tightly intertwined in a unique, dark fantasy world.

name: Shmup Arena
shortDescription: Take on intense challenges and waves of enemies in this frenetic arena shooter that demands quick reflexes and nonstop action. Survive the onslaught and defeat powerful bosses while staying in motion, mastering arenas designed for those who crave adrenaline and intense combat.

name: Palace of sky
shortDescription: 突如其来的变故打破了山村的宁静， 一名不速之客的到来，造成相依为命的爷爷亡故。 为此，一名原本应该平凡的少年，为了替爷爷报仇，踏上了修行之路。 随着对事情的调查深入，他逐渐解除到了传送中的东西——九霄仙阙。

name: Clones Run
shortDescription: A puzzle action game where Clone humans race through stages aiming for the goal! Move blocks that are impossible to handle alone by teaming up with everyone! Bring as many clones as possible to the goal!

name: BREAK THROUGH
shortDescription: Breakthrough" is an action game in which you fight giant enemy robots. Equip weapons that fall on six floating bits and destroy the enemy's parts. Enemies can be won by destroying their cores, which are located somewhere on their body. Manipulate the six bits to eliminate all enemies.

name: i Have Powers!
shortDescription: SuperHeroic SuperHero Arcade Fighting Game, make a Superhero using the classic 4 color costume design of comic-book Heroes. See how powerful you can make your character, see how long they can survive. Choose lots of different SuperPowers, and stop crime by any means!

name: Defending Frontiers
shortDescription: Defending Frontiers is a city defense, 2D graphics with a side view, a memorable and atmospheric soundtrack, colorful and beautiful graphics and unforgettable experiences.

name: Hexon
shortDescription: Just a nice puzzle, which you can spend a couple of hours.

name: Hockeysplit
shortDescription: This game is fast-paced arcade hockey style game about learning the mistakes and techniques!

name: DonDon Busters!!
shortDescription: KICK, PANCH, BALLOOM!! BATTLE IT OUT WITH YOUR FRIENDS!!

name: Rhythm of the Gods
shortDescription: Join the strongest mortal warrior, Lyrik, and slide, jump & slash to the beat to please the Gods of Rhythm! Solve the problems that the mortal realm faces in this auto-running, Greek-inspired rhythm game. Keep in time and reveal each gods’ true tune with unique beatmaps.

name: Sea King
shortDescription: Fast-paced naval combat party game.

name: Zombie World Coronavirus Apocalypse VR
shortDescription: Welcome to the world of the apocalyptic future, where in the laboratories the best scientists tried to create a cure for all known diseases, but the test led to terrible consequences that you will have to find out!

name: BORE DOME
shortDescription: In the near future, human life is perfect. BORE DOME is a magical pill solution from the future that lets you experience moments of human imperfection and mediocrity. Equip your senses and get ready to confront all kinds of situations and unhinged characters.

name: Frontline: The Great Patriotic War
shortDescription: A tactical scale strategy game that invites the players to take command of the URSS forces in an epic struggle for the control of Russia during World War Two.

name: Frog struggles
shortDescription: A fast and difficult action game in which lots of insects fight for control over the pond.

name: Position
shortDescription: Welcome to meditative story adventure about worlds, fantasies and eternal reasoning of mankind. Do not get lost.

name: Kart kids
shortDescription: A chaotic racing game in which up to 60 tiny karts race each other in the hood.

name: Talvisota - Winter War
shortDescription: Talvisota for Rising Storm 2 brings players from the steaming jungles of Vietnam to the frozen forests of Finland, during the Soviet-Finnish Winter War of the late 1930s.

name: Pilfer
shortDescription: A stealth game in which the player explores a small town, breaks into houses, and steals silverware.

name: Wrecker
shortDescription: Wrecker is an 2D arcade game set in space. In it you will fight off an endless horde of aliens in waves using your special issue high powered missile turret.

name: Thunderflash
shortDescription: Thunderflash is a "love letter" to the arcade games of the 80s. It is a Run 'n Gun game inspired by gems like Ikari Warriors, Commando and Heavy Barrel.

name: Goblin Summer Camp
shortDescription: The one true multiplayer goblin simulator. Play Goblin Tag and acquire power ups that let you leap across the entire map. Play Hide and Seek and annoy your friends with ‘REEEES’ when they cant find you. Stay alive in Death Run without being trapped. Be a goblin and do goblin things!

name: Tranject
shortDescription: Tranject is a 2D-space-shooter with a complex story about cleaning space and collecting green essence. The base game as well as a possible expansion is developed by Jadon-K. Fischer.

name: Primitive Survival
shortDescription: Conquer the stone age! Primitive Survival is a skill-based survival RPG. You begin as a primitive human and progress through the first steps toward civilization. Become a hunter/gatherer in a primitive world. Avoid dangerous predators as you learn the skills needed to overcome all obstacles.

name: JORRY
shortDescription: JORRY is a horror point & click game inspired by the classics of the 90's, including an survival horror game play.

name: Tin & Kuna
shortDescription: Spin and smash through the colorful, chaotic worlds of Tin & Kuna. Explore levels filled with puzzles and peril.

name: Suspicious Slide
shortDescription: Suspicious Slide takes the "ice slide" puzzle to the next level.

name: Ultimate Disc Golf
shortDescription: Disc Golf is a fun and easy to pick up sport that involves taking a disc and throwing it into a metal basket with chains on it. UDG is a disc golf video game with a unique take on "golf" style games. Featuring a character creator with real DG brands and explore-able courses. Come and play a round.

name: The inside of a drawer
shortDescription: ESC, Tab, W,A,S,D Space Bar, R, Mouse wheel, Drag

name: Kick Of Dungeon
shortDescription: Collect and combine different cards, challenge all kinds of monsters, encounter different random events!

name: 逆光 Sunwards
shortDescription: This is a challenging action adventure game. Freud said: dreams are the way to the heart. The magician Black Crow, has closed his heart. You will play his good friend, the Witch Niche, to explore in the dream of the Black Crow, smash the nightmare and finally face the Black Crow's heart to save him.

name: Alchemelee
shortDescription: Alchemelee is a potion-brewing party game that can be played with up to 4 players. Grow ingredients, make potions, and use them to affect the actions of other players, or be the first to make all three of your designated potions to win

name: Soul Axiom Rebooted
shortDescription: The new enhanced edition of Soul Axiom - a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. Collect unique hand powers, discover multiple endings and choose your own destiny as you unravel the mystery of your digital afterlife.

name: Monster Capture King
shortDescription: A monster taming game that's good enough to share with your dad! Start off with a little Doggy and tame more monsters to become the Monster Capture King!

name: My Adventure（我的冒险）
shortDescription: A girl, a sword, some magic, an adventure.

name: kraken's curse
shortDescription: A rogue-like pirate adventure game. Explore a skeleton-riddled archipelago in search of a giant monster. Find treasures, weapons and secrets. Can you defeat the terrible kraken?

name: Spaß Taxi
shortDescription: Spaß Taxi (Spaß is German for "fun") is a fun retro arcade game where you bring passengers from one station to another in a flying, rotating taxi. It's a clone of the classic game "Space Taxi" from 1984 with a modernized gameplay using physics and more freedom of movement.

name: Wamu Wamu 2
shortDescription: A cute short experimental game about cleaning fruits that are infested by big worms.

name: Lost Roads
shortDescription: Lost Roads is a psychological horror game in a world where undecipherable mysteries hide, are you ready to start the game?

name: Pinball universe
shortDescription: Pinball universe is an arcade game in which the player collects game points by manipulating the ball on the playing field. The goal of the game is to score as many game points as possible. Two playing fields are available.

name: Physical Glitch
shortDescription: Physical Glitch - this is a casual game using physics. Pink squares accidentally appear on the playing field, and your task is to collect them as much as possible and not touch the red objects. How many squares can you collect?

name: Bizarre Barber
shortDescription: Grab your VR controllers, and get ready to snip away! Bizarre Barber is a surreal, fun & fast-moving haircutting game set on a subway platform.

name: FLYING SHOT
shortDescription: FLYING SHOT is a voxel first-person shooter that involves dismembering opponents, physical blood, realistic destruction of glass and walls, and slow-motion parkour

name: Malediction
shortDescription: Malediction is a third-person puzzle/platformer that gives the player the ability to control space and time! Use your magic to solve puzzles, navigate through a cursed city, and fight magic clones to reclaim your powers.

name: Me and myself
shortDescription: Lily, a little girl who lost her parents in a car accident, lives in a big empty house. She really wants to have a friend with whom she could pass the tough time. One day, she finally get a friend, from mirror...

name: Flight League Series
shortDescription: FLS is a Scifi Sandbox Racing game.

name: Project Stocks
shortDescription: A darkly humorous and wacky trading simulator. Engage in market manipulation, insider trading, and ruthless deal-making as you battle AI tycoons and human traders. Short, speculate, form alliances, betray, and bend the rules to build your fortune.

name: Many Faces
shortDescription: Many Faces is a classic, retro arcade shooter from the 90s. Blast your way through randomly generated levels to confront the Many Face King!

name: The foreigner
shortDescription: 一件往事，一次邂逅，一段旅程，一丝乡愁，还有埋藏在砂尘的异国他乡的追忆

name: FlickerMAZE
shortDescription: In this game You have to get through several levels of mazes by controlling a bouncy ball by shooting it.

name: Gizmos: Steampunk Nonograms
shortDescription: Solve challenging nonograms (also known as picross, griddlers, etc.) to decipher a message from a distant planet!

name: Gray Zone
shortDescription: Gray Zone is best described as Men of War meets Commandos in a futuristic coat. It's an odyssey of a slave who turned against his masters. Use stealth or direct combat in a squad-based encounters. Expect memorable characters, fun dialogues and lots of action!

name: Adventure Boy Jailbreak
shortDescription: Puzzle your way through the small town of Estivale, brought to life with a range of characters who all have a problem to solve. With each person you help, Benson gets one stop closer to breaking his friend Mike out of the county jail.

name: Ghosts'n DJs
shortDescription: Inspired by the classic arcade hit Ghosts'n Goblins and fully created by the house music legend Dr. Kucho!, Ghosts'n DJs is a pixel-art run and gun side-scrolling action platformer set in a parallel universe in which the music scene is being dominated by fake artists and DJ’s.

name: Klym
shortDescription: A 3D-Platformer about climbing buildings and finding ducklings.

name: Chico
shortDescription: Chico, an epic tail of survival on a peak in the middle of nowhere. Customize your screensaver and help Chico make his life comfortable.

name: Pupper park
shortDescription: A cute sandbox game about dogs in a park. Fetch balls, run around, scare frogs, play football, and earn bones!

name: Coffee Break
shortDescription: Cafe management and crafting sim where you live the hectic life of a Barista. Play alone or with friends for the price of a latte!

name: Aigor Escape from Bishop
shortDescription: Relive the taste of the 90's point and click with stunning graphics! Help Aigor, a scoundrel zombie, to escape from the secret crypts of the perfidious Bishop Antoine Santolamazza. Explore the dungeons of the cathedral and solve the many riddles!

name: Puzzle Frame
shortDescription: Enter a quiet place where you can relax and solve sliding puzzles. There's no tracking scores, no hidden doors, and no plot twist, just a zen place for your mind to wander.

name: Infinite Beyond The Mind
shortDescription: Infinite - Beyond the mind is a slick 2D action-platformer where you take on evil Queen Evangelyn Bramann, ruler of The Beljantaur Kingdom as she works towards her dream of world domination.

name: Planet Bounce
shortDescription: Planet Bounce is an action packed arcade-style space game. Navigate solar systems, fire unique weapons, unlock powerful new ships in your quest to conquer the galaxy.

name: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs
shortDescription: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs is an RPG game with a mix of adventure and thriller. It's the story of a girl named Luna. She woke up in the park and discovered that she's gained the powers of the signs.

name: Brick Blaster
shortDescription: Brick Blaster is a classic brick breaking game with 100 levels to complete, power-ups to grab, and bosses to defeat!

name: Let's Learn Japanese! Vocabulary
shortDescription: Learn over 200 Japanese words by completing fun challenges. Unlock mini-games, art and music.

name: Axiel
shortDescription: Axiel is a casual puzzle game. No timers, no scoreboards, no rush. Take your time.

name: Shine's Adventures 3 (Sea Fight)
shortDescription: You can control Shine to fight the enemy again. This time you will meet large robots who dominate the ocean. But I want to say: 'Let them know how powerful we are and see whose firing fiercer. ' This time survival mode is very interesting, don't miss it.

name: Herbalist Simulator
shortDescription: Become a herbalist in a small village. Treat various diseases using natural methods. Prepare healing mixtures. Travel to search for better ingredients. Do not wait. Find your vocation to heal people…

name: Prometheus Wept
shortDescription: Prometheus Wept is a turn-based, party-based RPG set on a post digital apocalypse Earth. The game offers squad-level combat, branching dialogue with consequential choices, simultaneous battles between cyberspace and the physical world, along with deep character progression and crafting systems.

name: Samurai: Ronin's Path
shortDescription: Samurai: Ronin's Path is a dynamic action game set in feudal Japan. Fight in true samurai style, unlock new abilities, avoid death, and cut down your enemies using an extensive arsenal available to Asian warriors.

name: Escape from Life Inc
shortDescription: Escape from Life Inc is a quirky story-driven puzzle platformer, where you switch between three animals: a walking fish, an arrogant eagle and a stuttering reindeer. Together with plenty of wacky characters, help these three unlikely friends escape the alien lab!

name: Reach Coin
shortDescription: Sometimes I'm hungry, I put a coin in that kind of machine but the candy just won't get out. What happens with my coin in there?

name: Idle Space
shortDescription: Your cursor won't linger in Idle Space as you play this exciting and fast-paced clicker. You will work to defeat an encroaching fleet, with every explosion collect metal to create, produce and upgrade factories to keep you in the fight.

name: DUMB Infernal
shortDescription: Enter the infernal hellscape as a lone warrior fending off an army of monsters in arcade style combat.

name: PhyxBox
shortDescription: PhyxBox is a physics based sandbox in VR, construct anything you can imagine!

name: Deserted
shortDescription: Deserted is a stylized 3D action adventure with light RPG and narrative elements. Inspired by the alien atmosphere of Out Of This World, Deserted combines narrative storytelling with survival and fast paced strategic combat to deliver a thrilling adventure.

name: Path
shortDescription: In the world of lightness and darkness, Let's make a Path by connect the dots.

name: Small War
shortDescription: You need to choose your camp and build the building! Build combat units through barracks and factories, and then manipulate combat units to destroy enemy bases!

name: The War Enders Evolution
shortDescription: The War Enders Evolution is an arcade style single-stage bullet hell game. Beat the game with the choice from three different fighters and two different styles.

name: Super Crystal Hunter
shortDescription: Enter this Arcade-RPG adventure incarnating the young thief Slade. Go through multiple places to loot in the Eastern Lands, visit special zones, face several bosses and discover various mini-games and additional extras.

name: Foxfall
shortDescription: Welcome to FoxFall! Super Satisfying Adventures waiting to you!

name: TAXIDERMY
shortDescription: An 80's VHS style first person horror experience, in this game you are locked in a house of a mad taxidermist and surviving is up to you!

name: Kingdom Warrior
shortDescription: 在一个王国里 你即将成为新国王， 但是你会遇到各种各样的困难。

name: The Alchemist's House
shortDescription: An invitation from a stranger... There's something evil in this house... Will you survive?

name: DanielX.net Paint Composer
shortDescription: Create beautiful music simply and easily! Save your compositions and share them with friends and the world. Interesting characters are fun for both kids and adults. The musical staff is welcoming, you can leverage your existing knowledge of music or expand it through experimentation. Enjoy!

name: Red Rush
shortDescription: Take care of restoring the economy and the status of a superpower of a once great country in one of the most difficult times for Russia.

name: Ailuri
shortDescription: A hand-drawn, 2D platformer following the breathtaking story of an endangered red panda, named Ailuri. Climb, explore and survive the intricate levels while trying to defeat enemies to restore balance of life in the world.

name: View From Below
shortDescription: An emotional, story-driven, turn-based RPG about a sad kid put through hell. Literally! Escape a nightmare world, to save your own.

name: Green: An Orc's Life
shortDescription: A life-simulation card-swiper. Grow an orc. Pilot it through a life of pillage, plunder and gluttony. Build up your horde, become filthy-rich with loot, even become a god!

name: Oil Wars
shortDescription: Strategy and simulation game where you will be faced to enemies for control of oil refinery and strategic resource locations.

name: FireTry
shortDescription: FireTry is a 2D overhead co-op tank game. Steer your tank with your keyboard, gamepad or your own codes. Design levels, defeat your enemies and push the limits. Play now for an immersive tank experience!

name: The Blackbird of Amor
shortDescription: When there is an unsolved mystery, Stein can't let it go, he must pursue it till the end. In Amor there is a certain woman that interests him, she is rumored to have eternal youth. To solve the mystery of this woman he must tear heaven from earth. His journey will take him far beyond the world he has known.

name: FLAGFIGHTS
shortDescription: FLAGFIGHTS is an online action shooter in which you can choose where you want to fight and the side to play for. The goal of the game is to capture the flag as long as possible against the other team and at the same time shoot as many opponents as possible.

name: BomberX
shortDescription: Take control of atypical characters and blow up as many enemies as possible. Single player or multiplayer, fight for wealth and get equipment that shows your power!

name: Freight Simulator
shortDescription: Manage your transport company! Be a transportation entrepreneur, with control over everything in your business. Work, earn, invest and expand!

name: BlazeSky
shortDescription: BlazeSky is a space opera action RPG that tells the story of one person changing the fate of an entire galaxy. Explore stunning hand-crafted star systems, fight against strange alien races, and negotiate with key allies in this fully voice acted epic adventure.

name: Cowboy
shortDescription: This is a third person role-playing game，Players have swords, bows and arrows, and guns（You need to be on a horse to use it）,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players must maintain health，Players can kill nearby monsters or dodge attacks from monsters.

name: Defense and Revenge
shortDescription: Defense and Revenge is a turn-based strategy set in fantasy universe. You have to lead orcs tribe, provide defense and take revenge on enemies invading your land.

name: The Square Game
shortDescription: The Square Game is an insanely hard 2D action platformer with 24 short action packed levels.

name: 匿名信：失心者 / Stayer
shortDescription: Anonymous letter: the loss of heart is the beginning of the series of anonymous letter puzzle game, mainly tells about the intern detective man because of receiving an anonymous letter and broke the original quiet, when the letter instructions came to the abandoned 13 high school, found that everything has changed, is the trap?

name: Steamliner
shortDescription: Welcome aboard the Steamliner! As a carriage tester, you will experience anything from classic escape rooms to physics-defying surrealistic scenarios. Try to solve brain-melting puzzles inside a Victorian railway traveling through space!

name: Mompreneur: Pizza Cooking Life Sim
shortDescription: Live the life of a new mom in this story-driven cooking game.

name: Dungeon Cards
shortDescription: Simple fast-paced card crawler with roguelike elements and addictive gameplay

name: capy hoky
shortDescription: Sokpop S04: capy hoky - capybara ice-hockey! Control a cast of wacky animals in this funny sports game. Play your real or AI friends in versus mode, or team up to compete in the Capy Cup and unlock new animals!

name: Potion Commotion
shortDescription: Live the CRAZY life of a Wizard’s assistant in this hilarious Clicker game! You’ll be in charge of making wacky and wonderful Potions, using ingredients produced in your garden. With plenty of twists and turns along the way, the fun never stops! Do you have what it takes?

name: Hand In Hand
shortDescription: An atmospheric platformer with puzzle elements and split screen, where the player takes control of two characters at once. Immerse yourself in the ethnic world of two heroes, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles together, explore the fairy forest and other locations, help each other.

name: Smart Moves
shortDescription: "Smart Moves" is a puzzle with a turn-based mechanics. . Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

name: Cosmos
shortDescription: Cosmos is a rogue-lite shoot-em-up bullet-hell, in which you pilot the last hope for humanity in an attempt to save the world, pitching your augmented Starship against infused cosmic horrors. Can you close the Cosmic Rifts before The Singularity reaches your star system?

name: Virtually Real Life
shortDescription: "Reality. A term concocted by creatures to give worth to their version of reality..." What happens if a 2D being is dragged into a 3D realm? Follow the "hero" through a world he/she barely understands and survive the demonic beings who brought our hero into this realm.

name: The Island Story
shortDescription: The Island Story is leisure simulation game. Players can change the appearance of the island by placing different animals, plants and decorative items freely. Plants and animals also produce fruit and dust resources for further exploration and play.

name: Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions-
shortDescription: From the developer of Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler-, comes the next installment in the series, Unity Unions! A young jewelmancer must stop the reawakening of a great evil and discover the truth behind her powers.

name: Coloniam
shortDescription: Colonize islands and grow your population. Manage trade routes and resources to meet the ever increasing needs of your colonist.

name: FlowState
shortDescription: This simulator is a true FPV Drone Racing simulator. The goal is to make it look and feel as similar to a standard racing drone as possible. As such, the goal is not to make the most HD/GoPro-esque visuals. Instead the focus is on simulating what pilots see through the goggles, static and all!

name: Aloe and Cal
shortDescription: Dive into the world of Aloe and Cal and experience a gently paced visual novel about the importance of food. With thousands of fun choices to make, over 100 CGs to look at, and 7 colorful characters to meet, you will undoubtedly walk away satisfied!

name: 郡主别怕
shortDescription: 《郡主别怕》是一款以刺客和锦衣卫明争暗斗为背景的全新社交推理游戏，玩家将分为锦衣卫与刺客两大阵营，扮演郡主及护卫展开一场权谋大战！

name: BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre Demo
shortDescription: BDSM is the first satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son! Get some booze, kill the traitors, save Hell and rescue the hottest demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

name: Race Condition
shortDescription: Set in a modern low-poly arcade world, players of Race Condition find themselves as a rookie in a highly competitive open-wheel racing league. A rivalry with one suspiciously good opponent complicates things further.

name: sok-stories
shortDescription: A simple game making tool. Draw objects, drag them onto a canvas, and make rules to make a game! Easily upload your stories and share them anywhere, with anyone. What will you make?

name: Submersed
shortDescription: Rediscover the meaning of terror with Submersed. Are you afraid of depths? You will be.

name: Ageless
shortDescription: Ageless is a story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to progress. Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets and herself.

name: Circle
shortDescription: This is the game that nurtures “Circle” and adventures in the "Outside" of the room.

name: Island Saver
shortDescription: A group of amazing islands need your help! Horrid plastic waste has washed up and you need to sort it out with your trusty Trash Blaster! But look out for the Litterbugs. They love mess and they’re out to muck things up.

name: Purgatory Overkill
