shortDescription: Qual is a fast paced top-down bullet hell that emphasizes on spell combinations.

name: EMPTY
shortDescription: In the world of "EMPTY" Earth is flat, and Depart from the very ground. You will be controlling "Master Humpback", Jump through each level and collect "RED CORE". While you walk through Each level, you will discover the Story of "EMPTY".

name: Crypt Of Shadows
shortDescription: Shoot- bang, get through the rooms! A rogue-like dungeon crawler, take pills and survive.

name: Evil Cult
shortDescription: This is a strategy board game of Lovecraftian macabre. Gain resources, grow your cult, stay hidden from the world, and when the stars are finally right summon the Elder God you worship. Alternatively, just eliminate the competition in an invisible war.

name: Rocket Shipment
shortDescription: A tricky physics based rocketship delivery game with an integrated level editor.

name: GraFi Valentine
shortDescription: GraFi Valentine - casual, colorful, minimalist, physical puzzle with traps, treadmills, portals, hearts and changing gravity.

name: The Watcher's Pursuit
shortDescription: You’ve uncovered dangerous secrets, and now the corporation you work for is hunting you down. Survive the night, monitor camera's and find a solution to the problem. Trust no one. Stay sharp. Your life depends on it.

name: VE GSIM Crane Simulator
shortDescription: Crane Simulator. Experience the challenge of controlling an overhang crane and tower crane in VR. Take the crane through an obstacle course.

name: Phoenix Strike
shortDescription: In a casual game with a top view, you have to control military equipment from a Quad bike to a tank (only 4 types). During the passage of the location, you need to break enemy ambushes, but also collect keys to get to the boss. Defeating the boss will open access to the next level.

name: Isle Of Spirits
shortDescription: Isle of spirits is a chill and casual survival game taking place on a mysterious desert isle. Build your home, survive, and fight against microclimates or supernatural phenomenons. The isle will be your home and your enemy: it offers all resources to live, but it is also full of terrible dangers.

name: Redneck Ed: Astro Monsters Show
shortDescription: Crisp combat mechanics, challenging arenas, hilarious storyline, and totally addictive and painfully familiar spot-on gameplay. Experience the thrills of fighting your way through the most bizarre villains in the Galaxy and defend the honor of Earth in the space arena!

name: Great Alhcemist
shortDescription: Great Alchemist is a classic 3-in-a-row puzzle game.

name: Hot steel
shortDescription: Take on the role of a monster hunter who has occupied independent lands.

name: Samozbor ID:HEAVEN
shortDescription: Breach enemy stronghold in dread Siberian wastelands before insurgents can open gates to Samozbor dimension.

name: Attack of the alien thingies from lava!
shortDescription: Try to survive the increasing waves of alien thingies! Unlock and upgrade guns, pickup power-ups, get Steam achievements. Have fun with this brainless shooter game!

name: Anti Air
shortDescription: Are you the new recruit? Well, grab your weapons and descent into battle on distant planets. There you will combat the Alien invasion called the Cubicon Conjunction. Waves will hit you so you better blast these invaders from the sky before they crash onto your base.How many will you take down?

name: HVOR
shortDescription: HVOR - a dynamic top-down shooter, which takes place in the world,affected by an unknown infection.Kill the infected - and try not to join him.

name: Building the Universe: The Beginning of Time
shortDescription: Building the Universe is a time travel and building game that starts at the Big Bang and progresses through time as players recreate the conditions that resulted in the very fire atoms being created.

name: The Trud
shortDescription: The Trud is a horror game that combines exploration with stealth gameplay, here you'll need to find your way out and discover what's happening in the school while monsters are trying to catch you.

name: AREA MAN LIVES
shortDescription: AREA MAN LIVES. Or does he? A quirky radio drama unfolds around you in VR while you do your best to keep the radio station humming along as its new DJ. You record commercials, interview callers and try your best to piece together how your actions inside the station impact your listening audience.

name: Fields of Glory
shortDescription: Return to a true wargame based on Napoleon's Waterloo campaign! Become a General in control of huge armies in this classic, historic-themed RTS!

name: Tower Blitz
shortDescription: Tower Blitz is a fun and challenging Tower Defence game with over 10 levels

name: Blood Relation Part1.
shortDescription: Proceed with tools, notes, etc. in a closed building. Overcome various fears and complete tasks. Unlock secrets hidden in the building.

name: Red Town
shortDescription: Welcome to Red Town! This is an old small village in which the villagers live calmly, contacting with environment very seldom. But despite this they are very glad to tourists! Be sure: the locals are eager to help you!

name: Goomanuvr
shortDescription: In this hilarious and procedurally generated challenging platformer, swing and jump your way though to the goal. Put your skills to the test in Single or Multiplayer.

name: Legion's Crawl 2
shortDescription: Legion's Crawl 2 is a classic turn-based, grid-based, roguelike dungeon crawler! Build your character, pick up and enhance your gear, defeat enemies with a minimum loss, eat to survive, and conquer the randomly generated dungeons!

name: 禁忌
shortDescription: 在广阔的艾尔德林大陆做出你的选择，完成你的使命。在千千万万繁琐细碎的线索中找到事情的真相

name: My Universe - School Teacher
shortDescription: Play as a young teacher with a mission: bringing your new school back to the top! Motivate your pupils, improve their results and organize school contests and festivals.

name: UNNAMED
shortDescription: You - an UNNAMED suicide with a question mark instead of a face. But it looks like dying won't be so easy.

name: Cave Game
shortDescription: A simple concept with infinite possibilites. A procedurally generated 2D platformer.

name: 100 Doors Game - Escape from School
shortDescription: A girl named Mia is locked inside a school. Help her escape by solving puzzles and riddles, as well as finding hidden objects along the way that open the doors of every single room she finds herself trapped in.

name: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Rescue
shortDescription: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Resuce is a sequel to Terra Lander, a homage to the classic early days of arcade retro, but this time you will need to rescue the humanoids of the landing pads from the planet through ten levels of increasing difficulty.

name: Into A Dream
shortDescription: You are his last hope. The only one who can rescue him. Delve deep into the dreams of Luke Williams, a man diagnosed with depression, unfold the heartbreaking story of his life and prevent him from... fading away.

name: Never Date Werewolves
shortDescription: Dating a werewolf means you’re left with a litter of kids who turn into cubs when they get upset. You’ve got the silver out of the house, meat in the fridge – but contrary to your ex, you can’t turn into a wolf when the cubs decide to do a runner!

name: Interference: Dead Air
shortDescription: All hell's breaking loose in a mysterious research facility and the only person who can save the day is the night shift security guard in the booth outside. Remotely control systems, guide scientists to safety or just… goof off? You’re not in danger. Yet.

name: McSpace Colosseum
shortDescription: McSpace Colosseum is a dungeon crawler fully packed with action and roguelite elements. Discover all kind of worlds, collect crazy gadgets &relics, and face blood-lusting bosses with up to 4 friends. Will you rise as the strongest gladiator in this whacky and limitless reality show?

name: MoonRun
shortDescription: Fight incoming waves in this classic pixel-art arcade game! Put your top-tier aiming skills to the test, get rewarded, and trade up your ammo to defeat the final boss.

name: Retro Incremental
shortDescription: In this retro-themed incremental game, auto-click to destroy polygon-shaped asteroids to get some cash. Spend that cash to get upgrades to make it easier and faster to destroy asteroids!

name: Simple LOTO Simulator
shortDescription: This Simple LOTO Simulator was developed to provide employers of any size, with a cost effective method to verify their employees' understanding of the Energy Control Procedure usually required under OSHA's Lockout/Tagout Standard.

name: Peg Solitaire Adventure
shortDescription: This game is an implementation of the board game Peg Solitaire. The objective is, making valid moves, to empty the entire board except for a solitary peg in the central hole. Seven types of game layouts.

name: FatCat with Hat - Reload the Powergun
shortDescription: FatCat's life is relaxed. But one day his great love Mrs.Cat is kidnapped by the nasty FatDog. FatCat immediately sets out to save his beloved, but the cunning FatDog is prepared. He sends his henchmen to take out the unloved adversary.

name: Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary
shortDescription: Play as the White Rabbit in a schedule-based visual novel game set in the world of Alice in Wonderland.

name: Wandering Through The Vines
shortDescription: You find yourself in a strange land, by shooting and melee defeat your foes and journey to the end...

name: Sudd City Adventures
shortDescription: Sudd City Adventures is a lighthearted point-and-click 2D narrative game set in a world of ordinary superheroes.

name: Pancake House
shortDescription: Pancake House is a VR first-person shooting game. If you want to survive and save the world, you must defeat zombies.

name: Fractured Core
shortDescription: Lead a team of mercenaries in a cyberpunk world where elemental powers and corporate conspiracies collide. Take on high-risk missions, engage in strategic turn-based combat, and uncover the truth lurking beneath the surface.

name: Relentless
shortDescription: In this simulation, discover the impact of market finance on real economy. Take the lead of a trading desk and challenge your financial skills and instincts to earn as much money as possible!

name: Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand
shortDescription: Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand is a game about an operation for rescuing a princess kidnapped by monsters in a fantasy desert kingdom. The hero (user) must solve numerous puzzles and deal with countless monsters to complete the operation. It combines adventure puzzles with RPG elements.

name: Pyro the Exterminator
shortDescription: A post-apocalypse story of exterminator with contract to clear a military depot

name: Cube
shortDescription: Cube is an adventurer who does not rule out challenges.

name: AZ: Oath of Brotherhood Prologue 1
shortDescription: This game intends to create a simple gameplay and story-heavy experience. Players will help a teenage boy go through a tough time in his life. A story that shows how friendship works when we need it the most.

name: Yoren
shortDescription: Yoren is the first cutting-edge realistic VR magic game. Cast spells by drawing rune gestures, explore the openworld collecting crafting ingredients for potions and battle the numerous bosses of fallen kingdoms in the world of Yoren.

name: Death courier
shortDescription: In 2340. Earth ravaged, nearly destroyed. The last cities try to keep themselves alive and not starve. Hard times ahead. The roads to the other cities are destroyed, devastated or besieged by bandits.

name: LOVE - A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories
shortDescription: Every life has a story. Every story has regret. But what if you could change the past? LOVE is a puzzle game about finding the things we’ve lost in ourselves and the people who help us find them.

name: T.A.R.S
shortDescription: It is the year 2051, a disease has swept across the planet infecting over 90% of the population. You will take on the role of Samantha in this 3rd person horror shooter. Can you survive?

name: Formula Retro Racing
shortDescription: Formula Retro Racing is a retro style arcade racing game that’s influenced by the classic arcade racing games of the early 90’s.

name: Draco VR Dragon Sim
shortDescription: Vr Physics sandbox Demo. Very Early access to support the game.

name: Up on the Rooftop
shortDescription: Santa's elves have revolted! Christmas is falling apart, but reindeer are on the case! Knock sense into the elves and ensure Santa can make his delivery on time! Avoid Bears! Make deliveries along the way! They must save Christmas; they will save Christmas!

name: Up on the Rooftop Soundtrack
shortDescription: Rock around the Christmas tree to these festive songs from Up on the Rooftop!Features remixes of popular holiday tunes!

name: Cannon Jump
shortDescription: "Don't forget to bring your cannon! Shoot down and jump up, it will help you,” said the old pirate. Legend has it that countless treasures are kept up there. In this game, you have to jump and climb up using the classic "rocket jump" technique.

name: Memory Player
shortDescription: A memory training game that let you memorize the order of one shuffled deck of 52 playing cards in minutes.

name: Infection Point
shortDescription: Infection Point is a quarter view Hack and slash zombie hunting game.A gas leak occurs in the city.The main character arrives at a skyscraper that reads "The One" to determine the cause of the accident.What happened in this building?

name: Xyla and the 'Shrooms of Doom
shortDescription: Xyla is a pink haired hero who was raised as an elite Forest Agent. She realised early on in her life that dedication to her jumping and shooting skills would lead her to success. Work with Xyla as she navigates the unpredictable terrain of the forest.

name: Greed: Abandoned Dogs
shortDescription: GREED: Abandoned Dogs is a competitive “PvEvP” Third-Person Shooter. Travel back in time to ancient civilizations where your sole goal is to survive, loot treasures and escape. Be the last one standing to sell stolen relics and become rich.

name: Astronaut: The Best
shortDescription: Astronaut: The Best is an occult management adventure where people aren't just numbers: they're screwups. You must run a proper space academy using lies, witchcraft, and/or hard work. Guide cadets through a roguelite web of scandals and challenges, or the government will have you killed.

name: The Yolk Street
shortDescription: Evil boss oppresses his employees to make money again! How do you go about your life when you have financial pressure and want to have a girlfriend? ?！ 「The Yolk Street」will satisfy you all!

name: Luciform
shortDescription: Luciform is a color-based precision platformer that demands quick reflexes and nerves of steel. Can you help “Luci” navigate a dangerous forest to save its people from the nasty Red-Eyed Gorilla?

name: Dantes Bullet Inferno
shortDescription: Dantes Bullet Inferno is a shoot-em-up where the player fights against hell as Dante. This top down shooter includes a speedrun mode called time-dilation.

name: SokoBunny
shortDescription: SokoBunny is new fully 3d look at classic sokoban. Play alone or with your friend online, kick the cargo in the warehouse labyrinth.

name: Typical Cliche
shortDescription: So obvious and typical story, just puzzle and dodge traps. (English version will be provided soon.)

name: Dashing Fire
shortDescription: DASH between tiny, monster-infested planets on your journey to becoming the next Sun!

name: Unlord
shortDescription: Lords of the Damned Land - a text quest, a book-playing in the genre of gloomy fantasy, mixed with jokes on the verge of madness. 80,000 words, 1000 pages, 3 win endings and lots of other endings.

name: Rocket Panda Panic
shortDescription: It's a Panda-emic! Spreading across the globe causing panic and fear. Only one hero has the courage, power and cuteness to save us all. Join Pandy and his jetpack as they travel the world, protecting us from the critter panda plague.

name: Legendary Knight
shortDescription: The enemy is invading your lands, and only the Legendary Knight, the king himself, can rally his forces to stand against them. As both ruler and commander, you must lead your army, fortify defenses, and push back relentless waves of invaders to safeguard your kingdom.

name: The Botanist
shortDescription: The Botanist is 3D platformer featuring magical world of Bob’s dreams and nightmares full of exciting adventures and dangerous creatures. Enter his mind to go through the Dark Forbidden Forest and Broken Land.

name: Infestation: Battle Royale
shortDescription: Infestation: Battle Royale is a free-to-play, zombie-infested Battle Royale game. Fight in groups of 3 or solo until only one team remains standing. Discover a wide selection of maps, guns and customizations. Join in and let the good memories come back in this massively revamped all-time classic!

name: Galactic Center VR
shortDescription: Explore the center of the Milky Way like never before!

name: Shell Corp
shortDescription: Shell Corp is a 1-8 local multiplayer, physics based egg-centric, party game where you control, paint, and crack eggs! Using simple controls and wobbly eggs, play against your friends, or AI, in a series frantic mini-games. Will you take home the Egg Cup?

name: TechnoTsunami
shortDescription: Solve puzzles to uncover the mysteries of a space cruise ship. Fight or work together with robots which are remotely controlled by humans on Earth. Collect the technology coming from the future which might cause an apocalypse. Save the future and the past before it’s too late.

name: Witch and Spirit
shortDescription: Play Hide and Seek in the Mistery Land with friends in Compete Mode or Collaborate Mode.

name: Dungeon Warriors
shortDescription: Dungeon Warriors is a random dungeon barrage game that we use to polish our lives

name: Beach anime day
shortDescription: Beach anime day– a game that is a puzzle. The task of the game is to add up and get a whole picture, from the pieces into which it is cut.

name: Chicken Hero in Wulin
shortDescription: All Creatures will be uphold justice and "chivalrous".In the familiar world of martial arts,I regenerate a chicken.As a chicken, can you change your life against the weather and create miracles!Become an unprecedented and fantastic Great Xia! Everything is about to start!

name: kosmickop
shortDescription: In a post apocalyptic wasteland a jerboa is impersonating a police officer, much to the chagrin of a shadowy evil organisation.

name: Hades Ultimate Fighting Ball
shortDescription: Hades Ultimate Fighting Ball is a multiplayer sports game of ball and fighting.

name: PIVO
shortDescription: PIVO is a game that solves puzzles between 2D space and 3D space. Experience transcending space with a cute corgi.

name: Dark Room
shortDescription: Dark Room is an atmospheric point-and-click adventure game. You awaken in a mysterious, locked environment with no memory of who you are. Solve intricate puzzles, inspect hidden objects, and piece together forgotten journal entries to unlock the truth behind your confinement.

name: Scorched Islands
shortDescription: Move to one of islands and fight with AI or other players at the keyboard. Set shooting angles and power and destroy enemy tanks.5 islands with different conditions and environmentVarious weather effects affecting the battleFull ballistics physicsSurprises to discover

name: Legacy of Sin: The Father Sacrifice
shortDescription: Welcome to the original Legacy of Sin game! The Father's Sacrifice is a route defense combined with an epic fantasy storyline straight out of a 90s TV serial. Face an orcish army in a fantasy take on early modern warfare! Deploy your men, hold the line, and defend the kingdom!

name: 잭과 콩나무: 숨겨진 이야기
shortDescription: 원작 동화 '잭과 콩나무' 를 모티브로 한 게임. 전쟁으로 황폐해진 마을에 살고 있는 잭은, 어느 날 한 마녀로부터 알 수 없는 콩을 받는다. 다음 날, 잭은 마당에 자란 콩나무 줄기를 타고 올라가게 되는데.. 잭은 그곳에서 신비로운 콩나무 성을 탐험하게 된다.

name: Shadow Puppets & Beijing opera
shortDescription: The work is composed of a total of 4 acts with about 15 minutes. The images and characters of this work are based on one of China’s intangible cultural heritage: Shadow Puppets, and the story and music of the game are based on another China’s intangible cultural heritage: Beijing Opera .

name: 已下架
shortDescription: 《神鬼降世》是一款即时战斗类MMORPG网页游戏游戏 游戏整体上延用了经典的战士、法师、牧师三种职业，同时为玩家提供了三大职业神翼、十二星座守护灵兽、四大上古骑宠等玩法 。 是一款娱乐性，互动性都比较强的网页游戏，虽然画面较为简单，但游戏的PK方面还是做得很到位的。 一键精准敌人锁定击杀，满屏热血攻沙精彩，满足你的传奇体验。 复古写实的游戏画风，经典的传奇游戏玩法，带你重回记忆中的热血岁月。

name: Idle Warrior
shortDescription: Idle Warrior is a little idle/clicker game in which you play an warrior who has to fight against an unlimited number of enemies.

name: Jetpack Stadium
shortDescription: Jetpack Stadium is a hilarious VR sports game that will have you flying around a virtual stadium. Use your head to hit a massive soccer ball into your opponent's goal using two hand-mounted rockets. Duke it out against other players in a soccer-like competition!

name: SaveKunkun
shortDescription: Dive into horror-comedy with SaveKunkun. Play as an IKUN fan stuck in a time loop, remembering each reset. When a prank injures your friend, prevent their fall using over 100 methods. Explore time's mysteries, uncover friend's intentions, and save them.

name: POLYGON
shortDescription: POLYGON is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using various weapons, you will battle with up to 32 players on large-scale maps. Properly managing your arsenal and skills, you will lead your team to victory!

name: ANARCHY
shortDescription: ANARCHY is an escape / survivor games. Horde of robots, climbing, traps and many other things will try to kill you. It is one of the toughest games on steam right now.

name: Return to Sender
shortDescription: Return to Sender is a bullet-frenzy and rogue-like shooter. Killing each enemy returns a portion of your ammo, resulting in a fluid and chaotic run with nonstop shooting. Fight your way through enemies all while collecting new weapons and upgrades.

name: 降神战役 -A Story of the usurpers-
shortDescription: Because of an accident, the war once again descended on this land where peace has been welcomed for less than 10 years. Rebels swarming up, weak religious orders, hostile neighbors in the north. Where will the fate of the country go?

name: Hack or Die!
shortDescription: The Hacky-Sack Platformer! Keep the ball air-born while you kick your way through sprawling levels. Use unique kicking mechanics to rescue your best friend Kevin the dog. Just DONT DROP IT!!!

name: FierceWind Decay
shortDescription: Endless guidance, endless reincarnation

name: Reborn: in the Android Womb
shortDescription: You are a Sperm Cell that wants to be reborn. Kill other players, destroy viruses and become the first to conquer the Egg Cell! Use thousands of combinations of abilities, many costumes and drones, buy and sell at auction.

name: Bomb Fight
shortDescription: Bomb Fight is a local-multiplayer action party game. Destroy your friends or cooperate with them in a frenzy of bombs without destroying your self.

name: Dirty Harry's Thunder Drive
shortDescription: Rip up the streets of Neon City as a One-Car Thunderstorm. Your mission is to cause as much destruction as possible on the city's busiest highway. Your weapons? Wrecking Balls, Dynamite, and the pure speed of your prized Red Stallion.

name: TAG.IO
shortDescription: Join in the biggest game of Tag in the world!

name: Fatal Wings
shortDescription: Fatal wings is a classic top down space shoot ‘em. Playing as the last resistance fighters from the similian colony in planet Lithios against a brutal attack led by vernor’s forces

name: There Is No Game: Jam Edition 2015
shortDescription: A little game that’s not a game, winner of an old game jam that nobody’s ever heard of. So DON'T INSTALL IT!

name: Energy Island Corp.
shortDescription: Build and manage an electric grid ! At the start of the day, build new infrastructure and plan your day. Once ready, start the day then watch electricity production / consumption in real time to adjust your buildings settings. The growth of the islands depends on you !

name: CatDog Puzzle
shortDescription: CatDog Puzzle - slide puzzle game. You need solve the puzzle as fast as you can.

name: Bowmen
shortDescription: Lord Pain has risen once more to threaten the land of the living. As the last of an elite race known only as the Bowmen, you must gather your courage and slay his armies once again. Fight off hordes of enemies, equip unique items, and see how long you can survive in our debut title: Bowmen!

name: Get Good
shortDescription: A tough, skill based precision 2.5D platformer that will push you to your limits. Can you get good?

name: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War
shortDescription: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War is a game of grand strategy and fast-play tactical battles where you take the role of either the Union or the Confederates and attempt to win.

name: Warzone 2100
shortDescription: In the late 21st century, the world's civilizations are wiped out by a series of nuclear strikes, seemingly caused by a massive malfunction of the new NASDA (North American Strategic Defense Agency) strategic defense system.

name: Skid Cities
shortDescription: A Cyberpunk City Building Game. Define the city of a twisted, dark, utopian, or dystopian future. Build it in the sky, underground, on the ground. Navigate evil corporations, the Yakuza, android revolts, and unrest. Or embrace them - your choice.

name: 双子树 TwinTrees
shortDescription: Live Danmaku interactive game.

name: Tower of the Approval
shortDescription: New feeling! Roguelike action!Do you know such a story? ?When you reach the top floor, you will be recognized as a single person ApplivarA story about a craftsman who starts to yearn for such a tower and aims for the top floor.

name: The House in the Forest
shortDescription: The House in the Forest is a short, first-person exploration game about a family who moved out to go live a lonely life. You'll play as a person who got lost on the way back to his house ends up discovering clean but an abandoned house.

name: James Peris: No license nor control - Definitive edition
shortDescription: Graphic adventure with lots of extras and mini-games. Two difficulty levels and a clue system for those who may get stuck at some point even in the easy mode.

name: Send them to the sky
shortDescription: Use your magic cell keeping those funny villagers in the sky and don't let them down!

name: Pixel Pileup Party
shortDescription: A green on green 4-in-1 game collection styled after the most popular 90's handheld ever!

name: Infiniball
shortDescription: Infiniball is a simple yet addictive marble based game.

name: Galaxy Warfighter
shortDescription: Taking its roots from the classic games in the shoot'em up genre, «Galaxy Warfighter» conveys the old ideas in a new way. Piloting your fighter ship, you have to fight hordes of enemies with unpredictable strategies and attack schemes.

name: Nimbatus - Drone Creator
shortDescription: Use the Nimbatus Drone Creator to construct physically simulated drones and try them out in a virtual testing environment. Do you have what it takes to become a drone engineer?

name: Hellpoint: The Thespian Feast
shortDescription: This is a standalone story in Hellpoint universe, a dark and challenging action RPG set in the world where the line between science and occultism is blurred. The Thespian Feast tells the story of an investigator arriving at Irid Novo station 50 years after the Hellpoint events.

name: Mr Maker 3D Level Editor
shortDescription: Mr Maker 3D Level Editor is a platform game, with a level maker. Inspired by the games of the 90s, but with a touch of modernity.

name: The Galactic Junkers
shortDescription: Become the space captain you always wanted to be. There are just a few problems, your ship needs work, there’s a price on your head, and your crew are idiots. Seek your fortune and the truth in The Galactic Junkers, a comedic space combat adventure game.

name: Season Match 4
shortDescription: Try out a challenging mix of match3, puzzles and quests in the breathtaking game Season Match 4! Enjoy nice characters, an amazing plot full of unexpected twists and lots of thrilling match-3 quests.

name: Mossen Seikkailut
shortDescription: Mossen Seikkailut is an indie RPG adventure where you solve puzzles as a dog and face real-time fights on your way to glory. Gain respect by helping others and learn new fighting techniques to defeat those who oppose you. Experience all of this in magnificent 640x480 resolution!

name: K'nife Fight
shortDescription: An exciting party brawler that encourages you to play with your food!

name: Turret
shortDescription: When Artificial Intelligence goes to war it won’t sound like a war. It will sound like a harmony of reason and logic... Mankind will shut it’s eyes in total agreement.

name: War for Magincia
shortDescription: In this prequel to Swamp Castle and the Great Tournament, lead a medieval faction as it attempts to secure the Kingdom of Magincia. Deal with other hostile factions and fight off barbarians to secure your rule.

name: Sigma Draconis
shortDescription: A group of colonists from a distant world have arrived at their new home. Equipped with advanced technology but limited resources, they must build to survive. Sigma Draconis is a colony simulation game which focuses on building and resource management.

name: RUBICON
shortDescription: RUBICON is a local multiplayer split-screen party shooter inside an omnidirectional puzzle cube, an action-packed PvP game show where every round has a powerful new weapon and each battle adds a zany new twist.

name: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat
shortDescription: Spunk Dodgers and his sidekick Splat are ambushed by a group of space pirates and crash land on a mysterious asteroid! As Splat, dodge wacky space monsters through hazardous terrain on your adventure to help Spunk Dodgers fix your ship!

name: Detectives United III: Timeless Voyage Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Detectives United is out of options and working for the villains!

name: KUR
shortDescription: Destroy drones, ravage robots and stomp some skull-bearing spiderdroids in a dark-humor drenched take on the classic 90’s shooter.

name: Tobari 2: Dream Ocean
shortDescription: Tobari is back in the latest action platformer from indie developer, desunoya. Use that staff and smack around your enemies for their magic as you traverse the Dream Ocean. Seek out the mysterious voice that calls to you from beyond the sea as you journey with Tobari into this unknown new world.

name: Vaporwave World
shortDescription: "Vaporwave World" is a simple and casual buiding game that has three art packs (Egypt, Roman, 1980s). You can customize the lights in the game, and you will automatically get various types of buiding items over time.

name: Stalker
shortDescription: The background story of "Stalker" is that a teenager encounters various events on the road following a young girl. The teenager(player) can selectively interact and give repairs / help due to these events. How you will lead to different ending. The game was developed during the Global Game Jam 2020.

name: Entelechy

name: The Trivial Dead
shortDescription: Grab some friends to help you fend off a horde of brain eating zombies by answering 1000’s of trivia questions! Earn killstreaks by answering multiple questions in a row. Choose your difficulty and how many waves you can survive against, or even try our survival endless mode.

name: Birth ME Code
shortDescription: The second entry of the Abime Series. Play as the mastermind in a death game where you must find the traitor while concealing your identity. Six hours, one school, six deaths. Nine participants fight for survival: it's kill or be killed, trust or deceive, escape or die.

name: The Curse of Zigoris
shortDescription: The Curse Of Zigoris is an action adventure pixel art platformer game with a story about a girl who tries to lift the curse from her village.

name: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place

It ponders the violence of erasure and the profound grief of surviving at the edge of despotism, when places of entangled heritage are willfully effaced.

name: Tales in the TAXI
shortDescription: 『Tales in the TAXI』 is a multi-ending adventure game in which the story diverges by driving a taxi and talking with passengers.

name: Summon Masks
shortDescription: A Shaman gives life to Masks just to play with them. Take a side and show to the Shaman which is the best Mask.

name: Bloodwych
shortDescription: A dark fantasy role play adventure that pits your strategic thinking against an insane ruler and his mystical forces.

name: Steampunk Genius
shortDescription: Create futuristic designs in the fantastic world of Steampunk.

name: Sarawak

name: Apprehend;Girlfriend

name: Hnefatafl
shortDescription: The ancient boardgame of the Vikings. Thousands of variants, offline and online cross-platform play with leaderboards and tournaments. Are you ready for the challenge? Prepared to earn your way to Valhalla?

name: Adventures of JQ Jones: "Isle of the Serpent Empress"
shortDescription: An action, adventure, stealth, VR maze crawler game. Explore and help JQ Jones collect gems, Serpent's eggs, hidden door knobs and keys to open gates. Battle against the enemies to pass through each levels by using your longbow, sword and Shuriken blade.

name: Ninshi Masuta
shortDescription: Ninshi Masuta is a 2D action game where you are a ninja and have to save the city from the chaos caused by criminals.

name: Warspace
shortDescription: Warspace is a arcade space shooter game.

name: Carnival Games
shortDescription: Carnival Games offers fun for everyone and can be played alone or with up to three others. Hit home runs, pile the highest stack of cakes, and take your horse to the finish line. 20 total mini-games will have you and your friends stepping right up to win again and again!

name: Touch Typing Home Row Speed Grinder
shortDescription: An Onscreen Keyboard that is compatible with many programs, it allows you to take your Typing Training Everywhere You go! It also has Onboard Grinding Games that can be played offline allowing you to learn how to type using the "Key Rollover Method".

name: King of Vikings
shortDescription: King of Vikings is an adventure visual novel set in a Viking fantasy land. You play as a Viking noble summoned by Queen Mathilde to defeat a tentacled menace by assembling an elite unit of warriors.

name: Tiny Bunny: Prologue
shortDescription: Tiny Bunny: Prologue is a non-linear horror visual novel. Those, who have heard the voice of the forest, are beyond help.

name: Survival Denied
shortDescription: Survival Denied is a casual zombie shooter, made primarily with VR in mind. Wide choice of weapons, perks and power-ups make the game interesting. Dive in and try to survive as long as you can!

name: 愛神餐館MAX
shortDescription: Love, restaurant, and RPG adventure all in one, the origin of the "Cupid Bistro!!" series is here! As the main protagonist Rato Coriander, you need to run a bistro as part of your final year assignment. In one year's time, you are the one to decide all different endings with 13 beautiful girls!

name: Ourea
shortDescription: Ourea is a Cinematic Puzzle game about discovering the harrowing past of a long-forgotten world. Play as the last of the Oreads and unravel the mysterious history of your people.​

name: PASVAN
shortDescription: You can't get away from 'GAMAN' !

name: Space Station Manager
shortDescription: Space Station Manager is an exciting game where you own a space company, your main goal is to build a space station, make profit, grow your business, build an economical network, and expand beyond the solar system.

name: Swamp Castle
shortDescription: You are a newly appointed Lord in charge of a small castle. Manage your castle's finances, hire troops, resolve conflicts among the peasants, and bring order to the realm. Expand your power through war, diplomacy, or stealth. Whether you rise or fall is up to you in Swamp Castle.

name: Cyber Battle 69
shortDescription: Cyber Battle 69 is a VR cooperative multiplayer action title set in the distant future on a moon orbiting a gas giant located on the outskirts of the Milky Way. Fight against other players and hordes of infected alike to get rich and make a name for yourself.

name: Laser Heck

Defend a space station against an invading fleet by yourself or with 4 Player Split-Screen Coop, or have some fun with your friends by playing the Deathmatch, Keep Away, and Racing mini-games.

name: Путешествие паладина
shortDescription: Non-linear dramatic story about a paladin that left his home monastery for the first time to go on quest. The quest appeared harder that paladin throught: she is haunted by demons now, and the only people who coul help her - ancient rivals of paladins, the Duids.

name: You are next

name: Orders of Magnitude
shortDescription: Have you ever wondered what the whole Universe looks like? With the myriad Galaxies, each containing billions of Stars, including our Solar System? Have you seen a Human Brain and its Neurons? DNA? What about the Electrons surrounding the tiny Atomic Nucleus? And what lies at even smaller scales?

name: Rhyme Storm
shortDescription: Rhyme Storm is the world's first freestyle rapping rhythm game! It's packed with awesome beats, hilarious topics, and mind blowing visuals that dance and pulse to your performance. You won't be asking if you can freestyle rap -- you'll be wondering how fast you can go!

name: Retro Vaders: Reloaded
shortDescription: The original Retro Vaders game rebuilt from the ground up with a brand new engine, complete graphics overhaul and a heap of new content.

name: 2 Times Circles
shortDescription: 2 Times Circles is a game about controlling 2 circles moving horizontally and vertically in the two split screen at the same time.

name: Flash Snooker Game
shortDescription: Play the best Online Snooker Game, with Rankings, Stats, Tournaments every few hours, Game bets and Cue Upgrades. Practice or Play other Snooker players from all over the world. Quick and easy game play with realistic physics.

name: Recolit
shortDescription: Your spaceship crashes, and you find yourself in a dark town that looks just like any other, but that has something different about it. Its people go about their daily lives as if nothing was off, even though the sky above their heads is always black.

name: Apocalypse Age : DESTRUCTION
shortDescription: This is a classic top-down shooter with top-down gameplay. You are a solider who is looking for the truth, fighting agains monsters to save the world. This is survive game , kill or be kill.

name: Jetpack Guy
shortDescription: Can We Go to the Top? This TV-Headed Guy Want to fly High with His Jetpack! There are Many Annoying Obstacles that stand in Your Way. Be careful your flight! And Watch his Head! Fly to the Top with this Jetpack!

name: 前進吧！高捷少女Initiating Station PLUS
shortDescription: Next station, towards the future with youThe original 2016 visual novel 《高捷少女IS》is now on steam!In addition to all the original content and fully voiced (Chinese) dialogue, four whole new chapters and CGs are ready for you to explore.

name: Crafting Idle Clicker
shortDescription: Craft a complex production line, earn idle cash and become an industrial tycoon!

name: Festoon
shortDescription: Bypass the need to access a physical dome or planetarium to view, test and develop your fulldome show with four software packages. FESTOON, upgrade within Festoon to access FESTOON PRO, FESTOON MULTIPLAYER, and FESTOON PLAYER. See our separate product page to purchase Festoon Player.

name: Cyrano Story
shortDescription: Born from an Alternate Reality Game experience created by Alice & Smith in 2019, Cyrano Story is a complex puzzle game designed to ascend to intergalactic forces and give insight into the backstory of Funcom’s cosmic horror game Moons of Madness.

name: Project Beril / 贝丽尔养成计划
shortDescription: This is an AI game.

name: Summoners Mist

name: Aegis Descent
shortDescription: In this fast-paced roguelite vehicle shooter, WW2 is ending, and a secret testing facility is overrun by an unknown alien force. The best pilots of the war are asked to take an experimental hover tank on a perilous mission - To descend into the caverns below the facility and face this new threat.

name: Wolfie's Break Out

With its simple yet challenging gameplay, retro graphics, and catchy soundtrack, this game is sure to provide hours of fun for gamers of all ages.

name: Brinkmanship
shortDescription: First person shooter FPS

name: Glitchy Apocalypse Simulator
shortDescription: DISCLAIMER: Made by one dev and his kid. Uses lots of assets. Glitchy Apocalypse Simulator is a comical physics-based game. The game is a light-hearted, comical sandbox and makes no attempts at realism or strategy.

name: Cock Soccer
shortDescription: Cock Soccer is a multiplayer, arcade-style 2.5d sports game with multiple customizable characters to choose from, chaotic gameplay that fuses soccer with some beat 'em up elements and maps with traps that can change the course of the match in unexpected ways!

name: Istoria
shortDescription: Istoria is a Story driven Turn-based Strategy Game with a focus on Character Customisation. Follow Nemus Story, who has to recover her lost memories. Craft Items, complete Challenges and Sidequests.

name: Devil fight
shortDescription: This is a third person role playing action game,The player acts as a demon, surrounded by monsters,Players are free to explore the surrounding area. Players can kill monsters or avoid the attacks of monsters. Players need to keep their health as long as possible.

name: JumPlose
shortDescription: Test your thinking speed in this platform game inspired by the 90s, do you think you can win?

name: Frak!
shortDescription: A classic 2d platform puzzle game, with bold retro pixel graphics, and rebooted with plenty of twists.

name: Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure
shortDescription: Travel back in time to help defend Hua Mulan against evil time bandits all while learning Chinese in this story-driven, role-playing, open 3D world episodic adventure.

name: Golf Ace

By completing courses faster than your friends, leave your friends behind on leaderboard and win! More courses, ball customizations and level editor will be added at earlyaccess

name: Box: Boxing
shortDescription: Box:Boxing is a multiplayer virtual reality boxing game with action filled gameplay and unique graphics. Fight against the CPU or others players in the craziest scenarios you've ever seen and become the champion of the Box:Boxing world!

name: Mystic Escape - Diary of a Prisoner
shortDescription: Waking up in a boat in the middle of the ocean, you realize that you have lost your memories. In the distance you can only see an island and the answer is somewhere faraway. It feels like in a prison here. Sometimes you see the silhouette of a beautiful girl and she is leading you somewhere.

name: Brick Breaker VR
shortDescription: The goal of the Brick Breaker VR is to bring the old brick breaker, breakout experiences to life in virtual reality.

name: My Hole is a Mouth of Dirt
shortDescription: A lonely cloaked being called Mole services instructions from what he believes is the voice of God. As he wanders a desolate, otherwordly underground his faith is tested as he must deliver a baby.

shortDescription: In Roman Way, you try to create the most profitable slave network of ancient times. Discover unique mechanics and enjoy Roman era.

Elon Mus, knows how to disrupt the signal that is hijacking the robots and turning them into "zombies." He calls the presidents of several countries, and they work together to save the world

Battle mythical creatures, and decide the fate of the world in this epic adventure. Will you choose salvation or destruction?

name: Alien Scumbags

He gains the power of “Flip”, which let him unveils a hidden truth and takes one step closer to discovering himself. Uncover the truth now in the narrative puzzle game Flip Tale.

name: WWII Partisanen

As a mechanical saint, will you delve into forbidden means to save your people or allow them to go quietly into the night? Set up production chains to spend limited resources to save as many as you can.

name: City Breaker

name: System Invaders
shortDescription: Experience waves upon waves of viruses that have infected your computer. 5 Chapters with over 125 Waves of enemies! Play with your friends in local or online co-op! Can you destroy all the viruses?

name: Virtual Viking

Experience various industry standard fire protection systems in operation during a building fire. Further discover these systems through observations and guided interactive learning.

name: Dark Disharmony
shortDescription: In the role of a will-o-the-wisp you will have to reveal all the five murdered members of the deathmetal band to broke loose hell on the Earth!

name: LumberJack
shortDescription: Lumberjack, the short story game about a caring father.

name: Super Astreus 2
shortDescription: Super Astreus 2 is a 4-player platform game where you will have to watch out for your friends and avoid obstacles and all sort of traps to get to the goal first. Compete in an arsenal of stages or create, play and share your own ideas in the Level creator.

name: Seconds in Space
shortDescription: Use ships to attack and destroy enemy space stations in real time.  Navigate through different randomly setup star maps to get to the exit and win.  It's a 2D single player space game that's massively replayable.

name: Yukikoi Melt

shortDescription: The story happened in subconsciously, someday ego anomalies, “Persona” is one of the managers living subconsciously, she must use mind power and solve problems.

It supports PVE PVP EVE mode gameplay, and also provides the game's unique squadron fuse mode gameplay and gameplay detail adjustment system.

name: VE GSIM Tower Crane Simulator

name: Fusion SHIFT

name: SpiderClimber

name: Sleeping Beauty

name: Spacky's Nightshift

name: World Championship Boxing Manager™
