shortDescription: Coloring Game 3 is a new paint-by-number game which has already won hearts of numerous players. Now the game offers new difficulty modes.

name: Sanity of Morris
shortDescription: Sanity of Morris: a psychological horror adventure game. Your flashlight reveals the clues you need to stay sane in the search for your father. Discover the truth. Could aliens be real?

name: Outcore: Desktop Adventure
shortDescription: All you wanted was a nice game. But now you find yourself opening Windows apps like Paint & Notepad to solve puzzles, and searching for files on your computers that you didn't put there... Who is she? Why did she appear on your desktop? Let's dive into her memories and find out.

name: Street Power Football
shortDescription: Sick style and high-energy action come together in this arcade-style football experience. Face off against street football legends or friends in a variety of over-the-top game modes and playgrounds, unleashing tricks and crushing Super Powers as you grow your status to become Street King.

name: The Narrator is a DICK : Longer, Harder, and Uncut
shortDescription: In this narrated unfair platformer there's one man who's always out to get you... The Narrator. He's a real jerk, but with determination and a lot of skill MAYBE you can make it through this crazy adventure. Remastered with new Online Co-Op and Extended gameplay!

name: Space Otter Charlie
shortDescription: Adorable characters? Check! Makeshift weapons? Check! Otter dressed in a foam shark suit. Umm. Check? Join Charlie and his ragtag team of sea mammals as they jump, float, and rocket through Otter Space in this Zero-G Puzzle Platformer!

name: Stan Lee's Verticus
shortDescription: You are Verticus, a superhero equipped with a high tech, heat-resistant jump suit who must prevent the Earth’s destruction at the hands of an evil alien race known as The Obliterators!

name: Frog Space
shortDescription: Frog Space is a game about the adventures of frog 'Froxy' that avoids obstacles such as animals, vehicles, and terrain. Since only the skills and senses of the player are the only ways to clear this game, it requires a high level of concentration, equanimity, and a challenging spirit.

name: Kick the VIRUS
shortDescription: Kick the VIRUS It's a game that helps when your anger reaches its maximum.

name: WWII Zombies
shortDescription: Spring of 1945. The Third Reich is on the verge of defeat, the regime of the Fuhrer at death. Scientists from Anenerbe freeze Adolf Hitler in a secret cryolaboratory. After 75 years, on his birthday, he awakens and goes to the past to save the world from disaster ...

name: Digital Dungeon Tiles
shortDescription: An extremely quick to use dungeon tile-based mapping tool to build battle maps for “Screen In Table” and "Print" (or Online) based play! Fully orthographic so you can play as if your Miniatures are in the map.

name: Probe
shortDescription: A challenging 2D block breaker featuring arcade elements and a modern spin on the popular retro games. Destroy data blocks and galactic enemies using only your probe, bullets and power ups but don't lose your ball to the void. Do you have what it takes to reach the end of the universe?

name: Mini Words: Top Movies
shortDescription: The Top 100 Movies. You know them and you love them. Test your knowledge about the highest-grossing films of all time in “Mini Words: Top Movies”, a unique mix of logic puzzle, word search and trivia.

name: Fingertips  mountain  sea
shortDescription: Fingertips mountain sea: everyone's heart longing for the peach garden

name: Manufactoria 2022
shortDescription: Manufactoria 2022 is a constructive puzzle game about pushing robots around. (It's okay, they don't complain.) Use simple parts to engineer solutions to open-ended problems, then rebuild 'em better! Take a company from your backyard to the soaring heights of success! How hard could it be?

name: Creator Adventure Legend
shortDescription: This is a fantasy world, and you are a creator who will be punished into the reincarnation because of misplacement and experience the punishment of the 99th century,So you plan to build a village to protect you for every life

name: Clay Game
shortDescription: Explore a world handcrafted from clay. Make dumb jokes with your Foxcat friend. Use magic to solve puzzles. Can you solve the mystery at the Wizard Tower?

name: Twilight Struggle: Red Sea
shortDescription: Answer the summons of the trumpets and bear the burden of the Twilight Struggle. Set during the ideological tension of the Cold War, Twilight Struggle: Red Sea places the United States and the Soviet Union at odds in the Horn of Africa. Every choice you make will impact the balance of power.

name: NuclearRifle
shortDescription: 《NuclearRifle》 is an FPS shooting game. The protagonist wakes up from a small town house, only to find that the doors are locked. From time to time, strange sounds of biting came from nearby houses, and the exit of the town were sealed. What happened to the town? Can the protagonist escape?

name: Pandemic Panic!
shortDescription: We're in lockdown and you're our only hope! Grab your blaster, ready the cure and prepare to face the virus head on in this frantic, wacky and wild hospital. Don't be fooled, this is a task for only the best out there. Think you have what it takes?

name: PST VR (Primary Surgical Treatment)
shortDescription: “Primary surgical treatment” is a virtual simulator, designed for education purposes. By immersing yourself with your pair of Oculus VR Headsets, you can experience the task of treating a wound with many available surgical instruments and help the patient to begin the recovery.

name: Zerowood
shortDescription: Special action games

name: Naught
shortDescription: Test your skills, take control of the environment, and guide Naught through a dark underground world full of mystery. A platform videogame with a unique control that will immerse you in deep labyrinths in search of the light.

name: Flying Soldiers
shortDescription: Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.

name: evolution for beginners
shortDescription: Evolution For Beginners is an evolution simulation where you can create and cultivate your own species by only using evolutionary mechanics. Watch your creatures multiply like microorganisms in a primeval ocean while only the fittest survive.

name: Elva the Eco Dragon
shortDescription: "Elva, the Eco Dragon" is a 3D game in third view where you must control Elva, a small dragon whose mission is to cleanse the planet: land, sea and even space. Help Elva and you will help humanity to create a better world for everyone.

name: Bloons TD Battles 2
shortDescription: From the creators of Bloons TD6... Bloons TD Battles 2 is a brand new installment of the top-rated head-to-head tower defense game. Gather your Hero, choose your team of powerful Monkey Towers, and prepare to battle one on one against other players and relentless waves of Bloons!

name: MEGALAN 11
shortDescription: This is a exploration-puzzle game. Explore the science station and help the bad luck rescuers get out from the forgotten planet in 11 days.

name: Modest Hero
shortDescription: The violent clashes in the suburbs ended as a result of the military's harsh interventions. During the clashes, a general was killed brutally by a group of rebels. Seven people suspected of killing the general were arrested in next morning.

name: Cascading Failure
shortDescription: Lead your troops into battle first hand in an intense Sci-Fi world. Construct bases, build defences, construct bigger bases, build way too many defences and take the map with overwhelming amounts of infantry, mechs and firepower.

name: An Interesting Journey of Monsieur PAF
shortDescription: An Interesting Journey of Monsieur PAF is a platform / isometric puzzle game. Sharing similar mechanics with the Sokoban, Monsieur PAF attempts to revisit the genre using 3D verticality in magnificent homemade, two-dimensional environments.

name: Persian Nights 2: The Moonlight Veil
shortDescription: Travel to the magical land of Persian Nights and save your sister from a dire fate. Feel the taste of orient in this sumptuous and beguiling hidden object adventure.

name: Faefever
shortDescription: Faefever tells the story of a troubled journalist trying to uncover the mystery of a missing brother and sister in the small town of Glenroch, where not all things are as they seem.

name: Oddest Sea
shortDescription: Traverse an ominous ocean while evading monsters to reach the refuge of a distant lighthouse.

name: The Chronicles of Robin Hood - The King of Thieves
shortDescription: Join forces with Robin Hood in this thrilling match3 game...! Help Robin Hood and the Merry Men in their quest to take down the Sheriff of Nottingham!

name: Kira and the Life Stone
shortDescription: This the journey of Kira a lost soul in the state of limbo trying to get back to life and find out why is he dead. Follow him in his journey of getting back to life and get new powers, fight different enemies and find hidden secrets.

name: Cosmotic Blast
shortDescription: Cosmotic Blast is an asteroid game in an immersive experience. Stand amongst a swirling cluster of asteroids in space as you pilot a ship. Blast and destroy wave after wave of asteroids and collect the Cosmotic energy to enhance your ship, making it faster, stronger and more resilient.

name: Witching Tower: Heroes
shortDescription: Fight the undead with four sets of weapons. Beat the bosses to save the kingdom from enemies. Relentless arcade action suitable even for people new to VR! Breathtaking visuals and dark fantasy environments are waiting for you!

name: Protodroid DeLTA
shortDescription: Reach your potential in a fast and fluid 3D action-platformer set in a beautiful and hopeful Solarpunk world. Take on challenging bosses, upgrade your systems, and show humanity the promise of AI.

name: Space War Machine
shortDescription: In Space War Machine you warp to a new star for each battle, in a never-ending fight for dominance. Pause and slow time at will, control a vast armada of ships with powers! Explore and Terra-form planets. Warp to your far off opponents. Unleash your Ultimate units for total destruction! And more!!!

name: Kane's Shadow
shortDescription: Kane's Shadow is an alternative rhythm game inspired by trauma release exercises. Guide Kane through his re-discovery of a traumatic memory and assist him in releasing his inner demons once and for all. =

name: The Lilliputian Runner
shortDescription: Skill-based platformer where color matters!

name: Toilet Paper Crisis Simulator 2020
shortDescription: Take control of the typical toilet paper panic buyer. Help us to understand this strange phenomenon by gathering as much Toilet Paper as you can.

name: Dungeon & Derision
shortDescription: Dungeon & Derision is a tactical turn-based game with some gameplay elements taken from the rogue-like genre ! Create your team to explore a mysterious island run by a powerful king !

name: Underwater Wars
shortDescription: Underwater Wars is a tactical turn-based strategy game that takes place in the depths of the ocean. Two powerful factions of people are fighting a war for territory and resources, but everything changes when mysterious "Aliens" enter the conflict.

name: Aquarium Life
shortDescription: Nurture a small aquarium. A place you can return to for a moment of peace and quiet whenever you need it.

name: How To Make A Killing
shortDescription: An indie action RPG about assassins, necromancers, and mysterious rabbits. In an open world where your choices have permanent consequences, do you do the job or do you forge your own path as you meet new characters, battle a slew of enemies, and explore expansive dungeons and locations?

name: Crying Pony
shortDescription: Crying Pony is a 2D side-scrolling horror game where the protagonist, Michael, is hunted by the lurking evil in his nightmares. As the nightmare's corruption seeps into reality and even pulls Michael's daughter into its grasp, will he be able to lead them both to escape from the nightmare?

name: Cryptic Rooms
shortDescription: A series of 3 VR escape rooms, Eye Eaters Basement, Dungeon of Demise, and Inescapable Hypercube. You must navigate through and solve puzzles, each room with its own unique theme and hidden relics that can be found and collected.

name: Saving You From Yourself
shortDescription: You are a transgender therapist. The patients you encounter might regret transitioning. Your job is to protect them from that.

name: FirstQueen1 NEXT
shortDescription: Battlefield with Many Enemies and Allies. Your soldiers will fight or retreat in battle using their own discretion. You watch over the actions of your troops and can either move characters that are in danger to safety or send a strong character to help defeat enemies and lead your army to victory.

name: Sunset fighter
shortDescription: 这是一款竞速逃生类飞行游戏，有多种道具可供拾取，游戏节奏非常紧张，玩家的目标就是生存尽可能多的时间。

name: 异界大陆
shortDescription: 这是一款RPGmakermv制作出来的RPG游戏，一个现代人穿越到异世界的故事，所用的素材都是自带素材，只是一款娱乐作品

name: Death World
shortDescription: After a long night you wake up alone in the bunker as a bunker security guard. Hunt, kill, gather. Do anything to survive.

name: The Shepherd
shortDescription: After finding an old picture of your grandfather on a camel, you decide to leave the city and set off into the serenity of the desert. In order to become a great rider, just like he was. Train your herd, befriend desert-folk, fight predators, and navigate the mysteries of the desert.

name: Traffic Storm
shortDescription: Became the master of traffic. Control cars and avoid accidents. Get ready to fight the Traffic Storm!

name: BLACK STIGMA
shortDescription: “BLACK STIGMA” is a unique action shooter where ruthless Masters from rival organizations fight to dominate the city’s underworld. Experience stylish action and the thrill of precision gunfights!

name: Move with AI
shortDescription: This is a motion sensing game made with artificial intelligence (AI) technology. It doesn't need any sense of body equipment, just turn on the camera of the computer, and you can play happily.

name: Deadsigns
shortDescription: DeadSigns is a first person action game with survival and tower defense features. Go through many nights and beat a lot of monsters with style and get the best score !

name: RoboDo
shortDescription: RoboDo is a singleplayer/multiplayer VR puzzle game with plenty exciting features. Bunch of levels for you to complete, some are fast, reaction based and others will make you concentrate and think. Beat levels alone or join your friend for some Co-Op action!

name: Dustoff Z
shortDescription: Get those blades spinning and load up on guns and ammo, the time has come to rebuild humanity! Dustoff Z is a game about maneuvering combat-helicopters in one of the harshest weather conditions possible – A Zombie Apocalypse.

name: SUPER UFO FIGHTER
shortDescription: The space sport "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" is all the rage in the galaxy. And UFO pilots, known as Shwoopers, are battling it out today!

name: ETHYRIAL
shortDescription: A F2P 'Open Alpha' MMORPG! 23 Unique Classes - Charming Quests & Story - 100s of Monsters - 18 Professions - 8+ Dungeons - 4 World Bosses - 1 Pinnacle Boss - Total Level, Skill, & XP Rankings - Active and Friendly Devs... & Much More!

name: Heart's Medicine - Season One
shortDescription: Can you be counted on in an emergency? 🚑

name: I'mitation The Eight Suicide Note
shortDescription: A first-person search-type horror game developed for developers. Use the night vision, rean, slide and other actions to find eight items in the facility. Content that can be gameplayed in a short time.

name: Storynth
shortDescription: Join a ragtag group of adventurers, uncover the secrets of an ancient and enigmatic fortress, and alter the fate of two worlds.

name: FPV SkyDive : FPV Drone Simulator
shortDescription: FPV SkyDive is a free-to-play realistic drone racing and freestyle simulator. Feel the adrenaline of high speed first-person view drone racing in single-player or multi-player scenarios. The future is now, become an FPV pilot today!

name: Collection Quest
shortDescription: For the people who like reading quest descriptions and following context clues. Also a great experience for Achievement Hunters with 100 to collect. All while a subtle interconnected story unfolds. Free Roam Exploration awaits in a strange new world!

name: Stabby Cats
shortDescription: Fighting your fellow kitties with your incredible agility and arsenal of sharp weaponry in this 2D action game! Toss knives, climb around mansions, and stab your friends to see who will be rewarded the coveted golden yarn!

name: Death Taxi 3000
shortDescription: Retro arcade racer inspired by the MS-DOS era

name: Delirium
shortDescription: A psychological game about hardships of depression, life, being stuck, enraged and unable to fight. Unable to find the reason to continue and touches the dark side: The rage, hate, denial and definitely the wish for it to stop and for you to give up... But that's the easy way that leads nowhere...

name: Nayati River
shortDescription: A single-player game of adventure and survival, set in a vast region infested with the dead. Build an autonomous camp, manage a community of survivors, look for the many who are missing, fight ferocious hordes, and unravel the mysteries of the legend of Nayati River!

name: Jumpala
shortDescription: Jumpala is a fast-paced action puzzler with heavy fighting game vibes. While the core mechanics are simple, each game is a test of skill and strategy as you try to outscore and outplay your opponents. Features both local and online play.

name: Spacer: Legacies
shortDescription: Spacer: Legacies is a game of turn-based tactical combat between small and large capital ships. Recruit skilled captains to command your vessels and choose the abilities that will make them unstoppable. Pursue vengeance in a gripping campaign across the whole of the Tantalus Cluster.

name: Space Raiders in Space
shortDescription: Space Raiders in Space is a wave defense roguelike mixing squad management and tower defence mechanics. Command your almost competent crew to loot weapons and supplies, build defenses, and fight their way through the Bugpocalypse.

name: DENIAL
shortDescription: Denial takes place inside your own dark mind, true or false, illusion or reality... It doesn't matter. It all feels the same and the stains on the walls still remain, maybe now it is time to clean them.

name: Fire Rescue Simulator
shortDescription: Fire Rescue Simulator let's you experience the day in the life of a firefighter in the United States. From fires over hazmat and technical rescues to medical calls and normal daily station chores.

name: xDasher
shortDescription: A couch coop game where 1-4 players set off into a dim dungeon. Your quest is to eliminate all monsters lurking within by dashing through the monsters with the proper color. Eventually, you will be haunted by a ghoulish, four-headed beast and must face it in a thrilling boss fight.

name: Jelly Brawl
shortDescription: Jelly Brawl is a sticky and destructive multiplayer party game where you gotta jiggle, flop, and pop your way to the top! Fight alone or against friends for freedom from a mad king across tons of stages, mini games, and modes as you wrestle to be the last jelly standing!

name: Clam Man 2: Open Mic
shortDescription: OPEN MIC is the free prologue to the upcoming Clam Man 2: Headliner - a narrative adventure RPG where you escape your boring desk job to become a comedian!

name: Lost Circus VR - The Prologue
shortDescription: Meet a mysterious Clown and his abandoned circus. Will You dare to start a thrilling night excursion? If You dare to get into a barrel on the old, rusty cart, pushed by a strange Clown - get ready for an extreme experience.

name: BLOCKLORDS
shortDescription: BLOCKLORDS is a player-driven medieval grand strategy game where your decisions and skills shape the world and narrative. Choose from several playstyles, including farming, fighting, resource management, and ruling, and forge your own destiny as your Hero.

name: Warehouse attack
shortDescription: This is a first person shooter game, the player ACTS as a special forces soldier.Control keys:Surrounded by enemies, the player has a variety of weapon technologies to use, and is free to explore the surrounding area or kill enemies.Players need to keep their health alive for as long as possible.

name: Tower! 3D
shortDescription: Tower!3D is the successor to the best-selling Tower! 2011 airport tower simulator. Tower!3D brings the whole environment to life in full 3D with realistic foliage, real time weather changes and volumetric lighting.

name: Sky Seeker
shortDescription: SkySeeker is a game that aims to drop the enemy at the target location. You can feel very exhilarating when you can blow away your enemies, so please play.

name: Dungeons and Undead
shortDescription: INDIE FANTASY LOCAL MULTIPLAYER GAME FOR FRIENDS AND FAMILY, SET UP ON THE WORLD OF ETERNALIA Two games in one; Classic Arcade mode and First Person Medieval Shooter. Gather your party and venture forth, or play solo and venture forth too!

name: Firefighters - Airport Heroes
shortDescription: In Firefighters - Airport Heroes, players become everyday heroes in the very place where we feel most vulnerable: the world's airports.

name: FPS Robot Attack Minigame
shortDescription: Minigame where you have to destroy robots to save the world

name: Lost At Sea
shortDescription: What are the most important moments in your life? Lost At Sea is a game about life and death, about coming to terms with your past and about family. Set on a beautiful island, this game will force you to face your fears and take stock of your life through imaginative puzzles and a relatable story.

name: TinyShot
shortDescription: Tinyshot is a 2D wave-based arcade shooter. Follow Tiny on his journey after he makes a foolish and naive deal with the devil to retrieve his lost horn and earn love and fame in return.

name: Di[c]E
shortDescription: Di[c]E is a 3D survival game where dice are your only weapons. Craft equipment to grow stronger and defeat hostile forces. Uncover the secrets of a mysterious island and find a way to escape.

name: DeLight: The Journey Home
shortDescription: DeLight tells the story of a blind girl, a stray dog, and their unexpected journey during wartime.

name: Math Puzzle Alpha Challenge
shortDescription: A logic game for all ages. Fit the blocks in the pyramid following the logic to complete the challenge. The Math Puzzle Alpha Challenge game was designed to stimulate logical thinking.

name: Super Forklift 3000
shortDescription: Super Forklift 3000 is an arcade space shooter with a twist: you drive a forklift that carries and shoots up to three boxes. Defeat enemies and bosses while managing your different box types. Be careful not to run out of ammo!

name: Glare fall
shortDescription: This is a Glare shooting game distributed as an April Fools' Day project. In the near future robots dominate the world. Maid robot Glare gains flying capabilities and a disc shooter to fight against enemy robots on Earth.. Everything is for the user's dream of a peaceful everyday life.

name: Welcome to the Adventurer Inn!
shortDescription: Having just opened an inn, you set out to create a comfortable environment to bring in tired adventurers looking for respite after their questing. Earn money, upgrade your inn, and befriend a diverse cast of characters!

name: RESEARCH and DESTROY
shortDescription: RESEARCH and DESTROY is a TURN-BASED ACTION GAME with local and online co-op. Take control of three brilliant scientists as you RESEARCH and develop strange new weapons and gadgets to DESTROY the Supernatural hordes that have all but crushed humanity!

name: 湛蓝星球-迷失·赛博之城
shortDescription: This is a world abandoned by the gods! In the polluted wasteland, there is only one technological city controlled by the super company. In the city, the high-level people are drunk. Outside the exiled jobless wanderers struggle to survive in the fierce environment and the mouth of wild animals.

name: Under Lock
shortDescription: Under Lock is a multiplayer asymmetrical PvP horror game for 5 players (4 survivors versus 1 monster). Take the role of a survivor with the goal to outsmart the monster and escape from lockdown. Or choose one from several unique monsters to hunt down and devour the victims.

name: Realm of Heroes
shortDescription: Realm of Heroes is a strategy game in which players build castles to defend their lands and recruit heroes to fight for their cause.

name: Thomas Scott
shortDescription: ThomasScott will allow players to explore the world through rotation, parkour and puzzle solving.

name: Screw Drivers
shortDescription: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

name: MAVR3D 八般武艺
shortDescription: Martial Arts VR 3D (Immersive Duel, Cultural Treasure Demonstration) MAJOR UPGRADE Boss TacticalSim. Inch-longer the stronger! Inch-shorter the deadlier! Duel your Foe (or friend), Arena players, or Boss femme fatales using different pairings of Eight Martial Arts. Real-Time Strategy Action Slasher

name: Fritz Chess 17 Steam Edition
shortDescription: At the turn of the century, Fritz fascinated the chess world with victories over Garry Kasparov and then-reigning World Champion Vladimir Kramnik. The "most popular chess program" offers you everything you will need as a dedicated chess enthusiast.

name: Gem Master
shortDescription: A colorful strategic game with simple rules, quick sessions, and increasingly challenging computer opponents. Beware of the Merciless!

name: Tower of God
shortDescription: Turn-Based Action RPG

name: Legend of Towercraft
shortDescription: 'Legend of Towercraft' is a Free-to-Play Tower Defense/ARPG which has NO Pay-to-Win elements. The world is in ruins and as the Guardian of your community below the mountain, you have the task to rebuild your town and protect it from the growing corruption.

name: Zeph
shortDescription: Zeph is a puzzle game where you play as a sun entity, Zeph, who has been sent from a dying sun to the planet below to collect mosaic pieces that give her the power to restore life back to the sun. Zeph must use her sun powers of fire, light, and gravity in order to utilize parts of the world to solve puzzles and collect the mosaic pieces.

name: Swoosh
shortDescription: Simple 2D physics platformer where you try to progress through levels by interacting with different types of surfaces and objects in it.

name: Ballad of The Masked Bandits
shortDescription: Ballad of The Masked Bandits is a puzzle-packed stealth game where you play as three raccoons in a trench coat pulling off wild west heists.

name: Discreet
shortDescription: An asymmetric 3-player stealth game. Sneak in to steal valuables as a duo, or defend your home and hunt down intruders as the owner. Stealth, traps, and high tension: who will escape with the loot?

name: Element Battle Royale
shortDescription: Element Battle Royal takes BR to the next level with realistic mechanics, small games of only 24, and a large map to explore with others. Your main goal is to survive and thrive until you're the last man standing.

name: Get Over Here!
shortDescription: It's a krazy fusion of Mortal Kombat + Flappy Bird. Impale enemies while dodging deadly flying saws. Disintegrate the queued up enemies with the flying saws, but doing so requires great precision and courage. Absorb enough blood to engage Fatal Drive mode and destroy everything.

name: Void Arena
shortDescription: Void Arena is a Fantasy FPS which features an elegant ARPG combat system in the place of gunplay. Skills and classes traditionally played from the isometric perspective are thrilling to experience in first person.

name: 匠人物语Craftsman story
shortDescription: Craftsman story This game is an RPG open type role-playing game. There are many professions to play, such as swordsman, mage, hero, businessman, bandit, craftsman, etc. Each profession has its own main plot, as well as rich branch tasks and hidden tasks.

name: Ash of Legends
shortDescription: Grapple anywhere, build towers, place traps, shoot guns, launch arrows, and throw sabers, to defend the spores from hordes of the evil empire. Includes native Meta Quest with Link and Steam VR support.

name: Axizon Labs: Zombies
shortDescription: Axizon Labs: Zombies is a 2D Sci-Fi themed Platform Zombie Shooter Game based on the story of the sudden outbreak of ZMB Virus which affected 30% of the population around the world.

name: Moolii's Dreamland
shortDescription: Moolii’s Dreamland is a Bullet-hell game. Players will play as the little fox Moolii to fight against monsters in her dream. This game features whimsical level designs, monsters, and powerful bosses, along with combos of ammo skills and magical tricks. Help Moolii wake up from her nightmare!

name: Color Crush
shortDescription: Color Crush is a match 3 game. Swap and match the shapes. Solve the levels making smart moves.

name: Terracosmic
shortDescription: Terracosmic is a game.

name: Covid Quest 2077
shortDescription: Earth has fallen to COVID-2077. Your mission: Rescue your fellow survivors throughout the universe.

name: Drekirokr - Dusk of the Dragon
shortDescription: A classic-inspired RPG set in a post-apocaliptic world.

name: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition
shortDescription: A turn-based playable comic book about surviving in an alien ocean. Explore a planet reclaimed by nature. Forage, salvage, and cultivate to survive. Uncover a lost history. Discover who you are. Find your way home.

name: Redmatch 2
shortDescription: A free fast-paced online multiplayer FPS with grapple hooks where you upgrade your stats with kills!

name: Historica Fantasia
shortDescription: In the land known as Siegeland Empire, the assassination of the Emperor has brought the Nation under a Civil War. After being convicted for the Murder of her Father, Player will have to journey across the land toward the Capital, and claim the Throne to end the War.

name: 80S escape
shortDescription: This is a first person shooting game,The player is a pathfinder soldier, who is free to explore the surrounding area to collect intelligence,Players can kill the enemy or avoid the enemy's attack, so as to ensure that the health value can survive for as long as possible.

name: Hard Vacuum
shortDescription: Hard Vacuum is a single-player space combat game developed from the ground up for virtual reality. Be the pilot of a starfighter with a fully interactive cockpit.

name: Interstate Drifter 2000
shortDescription: Drift through the interstates and sideroads of this open game world, win street races and try to avoid traffic and police.

name: Pay Me In Colors
shortDescription: Pay Me In Colors is a 2D platformer game with multiple mechanics, six different worlds and over 40 challenging levels. Face meteors, gravity changing, spikes falling and missiles coming in your direction while you try to recover the colors back to your world. A game inspired by the classics of the past.

name: Polarities
shortDescription: Want to battle your friends and family in a high paced, action packed local multiplayer brawler? Then get ready to duke it out using magnetic powers in Polarities!

name: Unknown Ways
shortDescription: Buckle up and take a ride on this wholesome adventure to places you couldn't even imagine. Help this golem boy to find a way out of these forests and mountains.

name: Train Station Renovation - First Job
shortDescription: Welcome to the prologue to Train Station Renovation. This is where you will learn and teach how to renovate these small and the largest train stations in the world.

name: Murk
shortDescription: Your goal is to escape from this strange, hostile and really dark place. Don't be afraid of the dark, kill your enemies without mercy, cautiously avoid death traps, discover quirky secret places, and much more!

name: Thrice in a row
shortDescription: Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses. There are 28 different levels available.

name: My Sweet Confession
shortDescription: The hapless, love-struck Ichika made a big mistake, and she might have ruined her friendship with Hana forever. With the help of her classmate Ayumi, can she work her own feelings out in time to show Hana how she really feels? A soft, comedic romance with big personalities and a tinge of melodrama.

name: Modiverse
shortDescription: An open multiplayer sandbox game; includes tools, props, levels, NPCs, character models, game-modes and much more! Make your own using our mod kit!

name: Jigsaw Puzzles for Kids and Adults - Europe
shortDescription: Jigsaw Puzzles for Kids and Adults - Europe Do puzzle in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Jigsaw Puzzles for Kids and Adults - Europe is designed for adults and for kids.

name: The Shadow Government Simulator
shortDescription: A turn-based strategy game where you lead a secret society towards world domination. Investigate the influential and convert them to your faction via bribery, seduction and intimidation. Reshape society's power structures to fend off rival societies and the world's nations in your quest for power.

name: Therapy Sheep VR
shortDescription: Roam free through a mountainside meadow modeled after the Swiss Alps. Rolling hills and tall grass rustle with the wind as you walk alongside friendly grazing sheep, who are happy to have your company. Escape reality to meditate, work on your mindfulness, or just lie down and look at the stars.

name: Pandemic Crisis
shortDescription: In the event of a global pandemic, would your first priority be preserving lives or saving the economy?

name: New Yankee 8: Journey of Odysseus
shortDescription: Once again, Mary shatters the boundaries of time and space as she's practicing magic and sends herself and her husband, John, reeling back in time. They land on the outskirts of Troy, where they help the Greek hero Odysseus triumph in the legendary battle.

name: PLOID SAGA
shortDescription: Ploid is a new platform adventure game for old or modern hardware, play and explore the lost temples, gain sacred disc files and become the ultimate Ploid X of the galaxy! + V.O.I.D. Definitive Edition

name: INVASION
shortDescription: INVASION is a game about heroes who are fighting an invasion of wild animals that has hit their village.

name: Wasted World
shortDescription: The apocalypse has come, brought by pollution, wars and disease! Your mission is to save your land... or what’s left of it. Alone or with your friends gather, recycle, craft, build, plant, explore, fight & help survivors.

name: Good Knight - One-Button Bullet-Hell
shortDescription: Geometry Dash meets Super Hexagon, in this ONE-BUTTON "Butt-Clenching" Bullet-Hell! Experience a rollercoaster of emotions as you experience filipino hell with its unique mechanics and Philippine mythology inspired story.

name: Chessсakе
shortDescription: Classic board game in a computer version. A variant of English drafts. The goal of the game is to collect all enemy checkers.

name: Epica
shortDescription: Journey into the fairy lands of Epica, a saga awaits.

name: Kirakira stars idol project Nagisa
shortDescription: "You're the idol you used to sing to on stage? " After their first live performance, Nobuyuki and Ai have a fateful encounter with the top idol, Nagisa Yukihiro. While getting involved with Nagisa through joint lessons, it is decided that an idol festival - DivaFes - will be held, but...

name: Bird Missions
shortDescription: Live the life of your bird reigning in the air! Find one by one all the hidden pieces on each map and unlock new territories!

name: Beyond Solar
shortDescription: Blast through intense pixel-art bullet hell battles in Beyond Solar! Conquer challenging campaigns, survive relentless enemy waves, master one-hit Hardcore Mode, compete in online PvP, and build your own customizable space cabin.

name: Oh Frog
shortDescription: Oh Frog is a loopy 2D action adventure game set in the mysterious, fairy tale-esque lands of the Frog Kingdom. Play as Lif, the Frog Kingdom’s bravest frog, as you travel through gorgeous, lovingly hand-drawn landscapes and animated worlds, on your quest to recover the stolen Crowns of Power!

name: Zen Universe
shortDescription: Explore а bundle of 4 real-life and legendary locations - shot, scanned, and hand-polished into realistic interactive environments. Early Access includes 2 experiences and 2 more will be updated for free.

name: Woody Chopper
shortDescription: In Woody Chopper you help Woody chop down the endless tree on his way to becoming a lumberjack millionaire. Whether in spring, summer, autumn or winter, it's the perfect casual game for in-between. Now with Achievements! Play Woody Chopper today and help Woody get the legendary axe.

name: Samsara Room
shortDescription: You woke up in a mysterious room you have never seen before. Can you find another way out? Samsara Room is a remake of the praised predecessor of the Rusty Lake & Cube Escape series.

name: Reflections of Life: Utopia Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Can you escape a utopian toy world before it’s too late?

name: Defective Holiday
shortDescription: Memories of a new place

name: Iron Reckoning
shortDescription: Become a warrior in this sci-fi/fantasy adventure! Iron Reckoning showcases a unique movement mechanic that will test your skill in preserving airborne momentum. Wield a variety of powers and master the combat to defeat your enemies, as you uncover the mystery behind a deadly machine threat!

name: Catovania
shortDescription: This is a game about a cat who fights with enemies. 2D platformer is made in a retro style.

name: CoronaFighter
shortDescription: A coronavirus-themed shoot-em-up in the classic arcade tradition.

name: Saint Lary's Hospital - Ay Corona!
shortDescription: Play as saint Lary as you battle an outbreak at St. Lary's hospital. Be careful though as patients are always trying to get your attention by coughing at you. The more unruly patients have also been hiding toilet paper around the hospital.

name: Apocalypse Survivor
shortDescription: Apocalypse Survivor is a challenging first-person shooter (FPS), set after a nuclear war.

name: Chang'an: The capital of Tang Dynasty
shortDescription: It is a city building game of Chang'an, the capital city of Tang dynasty in 8th century AD. Players will build the ancient city in an 1:1 proportion sandbox. Based on researches of history and ancient architecture, you will see a Chang'an city reconstructed in reality.

name: Tree Simulator 2021
shortDescription: Wood you like marginally improved graphics? Do you like leafing it all behind and taking root in some random field? If so, you are a tree, be the best tree you can be. Prepare for a deeper and more detailed understanding of what it is to be a tree. A true work of art.

name: Escape Initiative
shortDescription: Run, jump, and shoot lasers in this difficult and aesthetic action precision platformer. Built for fast play but not required, you will enjoy hand built levels with an immense variety of challenges. Customize your colors and realize your initiative. ESCAPE.

name: A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog
shortDescription: "A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog" is a virtual reality adventure in which you go on a search for the inhabitants of the valley, who have disappeared since a mysterious fog appeared in their homeland. Help the little rabbit by completing the story around the charismatic characters of the valley.

name: Fires At Midnight
shortDescription: In a world where making love without being in love makes you spontaneously combust, the person you love most may be the one who burns you in Fires at Midnight – a cinematic and interactive visual novel about a couple who struggles to stay together.

name: 泡泡三国
shortDescription: 《泡泡三国》是一款基于三国题材的2D消除类游戏，游戏包含多个关卡。卡通的游戏画面设计，动态的视觉效果和丰富的技能选择，让玩家体验一种不一样的消除游戏。

name: Strinova
shortDescription: Strinova is an anime-style third-person tactical competitive shooter. Switch freely between three-dimensional and two-dimensional forms in this one-of-a-kind game that offers a unique tactical shooting system for an unparalleled experience.

name: Stilstand
shortDescription: A dark, whimsical, and absurd interactive comic by artist Ida Hartmann, exploring the despair and loneliness of a young woman living alone through a long summer in Copenhagen.

name: Escape From Island
shortDescription: After a helicopter crash on a mysterious island, your mission is to survive and escape before the island’s dark forces consume you. Explore, gather resources, and face dangerous enemies as you navigate the island’s open world. Can you escape before it's too late?

name: GraFi Easter
shortDescription: GraFi Easter - casual, colorful, minimalist, physical puzzle with traps, treadmills, portals, easter eggs and changing gravity.

name: Fast Gear
shortDescription: Fast Gear is a high-intensity 3D car racing game built for PC, offering both thrilling single-player challenges and competitive online multiplayer PvP action.

name: Prisme 7
shortDescription: The first video game on modern and contemporary art. Produced by Centre Pompidou.

name: Cards & Crystals
shortDescription: Match3 meets Trading Card Game! Collect cards, level up your heroes, and build decks to defeat your foes in this fast-paced puzzle/strategy game.

name: Tales of Kongfu
shortDescription: 游戏题材来源于中国武侠，采用类似杀戮尖塔的卡组构建玩法，并从格斗游戏当中获取灵感，游戏每张卡牌都代表一个招式，每个招式又分解为多个动作，这部分我是基于现实格斗当中，游戏采用一个动作一结算的方式，只有当你的招式完全行动完成后才会拥有使用下一张牌的机会。招式的动作分为四种攻击防御破绽警惕。游戏采用灵活的连招系统，只要两个招式间首尾有重叠，则可以省略前一个招式的重叠部分。玩家需要利用这项设定让自己的破绽尽量小，并且尽量利用对手的破绽。

name: Hunter of the Disowned
shortDescription: Hunter Of The Disowned is a procedural dungeon adventure video game in which you embody a tragic hero who must fight against destiny in a world ruled by Gods of nature an slaved animals.

name: BitBattle
shortDescription: BitBattle is a 2D multiplayer action shooter. Zero Aim, 100% Bullet Hell! Collect Weapons and Items and fight against friends or other players.

name: YouCanDoIt?
shortDescription: Try to clear the game How to play is simple. You can move the chicken to the target point. Drag with the mouse to jump the chicken. Feel the annoyance starting from scratch Sometimes you can get angry while playing this game.

name: 180 Files: The Aegis Project
shortDescription: Uncover a web of evil as a superspy! Break rules, break hearts–don't break cover.

name: The Most Beautiful Room in the World
shortDescription: Virtual world that reenacts through interactive animations the content painted by Andrea Mantegna in the Saint Giorgio Castle in Mantua, Italy. Virtual Reality interactive animated environment. For artists and scholars.

name: Woodsalt
shortDescription: "Woodsalt" is an adventure game set on the planet of Nu-Terra, 1000 years after Earth was evacuated during chaotic natural disasters and an attack by giant creatures.

name: Sakura Stars
shortDescription: When hordes of Youkai threaten the world, the Tanukis send a messenger to choose human girls to receive magical powers to defend humanity. They are known as SAKURA STARS. This is a horizontal shmup made on Pico-8, a retro fantasy console with purposeful limitations to simulate an 8-bit era console.

name: Swords of Time
shortDescription: A colorful fantasy world threatened by dark forces is in danger. Help defeat the threat with your allies and companions who join you on the way. This game allows deep character development that progresses with classes, skills, permanent huntings stats, equipment and more.

name: Virtual Presenter Pro
shortDescription: Virtual Presenter Pro is a VR game designed to make you a better public speaker without leaving your home. Hone your speaking skills by using our in-depth analysis to incrementally improve your presentations.

name: Battle for the Kingdom
shortDescription: Top down card based medieval strategy game about map control.

name: PUZZL
shortDescription: PUZZL is a puzzle game with simple gameplay and increasing difficulty. With a minimalist and pleasant look, have fun solving it's 50 levels.

name: Space Mouse 2
shortDescription: In 1981, Geimu Kyoujin's masterpiece "Space Mouse" was released. 39 years later, a sequel has arrived. In "Space Mouse 2", you'll enter a perilous underground labyrinth. This is a roguelike dot-eater designed to appeal to players of all skill levels.

name: Hi-Score Boi
shortDescription: This is a clicking journey where you, the gamer set out to achieve the highest score and become the ultimate gamer!

name: Furry Shakespeare: Emperor Penguin Lear
shortDescription: Rewrite Shakespeare's King Lear. But with animals and dinosaurs and stuff.

name: 3D Jigsaw Puzzle Simulator
shortDescription: A demo game about assembling puzzles in 3D space. You can load any picture for assembly from your computer and select any level from the pause menu.

name: Start Heart Thief | 出发吧！偷心盗贼 | 出撃 ルビー | 出擊 偷心盜賊
shortDescription: Our heroine ruby is an orphan, Every morning, she goes out to explore the secret island of God Every night, she put on her nightdress

name: Micro Platformer
shortDescription: A minimalistic platformer with a 1x1 tileset. No enemies, no bullets, no lasers. Just sheer platforming.

name: Burn Me Twice
shortDescription: A narrative adventure that combines the exploration and investigation of the enigmatic town of Düstenburg and its people, with trials that test your knowledge about the case.

name: ROBALL
shortDescription: Space shooter on your own drone. Various types of weapons. Every man for himself.

name: 渡劫 x 魔女 ~ Team up with A Magician！
shortDescription: The orc magician who came down from the sky ended my lonely life. However, my peaceful daily life was also disturbed.

name: Devolverland Expo
shortDescription: Devolverland Expo is a first-person 'marketing simulator' set within an abandoned convention center after the annual Devolver Digital game expo was mysteriously canceled.

name: Center2048
shortDescription: The game needs to be rebuilt and will be temporarily removed. It will be relaunched in about a year. Thank you for your attention.

name: Audio Party Pack
shortDescription: A party game designed around sound. Includes 3 mini-games featuring "sound" focused gameplay!This party game is designed with visual impairments in mind as it relies strongly on sound. There are three mini-games, each focusing on a different challenge.

name: Coof Attack
shortDescription: Defend your toilet paper from an ever-growing angry mob! Even the odds by teaming up with friends in up to 4-player co-op. Customise your character's appearance and skills to fit your play-style. Discover more as you progress and unlock even cooler stuff.

name: 胆小鬼 Coward
shortDescription: A man desperate for life, choose to jump to end his life. The soul of suicide is imprisoned in the dark house. He has to escape from the devil and save the souls of other suicides in order to survive for 5 days.

name: My Sail And My Sea
shortDescription: Half sandbox navigation game, including construction, exploration, trade, operation and other elements, combined with instant combat and round game.In addition, the game also has a built-in blueprint editor, which can use cubes to stack everything and share with each other.

name: 我是熊孩子
shortDescription: 今天天气好晴朗~~ 熊孩子又出门玩啦~~ 前面有个人~~ 捉弄一下他~~ 哈哈哈哈来追我呀~~

name: Geki Yaba Runner
shortDescription: Turn into a raging force of destruction or a super speedy gnome to overcome Geki Yaba's ultimate challenge. Do you have what it takes to save the princess in peril?

name: A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950
shortDescription: “A Painter's Tale” is an adventure game that tells the story of the tiny Südtirol village of Curon Venosta by mixing reality and fiction. The old Curon was flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam. What lies beneath the bell tower still emerging from the lake?

name: SpinZap
shortDescription: SpinZap is a challenging game in classic arcade style. Use your reflexes, dexterity and boss skills to conquer 81 levels of circle zapping madness.

name: Fighting Fiends
shortDescription: Fighting Fiends is a top-down fighting game. Play it 1 on 1 for intense matches or with up to 4 players for chaotic fun, both locally and online.

name: soundStrider
shortDescription: Enter a synthesized reality. Explore endless worlds. Play an instrument. Save bookmarks. A psychedelic audio exploration game, walking simulator, music generator, and relaxation tool best experienced with headphones.

name: The Odd Neon Void
shortDescription: The Odd Neon Void is an experimental Adventure/RPG game where you become Jack, a man stuck in a strange and unfamiliar place called the neon void. Don't be too sad.

name: Rotatex 3
shortDescription: Solve puzzles, rotate the level and guide the Cat to the teleport.

name: Minimalist Space War
shortDescription: A minimalist retro space shooter. Challenging, fast, and fun game play

name: Azure
shortDescription: A final project of my college freshman year. Just jump and dash and have fun.

name: Captive
shortDescription: You wake up in a bright, but mysterious room. You don't know what is happening or how you got there.

name: Music is the Language
shortDescription: Music is The Language is a VR music video featuring a new song by DJ Dani Magnani. Explore a mystical planet, following the surround beat of trumpets, voice, and guitars, in this surreal experience.

name: The Link
shortDescription: This application lets you use a webcam and a microphone to play any game with real-world movements and voice commands.

name: b 2
shortDescription: b 2: online multiplayer an alien place you are the bee: fly where you like, play as you like

name: Racing Juke
shortDescription: Compete against cunning and tough rivals racers out on the race track to prove that you are the fastest!

name: End of Panduora
shortDescription: "End of Panduora" is a fast-paced fantasy-style strategy management game. In a randomly generated corner of the abyss, by consuming sanity in exchange for strength that does not belong to you. In the endless sea, create a new paradise to welcome the remnants of the old gods.

name: Angel Legion
shortDescription: Idle or play whenever and wherever you want. Customize the looking of your favorite Angels. Automatically accumulate resources all the time.

name: Jungle Town: Birthday quest
shortDescription: A colorful educational adventure for children ages 2–5. Join six friendly animals, solve simple puzzles, find hidden objects, and practice attention, fine motor skills, and everyday habits while preparing a birthday surprise for the baby elephant. Play offline, with no adult help required.

name: Ukrainian Soccer  ( any two points directed towards the net can score )
shortDescription: This game allows to create scoring opportunities from many angles simultaneously what makes for a dynamic and exciting play. Direct any two points from your team towards the opponent's net and score. First party to score wins. It also features three board designs with zoom.

name: Battle Teams 2
shortDescription: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries.

name: The Deadly Path
shortDescription: Aid the Deities of Dread in their quest for vengeance and pave the way for their ascension. Gather grim materials, construct defences and expand the underworld to appease the rage of the gods in The Deadly Path, a unique building management and roguelike strategy game.

name: Ominoflux
shortDescription: Ominoflux will test your brain in a most peculiar way.

name: Tempest Tower
shortDescription: Tempest Tower is an action packed tower defense platformer where you must brawl with incoming hordes of Creepers while herding the local critters to safety. Build, fight, upgrade, overcome.

name: Patchkins Party
shortDescription: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 8 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

name: Chronicle Archive - Japan
shortDescription: Explore history like never before in Chronicle Archive - Japan! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect badges, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.

name: AstroScaper
shortDescription: Colonize barren asteroids and transform them into thriving space colonies. Discover powerful building synergies, solve satisfying placement puzzles, and journey from one procedurally generated world to the next.

name: Frontier Force Vanguard
shortDescription: Frontier Force Vanguard is an open-world, turn-based RPG where you take on missions and build your reputation and supports the Empire expansion.

name: Sad Virus Foodland
shortDescription: Walking simulation and adventure game where player controls virus character in foodland. Mission to avoid obstacles and find beer bottle

name: Rat Run
shortDescription: Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

name: Monkey Wave
shortDescription: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

name: Hello Anxiety
shortDescription: Hello Anxiety is a pixel art narrative puzzle RPG set in a surreal world shaped by mental health struggles. Navigate eerie bookstores, silent streets, and haunting memories as you explore the layers of anxiety and self-doubt in this emotional, story-driven experience.

name: Eyes Of The ElderWood
shortDescription: Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

name: Dream about yoU
shortDescription: A dashing blond partner drops in from the sky, declaring they're taking responsibility for you—but they need a small favor.Find them in your dreams, wake them up, and crack the dream maze. Sci-fi comedy, adventure starts now!

name: One Tower Defense
shortDescription: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

name: Police Chief Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
shortDescription: Free introduction to the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

name: AxeSlinger
shortDescription: AxeSlinger is a fast, movement based roguelite FPS where you shred through enemy infested dimensions using guitar weapons. Fight hordes, rack up insane combos, unlock abilities, and battle colossal bosses as The AxeSlinger on your path to ultimate power!

name: Restitutor: Empire Restored
shortDescription: Restitutor is a historical incremental grand strategy game focused on statecraft, diplomacy, and calculated warfare. Strengthen your economy, research new technologies, form alliances, and outmaneuver rivals through high-level strategic decisions without micromanagement.

name: Arrow Flow
shortDescription: Welcome to Arrow Flow - a stylish, minimalist puzzle game where every decision requires care and thoughtful strategy. Use logic and spatial thinking to direct all the arrows to the exit and prevent them from crossing.

name: Martha's Dolls 2
shortDescription: The viral horror hit returns. Step into the haunting ruins of the Martha's House , where every shadow conceals a threat and the porcelain dolls aren't just watching , they're hunting you.

name: Novel Forger: Suicide Mr. Fury
shortDescription: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

name: Slot Theory
shortDescription: A roguelike tower defense where every draft permanently mutates your build. Stack modifiers, trigger massive Surge events, and watch your defenses evolve into unstable, compounding systems that fight in ways you didn’t design.

name: Clutch Legend: FPS Career Simulator
shortDescription: Build a Counter-Strike-inspired esports career from nobody to legend. Master weapons, develop your skills, negotiate contracts, hire staff, and play or simulate every match on your road to the Major.

name: Dawn of Horror
shortDescription: Dawn of Horror is a fast-paced, brutal cyberpunk Battle Royale set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City, 2221. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, scavengers fight over the remaining ruins. Drop in, gear up, hack the system, and be the last one breathing.

name: BUNKER: RED FLAG
shortDescription: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

name: KESU-JI
shortDescription: KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

name: Pocket Dinos
shortDescription: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

name: DEMON SIEGE
shortDescription: Stack ridiculous power-ups infinitely in this retro-inspired FPS Bullet Heaven. Build completely broken combinations as you go from a lowly demon hunter to an unstoppable demon-slaying GOD. Includes Story Mode with multiple endings and Endless Mode.

name: Castleborne Survivors
shortDescription: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

name: Source aged like fine wine: ballad of jets
shortDescription: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
shortDescription: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

name: Token x Token x Clicker
shortDescription: Run a tiny 3D office of robot employees — the Grammis — and pick up the token embers they drop. Win contracts on the lottery reel, ride out overtime rushes, renovate your one-room startup into a corporate tower, and climb to #1 in the market cap rankings. 200+ collectibles. Fully local.

name: CapyCam
shortDescription: There's no fuss here. There's only golden light, rustling grass, and dozens of friendly faces. Look for capybaras in the thicket, but remember the most important rule of photography: to capture the perfect shot, sometimes you just need to lower the camera.

name: CrystalStack
shortDescription: Build the tallest crystal tower you can. CrystalStack is a 3D physics-based stacking game developed with Unreal Engine 5. Carefully place transparent crystal cubes, keep your balance, and beat your highest score before the tower collapses. Relaxing to play, challenging to master.
